verses.kjv: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.
verses.modern: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, or stand in the way of sinners, or sit in the seat of mockers.

verses.kjv: But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
verses.modern: But His delight is in the law of the LORD, and on His law He meditates day and night.

verses.kjv: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
verses.modern: He is like a tree planted by streams of water, which yields its fruit in season and whose leaf does not wither — whatever He does prospers.

verses.kjv: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
verses.modern: Not so the wicked! They are like chaff that the wind blows away.

verses.kjv: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
verses.modern: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.

verses.kjv: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.
verses.modern: For the LORD watches over the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked leads to destruction.

chapters.summary: The psalmist celebrates the man who delights in the law of the LORD. The righteous are like a tree planted by streams of water; the ungodly are like chaff driven away by the wind.

verses.kjv: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?
verses.modern: Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?

verses.kjv: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his anointed, saying,
verses.modern: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against His anointed, saying,

verses.kjv: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.
verses.modern: "Let us break their chains," they say, "and throw off their shackles."

verses.kjv: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the LORD shall have them in derision.
verses.modern: He who sits in the heavens shall laugh; the Lord shall have them in derision.

verses.kjv: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.
verses.modern: Then He rebukes them in His anger and terrifies them in His wrath, saying,

verses.kjv: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.
verses.modern: "I have installed my King on Zion, my holy mountain."

verses.kjv: I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.
verses.modern: I will proclaim the LORD's decree: He said to me, "You are my Son; today I have become Your Father.

verses.kjv: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.
verses.modern: Ask me. I will make the nations your inheritance, the ends of the earth Your possession.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.
verses.modern: You will break them with a rod of iron; You will dash them to pieces like pottery."

verses.kjv: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.
verses.modern: Therefore, You kings, be wise; be warned, you rulers of the earth.

verses.kjv: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
verses.modern: Serve the LORD with fear and celebrate His rule with trembling.

verses.kjv: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.
verses.modern: Kiss His Son, or He will be angry and Your way will lead to Your destruction, for His wrath can flare up in a moment. Blessed are all who take refuge in Him.

chapters.summary: The nations rage against the LORD and His anointed, but God laughs from heaven and declares His King installed on Zion. The psalm warns earthly rulers to kiss the Son and take refuge in Him before His wrath is kindled.

verses.kjv: LORD, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.
verses.modern: LORD, how many are my foes! How many rise up against me!

verses.kjv: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah.
verses.modern: Many there are who say of my soul, "There is no help for Him in God." Selah.

verses.kjv: But thou, O LORD, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.
verses.modern: But You, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, the One who lifts my head high.

verses.kjv: I cried unto the LORD with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
verses.modern: I call out to the LORD. He answers me from His holy mountain.

verses.kjv: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.
verses.modern: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, because the LORD sustains me.

verses.kjv: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.
verses.modern: I will not fear though tens of thousands assail me on every side.

verses.kjv: Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.
verses.modern: Arise, LORD! Deliver me, my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.

verses.kjv: Salvation belongeth unto the LORD: thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.
verses.modern: From the LORD comes deliverance. May Your blessing be on Your people.

chapters.summary: The psalmist cries out to the LORD as enemies multiply against him. He confesses God as his shield and the lifter of his head, and lies down in peace because the LORD sustains him.

verses.kjv: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
verses.modern: Answer me when I call to You, my righteous God. Give me relief from my distress; have mercy on me and hear my prayer.

verses.kjv: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.
verses.modern: How long will You people turn my glory into shame? How long will You love delusions and seek false gods?

verses.kjv: But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the LORD will hear when I call unto him.
verses.modern: Know that the LORD has set apart His faithful servant for Himself; the LORD hears when I call to Him.

verses.kjv: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.
verses.modern: Tremble and do not sin; when You are on Your beds, search Your hearts and be silent.

verses.kjv: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.
verses.modern: Offer the sacrifices of the righteous and trust in the LORD.

verses.kjv: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.
verses.modern: There are many who say, "Who will show us any good?" LORD, lift up the light of Your countenance on us.

verses.kjv: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.
verses.modern: Fill my heart with joy when their grain and new wine abound.

verses.kjv: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
verses.modern: In peace I will lie down and sleep, for You alone, LORD, make me dwell in safety.

chapters.summary: The psalmist calls on God for relief from distress and rebukes those who turn his glory into shame. He declares that the LORD has set apart the godly and lies down in peace, for God alone makes him dwell in safety.

verses.kjv: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.
verses.modern: Listen to my words, LORD, consider my lament.

verses.kjv: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.
verses.modern: Hear my cry for help, my King and my God, for to You I pray.

verses.kjv: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
verses.modern: In the morning, LORD, You hear my voice; in the morning I lay my requests before You and wait expectantly.

verses.kjv: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.
verses.modern: For You are not a God Who is pleased with wickedness; with You, evil people are not welcome.

verses.kjv: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
verses.modern: The arrogant cannot stand in Your presence. You hate all who do wrong;

verses.kjv: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
verses.modern: You destroy those who tell lies. The bloodthirsty and deceitful You, LORD, detest.

verses.kjv: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
verses.modern: But as for me, I will come into Your house in the multitude of Your mercy; and in Your fear I will worship toward Your holy temple.

verses.kjv: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.
verses.modern: Lead me, LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies — make Your way straight before me.

verses.kjv: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.
verses.modern: Not a word from their mouth can be trusted; their heart is filled with malice. Their throat is an open grave; with their tongues they tell lies.

verses.kjv: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.
verses.modern: Declare them guilty, O God! Let their intrigues be their downfall. Banish them for their many sins, for they have rebelled against You.

verses.kjv: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
verses.modern: But let all who take refuge in You be glad; let them ever sing for joy. Spread Your protection over them, that those who love Your name may rejoice in You.

verses.kjv: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.
verses.modern: Surely, LORD, You bless the righteous; you surround them with your favor as with a shield.

chapters.summary: The psalmist asks God to hear his morning prayer and lead him in righteousness. He contrasts the wicked, whose throats are open graves, with the righteous who take refuge in God and are surrounded by His favor as with a shield.

verses.kjv: O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
verses.modern: LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.

verses.kjv: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.
verses.modern: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am faint; heal me, LORD, for my bones are in agony.

verses.kjv: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?
verses.modern: My soul is in deep anguish. How long, LORD, how long?

verses.kjv: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.
verses.modern: Turn, LORD, and deliver me; save me because of Your mercy.

verses.kjv: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?
verses.modern: Among the dead no one proclaims your name. Who praises you from the grave?

verses.kjv: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
verses.modern: I am worn out from my groaning. All night long I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.

verses.kjv: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.
verses.modern: My eyes grow weak with sorrow; they fail because of all my foes.

verses.kjv: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.modern: Away from me, all You who do evil, for the LORD has heard my weeping.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.
verses.modern: The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.

verses.kjv: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.
verses.modern: All my enemies will be overwhelmed with shame and anguish; they will turn back and suddenly be put to shame.

chapters.summary: The psalmist pleads with the LORD not to rebuke him in anger, for his bones are troubled and his soul is greatly vexed. He begs God to return and save him for His mercy's sake, weeping on his bed every night.

verses.kjv: O LORD my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
verses.modern: LORD my God, I take refuge in You; save and deliver me from all who pursue me,

verses.kjv: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
verses.modern: or they will tear me apart like a lion and rip me to pieces with no one to rescue me.

verses.kjv: O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;
verses.modern: LORD my God, if I have done this and there is guilt on my hands —

verses.kjv: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)
verses.modern: if I have repaid my ally with evil or without cause have robbed my foe —

verses.kjv: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.
verses.modern: then let my enemy pursue and overtake me; let Him trample my life to the ground and make me sleep in the dust.

verses.kjv: Arise, O LORD, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.
verses.modern: Arise, LORD, in Your anger; rise up against the rage of my enemies. Awake, my God; decree justice.

verses.kjv: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.
verses.modern: Let the assembled peoples gather around You, while You sit enthroned over them on high.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall judge the people: judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.
verses.modern: Let the LORD judge the peoples. Vindicate me, LORD, according to my righteousness, according to my integrity, O Most High.

verses.kjv: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.
verses.modern: Bring to an end the violence of the wicked and make the righteous secure — you, the righteous God Who probes minds and hearts.

verses.kjv: My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.
verses.modern: My shield is God Most High, who saves the upright in heart.

verses.kjv: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.
verses.modern: God is a righteous judge, a God Who displays His wrath every day.

verses.kjv: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.
verses.modern: If a person does not repent, God will sharpen his sword; He will bend and string his bow.

verses.kjv: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.
verses.modern: He has prepared his deadly weapons; he makes ready his flaming arrows.

verses.kjv: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.
verses.modern: Whoever is pregnant with evil conceives trouble and gives birth to disillusionment.

verses.kjv: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.
verses.modern: Whoever digs a hole and scoops it out falls into the pit they have made.

verses.kjv: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
verses.modern: The trouble they cause recoils on them; their violence comes down on their own heads.

verses.kjv: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.
verses.modern: I will give thanks to the LORD because of His righteousness; I will sing the praises of the name of the LORD Most High.

chapters.summary: The psalmist takes refuge in the LORD from those who pursue him and asks God to arise in judgment. He declares that God is a righteous judge who tests hearts and reins, and gives thanks to the LORD Most High.

verses.kjv: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.
verses.modern: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth! You have set Your glory in the heavens.

verses.kjv: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
verses.modern: Through the praise of children and infants You have established a stronghold against Your enemies, to silence the foe and the avenger.

verses.kjv: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
verses.modern: When I consider Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place,

verses.kjv: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
verses.modern: what is man, that You are mindful of Him? And the son of man, that You visit Him?

verses.kjv: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.
verses.modern: For You have made Him a little lower than the angels and crowned Him with glory and honor.

verses.kjv: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:
verses.modern: You made Him to have dominion over the works of Your hands; You have put all things under His feet:

verses.kjv: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;
verses.modern: all flocks and herds, and the animals of the wild,

verses.kjv: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.
verses.modern: the birds in the sky, and the fish in the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.

verses.kjv: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!
verses.modern: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth!

chapters.summary: The psalmist marvels at the excellency of God's name in all the earth and asks what man is that God should be mindful of him. God has crowned man with glory and honour and given him dominion over the works of His hands.

verses.kjv: I will praise thee, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
verses.modern: I will give thanks to You, LORD, with all my heart; I will tell of all Your wonderful deeds.

verses.kjv: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
verses.modern: I will be glad and rejoice in You; I will sing the praises of Your name, O Most High.

verses.kjv: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.
verses.modern: My enemies turn back; they stumble and perish before You.

verses.kjv: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.
verses.modern: For You have upheld my right and my cause, sitting enthroned as the righteous judge.

verses.kjv: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
verses.modern: You have rebuked the nations and destroyed the wicked; you have blotted out their name for ever and ever.

verses.kjv: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.
verses.modern: Endless ruin has overtaken my enemies; you have uprooted their cities — even the memory of them has perished.

verses.kjv: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.
verses.modern: The LORD reigns forever; He has established His throne for judgment.

verses.kjv: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
verses.modern: He rules the world in righteousness and judges the peoples with equity.

verses.kjv: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
verses.modern: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.

verses.kjv: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
verses.modern: Those who know Your name trust in You, for You, LORD, have never forsaken those who seek You.

verses.kjv: Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.
verses.modern: Sing the praises of the LORD, enthroned in Zion; proclaim among the nations what he has done.

verses.kjv: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
verses.modern: For He who avenges blood remembers; he does not ignore the cries of the afflicted.

verses.kjv: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
verses.modern: LORD, see how my enemies persecute me! Have mercy and lift me up from the gates of death,

verses.kjv: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.
verses.modern: that I may show forth all Your praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion; I will rejoice in Your salvation.

verses.kjv: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
verses.modern: The nations have fallen into the pit they have dug; their feet are caught in the net they have hidden.

verses.kjv: The LORD is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
verses.modern: The LORD is known by His acts of justice; the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands.

verses.kjv: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.
verses.modern: The wicked go down to the hell, all the nations that forget God.

verses.kjv: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.
verses.modern: But God will never forget the needy; the hope of the afflicted will never perish.

verses.kjv: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
verses.modern: Arise, LORD; do not let man prevail; let the nations be judged in your sight.

verses.kjv: Put them in fear, O LORD: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.
verses.modern: Put them in fear, LORD, that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.

chapters.summary: The psalmist praises God with his whole heart and recounts how his enemies turned back and perished. He declares that the LORD reigns forever, judges the world in righteousness, and is a refuge for the oppressed in times of trouble.

verses.kjv: Why standest thou afar off, O LORD? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?
verses.modern: Why, LORD, do You stand far off? Why do You hide Yourself in times of trouble?

verses.kjv: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.
verses.modern: In his arrogance the wicked man hunts down the weak, who are caught in the schemes he devises.

verses.kjv: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the LORD abhorreth.
verses.modern: He boasts about the cravings of His heart; He blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD.

verses.kjv: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.
verses.modern: In his pride the wicked man does not seek him; in all his thoughts there is no room for God.

verses.kjv: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.
verses.modern: His ways are always prosperous; your laws are rejected by him; he sneers at all his enemies.

verses.kjv: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.
verses.modern: He says to himself, "Nothing will ever shake me." He swears, "No one will ever do me harm."

verses.kjv: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.
verses.modern: His mouth is full of lies and threats; trouble and evil are under his tongue.

verses.kjv: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.
verses.modern: He lies in wait near the villages; from ambush he murders the innocent. His eyes watch in secret for his victims;

verses.kjv: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.
verses.modern: like a lion in cover he lies in wait. He lies in wait to catch the helpless; he catches the helpless and drags them off in his net.

verses.kjv: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.
verses.modern: His victims are crushed, they collapse; they fall under his strength.

verses.kjv: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.
verses.modern: He says to himself, "God will never notice; He covers His face and never sees."

verses.kjv: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.
verses.modern: Arise, LORD! Lift up Your hand, O God. Do not forget the helpless.

verses.kjv: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.
verses.modern: Why does the wicked man revile God? Why does He say to himself, "He won't call me to account"?

verses.kjv: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.
verses.modern: But You, God, see the trouble of the afflicted; You consider their grief and take it in hand. The victims commit themselves to You; You are the helper of the fatherless.

verses.kjv: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.
verses.modern: Break the arm of the wicked man; call the evildoer to account for his wickedness that would not otherwise be found out.

verses.kjv: The LORD is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.
verses.modern: The LORD is King for ever and ever; the nations will perish from his land.

verses.kjv: LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:
verses.modern: You, LORD, hear the desire of the afflicted; You encourage them, and You listen to their cry,

verses.kjv: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.
verses.modern: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no longer oppress.

chapters.summary: The psalmist asks why the LORD stands far off while the wicked devour the poor. He describes the arrogant man who says in his heart that God has forgotten, then calls on the LORD to arise, break the arm of the wicked, and defend the fatherless and oppressed.

verses.kjv: In the LORD put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?
verses.modern: In the LORD I take refuge. How then can You say to me: "Flee like a bird to Your mountain.

verses.kjv: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.
verses.modern: For look, the wicked bend their bows; they set their arrows against the strings to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.

verses.kjv: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?
verses.modern: When the foundations are being destroyed, what can the righteous do?"

verses.kjv: The LORD is in his holy temple, the LORD'S throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
verses.modern: The LORD is in His holy temple; the LORD is on His heavenly throne. He observes everyone on earth; His eyes examine them.

verses.kjv: The LORD trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
verses.modern: The LORD examines the righteous, but the wicked, those who love violence, he hates with a passion.

verses.kjv: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.
verses.modern: On the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and a horrible tempest; this shall be the portion of their cup.

verses.kjv: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.
verses.modern: For the righteous LORD loves righteousness; His countenance does behold the upright.

chapters.summary: The psalmist declares his trust in the LORD when told to flee like a bird. He affirms that the LORD is in His holy temple, His eyes test the children of men, and He rains snares on the wicked while the righteous behold His face.

verses.kjv: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
verses.modern: Help, LORD, for the godly man ceases; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.

verses.kjv: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.
verses.modern: Everyone lies to their neighbor; they flatter with their lips but harbor deception in their hearts.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:
verses.modern: May the LORD silence all flattering lips and every boastful tongue —

verses.kjv: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?
verses.modern: those who say, "By our tongues we will prevail; our own lips will defend us — who is lord over us?"

verses.kjv: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.
verses.modern: "Because the poor are plundered and the needy groan, I will now arise," says the LORD. "I will protect them from those who malign them."

verses.kjv: The words of the LORD are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
verses.modern: the words of the LORD are flawless, like silver purified in a crucible, like gold refined seven times.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt keep them, O LORD, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.
verses.modern: You, LORD, will keep the needy safe and will protect us forever from the wicked,

verses.kjv: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.
verses.modern: The wicked walk on every side when the vilest men are exalted.

chapters.summary: The psalmist cries for help because the godly are vanishing and the faithful are failing among men. Liars and flatterers fill the earth, but the LORD promises to arise and protect the poor, for His words are pure as silver tried seven times.

verses.kjv: How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?
verses.modern: How long, LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?

verses.kjv: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
verses.modern: How long must I wrestle with my thoughts and day after day have sorrow in my heart? How long will my enemy triumph over me?

verses.kjv: Consider and hear me, O LORD my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;
verses.modern: Look on me and answer, LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, or I will sleep in death,

verses.kjv: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
verses.modern: my enemy will say, "I have overcome Him," and my foes will rejoice when I fall.

verses.kjv: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.
verses.modern: But I trust in Your mercy; my heart rejoices in Your salvation.

verses.kjv: I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
verses.modern: I will sing the LORD's praise, for He has been good to me.

chapters.summary: The psalmist cries "How long?" four times, pleading with the LORD not to forget him. He moves from desperate lament to trust in God's mercy and closes singing praise because the LORD has dealt bountifully with him.

verses.kjv: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.
verses.modern: The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, their deeds are vile; there is no one who does good.

verses.kjv: The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek God.
verses.modern: The LORD looks down from heaven on all mankind to see if there are any who understand, any who seek God.

verses.kjv: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.modern: All have turned away, all have become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.

verses.kjv: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.
verses.modern: Do all these evildoers know nothing? They devour my people as though eating bread; they never call on the LORD.

verses.kjv: There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.
verses.modern: But there they are, overwhelmed with dread, for God is present in the company of the righteous.

verses.kjv: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.
verses.modern: You evildoers frustrate the plans of the poor. But The LORD is their refuge.

verses.kjv: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
verses.modern: Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD restores His people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad!

chapters.summary: The psalmist declares that the fool says in his heart there is no God. The LORD looks down from heaven and finds that all have turned aside -- there is none that does good, not even one. He longs for the salvation of Israel to come out of Zion.

verses.kjv: LORD, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
verses.modern: LORD, who may dwell in Your sacred tent? Who may live on Your holy mountain?

verses.kjv: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.
verses.modern: The one whose walk is blameless, who does what is righteous, who speaks the truth from their heart;

verses.kjv: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.
verses.modern: whose tongue utters no slander, who does no wrong to a neighbor, and casts no slur on others;

verses.kjv: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the LORD. He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.
verses.modern: who despises a vile person but honors those who fear the LORD; who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and does not change their mind;

verses.kjv: He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.
verses.modern: who lends money to the poor without interest; who does not accept a bribe against the innocent. Whoever does these things will never be shaken.

chapters.summary: The psalmist asks who may dwell in the LORD's tabernacle and on His holy hill. The answer is the one who walks uprightly, speaks truth, does no evil to his neighbor, keeps his oath even when it hurts, and takes no bribe against the innocent.

verses.kjv: Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.
verses.modern: Keep me safe, my God, for in You I take refuge.

verses.kjv: O my soul, thou hast said unto the LORD, Thou art my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to thee;
verses.modern: I say to the LORD, "You are my Lord; apart from You I have no good thing."

verses.kjv: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.
verses.modern: I say of the holy people who are in the land, "They are the noble ones in whom is all my delight."

verses.kjv: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.
verses.modern: Those who run after other gods will suffer more and more. I will not pour out libations of blood to such gods or take up their names on my lips.

verses.kjv: The LORD is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.
verses.modern: LORD, You alone are my portion and my cup; You make my lot secure.

verses.kjv: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
verses.modern: The boundary lines have fallen for me in pleasant places; surely I have a delightful inheritance.

verses.kjv: I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.
verses.modern: I will praise the LORD, Who counsels me; even at night my heart instructs me.

verses.kjv: I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
verses.modern: I keep my eyes always on the LORD. With Him at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

verses.kjv: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.
verses.modern: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will rest secure,

verses.kjv: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
verses.modern: For You will not leave my soul in hell; neither will You allow Your Holy One to see corruption.

verses.kjv: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
verses.modern: You make known to me the path of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.

chapters.summary: The psalmist trusts God as his refuge and portion, declaring that the LORD is always at his right hand. He rejoices that God will not leave his soul in hell nor allow His Holy One to see corruption -- a psalm the apostles applied directly to the resurrection of Christ.

verses.kjv: Hear the right, O LORD, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.
verses.modern: Hear me, LORD, my plea is just; listen to my cry. Hear my prayer — it does not rise from deceitful lips.

verses.kjv: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.
verses.modern: Let my vindication come from You; may Your eyes see what is right.

verses.kjv: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited me in the night; thou hast tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.
verses.modern: Though You probe my heart, though You examine me at night and test me, You will find that I have planned no evil; my mouth has not transgressed.

verses.kjv: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.
verses.modern: As for what others do — by the word of Your lips I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.

verses.kjv: Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not.
verses.modern: My steps have held to Your paths; my feet have not stumbled.

verses.kjv: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.
verses.modern: I call on You, my God, for You will answer me; turn Your ear to me and hear my prayer.

verses.kjv: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee from those that rise up against them.
verses.modern: Show Your marvellous lovingkindness, O You who save by Your right hand those who put their trust in You from those who rise up against them.

verses.kjv: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
verses.modern: Keep me as the apple of Your eye; hide me in the shadow of Your wings

verses.kjv: From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.
verses.modern: from the wicked who are out to destroy me, from my mortal enemies who surround me.

verses.kjv: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.
verses.modern: They close up their callous hearts. Their mouths speak with arrogance.

verses.kjv: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;
verses.modern: They have tracked me down, they now surround me, with eyes alert, to throw me to the ground.

verses.kjv: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
verses.modern: They are like a lion hungry for prey, like a fierce lion crouching in cover.

verses.kjv: Arise, O LORD, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:
verses.modern: Rise up, LORD, confront them, bring them down; with Your sword rescue me from the wicked.

verses.kjv: From men which are thy hand, O LORD, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.
verses.modern: By Your hand save me from such people, LORD, from those of this world whose reward is in this life. May what You have stored up for the wicked fill their bellies; may their children gorge themselves on it, and may there be leftovers for their little ones.

verses.kjv: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.
verses.modern: As for me, I will be vindicated and will see Your face; when I awake, I will be satisfied with seeing Your likeness.

chapters.summary: The psalmist pleads for the LORD to hear his righteous cause and examine his heart. He prays for deliverance from the wicked who surround him like a lion crouching to spring, and asks God to arise, confront them, and satisfy him with His likeness when he awakes.

verses.kjv: I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.
verses.modern: I love You, LORD, my strength.

verses.kjv: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
verses.modern: The LORD is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer; my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.

verses.kjv: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
verses.modern: I called to the LORD, Who is worthy of praise. I have been saved from my enemies.

verses.kjv: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.
verses.modern: The cords of death entangled me; the torrents of destruction overwhelmed me.

verses.kjv: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.
verses.modern: The cords of the grave coiled around me; the snares of death confronted me.

verses.kjv: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.
verses.modern: In my distress I called to the LORD; I cried to my God for help. From His temple He heard my voice; my cry came before Him, into His ears.

verses.kjv: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.
verses.modern: The earth trembled and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains shook; they trembled because He was angry.

verses.kjv: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
verses.modern: Smoke rose from his nostrils; consuming fire came from His mouth, burning coals blazed out of it.

verses.kjv: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.
verses.modern: He parted the heavens and came down; dark clouds were under His feet.

verses.kjv: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.
verses.modern: He mounted the cherubim and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.

verses.kjv: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.
verses.modern: He made darkness His covering, His canopy around Him — the dark rain clouds of the sky.

verses.kjv: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.
verses.modern: Out of the brightness of His presence clouds advanced, with hailstones and bolts of lightning.

verses.kjv: The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.
verses.modern: The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.

verses.kjv: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.
verses.modern: He shot his arrows and scattered the enemy, with great bolts of lightning he routed them.

verses.kjv: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.
verses.modern: The valleys of the sea were exposed and the foundations of the earth laid bare at Your rebuke, LORD, at the blast of breath from Your nostrils.

verses.kjv: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.
verses.modern: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.

verses.kjv: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.
verses.modern: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from my foes, who were too strong for me.

verses.kjv: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.
verses.modern: They confronted me in the day of my disaster. But The LORD was my support.

verses.kjv: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.modern: He brought me out into a spacious place; He rescued me because He delighted in me.

verses.kjv: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
verses.modern: The LORD has dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands He has rewarded me.

verses.kjv: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.modern: For I have kept the ways of the LORD; I am not guilty of turning from my God.

verses.kjv: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.
verses.modern: All His laws are before me; I have not turned away from His decrees.

verses.kjv: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.
verses.modern: I have been blameless before Him and have kept myself from sin.

verses.kjv: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
verses.modern: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in His sight.

verses.kjv: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;
verses.modern: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless,

verses.kjv: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.
verses.modern: to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the devious You show Yourself shrewd.

verses.kjv: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.
verses.modern: You save the humble but bring low those whose eyes are haughty.

verses.kjv: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.
verses.modern: You, LORD, keep my lamp burning; my God turns my darkness into light.

verses.kjv: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.
verses.modern: With Your help I can advance against a troop; with my God I can scale a wall.

verses.kjv: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.
verses.modern: As for God, His way is perfect: the LORD's word is flawless; He shields all who take refuge in Him.

verses.kjv: For who is God save the LORD? or who is a rock save our God?
verses.modern: For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?

verses.kjv: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.
verses.modern: It is God Who arms me with strength and keeps my way secure.

verses.kjv: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet, and setteth me upon my high places.
verses.modern: He makes my feet like the feet of a deer; He causes me to stand on the heights.

verses.kjv: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
verses.modern: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

verses.kjv: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.
verses.modern: You make Your saving help my shield, and Your right hand sustains me; Your help has made me great.

verses.kjv: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.
verses.modern: You provide a broad path for my feet, so that my ankles do not give way.

verses.kjv: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.
verses.modern: I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I did not turn back till they were destroyed.

verses.kjv: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.
verses.modern: I crushed them so that they could not rise; they fell beneath my feet.

verses.kjv: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
verses.modern: You armed me with strength for battle; You humbled my adversaries before me.

verses.kjv: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.
verses.modern: You made my enemies turn their backs in flight. I destroyed my foes.

verses.kjv: They cried, but there was none to save them: even unto the LORD, but he answered them not.
verses.modern: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them — to the LORD. But He did not answer.

verses.kjv: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.
verses.modern: I beat them as fine as windblown dust; I trampled them like mud in the streets.

verses.kjv: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.
verses.modern: You have delivered me from the attacks of the people; you have made me the head of nations. People I did not know now serve me,

verses.kjv: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.
verses.modern: foreigners cower before me; as soon as they hear of me, they obey me.

verses.kjv: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.
verses.modern: They all lose heart; they come trembling from their strongholds.

verses.kjv: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.
verses.modern: The LORD lives! Praise be to my Rock! Exalted be God my Savior!

verses.kjv: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.
verses.modern: He is the God Who avenges me, who subdues nations under me,

verses.kjv: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
verses.modern: who saves me from my enemies. You exalted me above my foes; from a violent man You rescued me.

verses.kjv: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.
verses.modern: Therefore I will praise You, LORD, among the nations; I will sing the praises of your name.

verses.kjv: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.
verses.modern: He gives his king great victories; he shows mercy to his anointed, to David and to his descendants forever.

chapters.summary: The psalmist praises the LORD as his rock, fortress, and deliverer after being rescued from all his enemies. He recounts how God shook the earth, parted the heavens, and rode on a cherub to save him, and declares that the LORD lives and is worthy to be praised among the nations.

verses.kjv: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
verses.modern: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of His hands.

verses.kjv: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.
verses.modern: Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they reveal knowledge.

verses.kjv: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
verses.modern: They have no speech, they use no words; no sound is heard from them.

verses.kjv: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,
verses.modern: Yet their voice goes out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world. In the heavens God has pitched a tent for the sun.

verses.kjv: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.
verses.modern: It is like a bridegroom coming out of His chamber, like a champion rejoicing to run His course.

verses.kjv: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
verses.modern: It rises at one end of the heavens and makes its circuit to the other; nothing is deprived of its warmth.

verses.kjv: The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.
verses.modern: The law of the LORD is perfect, refreshing the soul. The statutes of the LORD are trustworthy, making wise the simple.

verses.kjv: The statutes of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.
verses.modern: The precepts of the LORD are right, giving joy to the heart. The commands of the LORD are radiant, giving light to the eyes.

verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD are true and righteous altogether.
verses.modern: The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever. The decrees of the LORD are firm. All of them are righteous.

verses.kjv: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
verses.modern: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the honeycomb.

verses.kjv: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.
verses.modern: By them Your servant is warned; in keeping them there is great reward.

verses.kjv: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.
verses.modern: But who can discern their own errors? Forgive my hidden faults.

verses.kjv: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
verses.modern: Keep Your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then I will be blameless, innocent of great transgression.

verses.kjv: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.
verses.modern: May these words of my mouth and this meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.

chapters.summary: The psalmist declares that the heavens proclaim God's glory and the skies display His handiwork. He then celebrates the perfection of the LORD's law, which revives the soul and makes wise the simple, and prays to be kept from presumptuous sins.

verses.kjv: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;
verses.modern: May the LORD answer You when You are in distress; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.

verses.kjv: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;
verses.modern: May He send You help from the sanctuary and grant You support from Zion.

verses.kjv: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.
verses.modern: May He remember all Your sacrifices and accept Your burnt offerings.

verses.kjv: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.
verses.modern: May He give You the desire of Your heart and make all Your plans succeed.

verses.kjv: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.
verses.modern: May we shout for joy over Your victory and lift up our banners in the name of our God. May the LORD grant all Your requests.

verses.kjv: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.
verses.modern: Now this I know: the LORD gives victory to His anointed. He answers Him from His heavenly sanctuary with the victorious power of His right hand.

verses.kjv: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.
verses.modern: Some trust in chariots and some in horses. But We trust in the name of the LORD our God.

verses.kjv: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.
verses.modern: They are brought to their knees and fall. But We rise up and stand firm.

verses.kjv: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.
verses.modern: LORD, give victory to the king! Answer us when we call!

chapters.summary: The people pray for the king before battle, asking the LORD to send him help from Zion and grant him victory. They declare that some trust in chariots and some in horses, but they will remember the name of the LORD their God.

verses.kjv: The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
verses.modern: The king rejoices in your strength, LORD. How great is His joy in the victories You give!

verses.kjv: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.
verses.modern: You have granted Him His heart's desire and have not withheld the request of His lips.

verses.kjv: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.
verses.modern: You came to greet Him with rich blessings and placed a crown of pure gold on His head.

verses.kjv: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.
verses.modern: He asked You for life, and You gave it to Him — length of days, for ever and ever.

verses.kjv: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.
verses.modern: Through the victories You gave, His glory is great; You have bestowed on Him splendor and majesty.

verses.kjv: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.
verses.modern: For You have made Him most blessed forever; You have made Him exceedingly glad with Your countenance.

verses.kjv: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.
verses.modern: For the king trusts in the LORD; through the mercy of the Most High He will not be shaken.

verses.kjv: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.
verses.modern: Your hand will lay hold on all Your enemies; Your right hand will seize Your foes.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.
verses.modern: When You appear for battle, You will burn them up as in a blazing furnace. The LORD will swallow them up in His wrath. His fire will consume them.

verses.kjv: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
verses.modern: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from mankind.

verses.kjv: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.
verses.modern: Though they plot evil against You and devise wicked schemes, they cannot succeed.

verses.kjv: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.
verses.modern: You will make them turn their backs when You aim at them with drawn bow.

verses.kjv: Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.
verses.modern: Be exalted in Your strength, LORD; we will sing and praise Your might.

chapters.summary: The king rejoices in the LORD's strength and the victories God has given him. The psalm celebrates God's blessings on the king -- life, honor, and a crown of gold -- and prophesies the destruction of all the king's enemies by the hand of the LORD.

verses.kjv: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?
verses.modern: My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? Why are You so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?

verses.kjv: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.
verses.modern: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but You hear not; and in the night season, and am not silent.

verses.kjv: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.
verses.modern: Yet You are enthroned as the Holy One; You are the one Israel praises.

verses.kjv: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.
verses.modern: Our fathers trusted in You; they trusted, and You delivered them.

verses.kjv: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.
verses.modern: To You they cried out and were saved; in You they trusted and were not put to shame.

verses.kjv: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.
verses.modern: But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by everyone, despised by the people.

verses.kjv: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,
verses.modern: All who see me mock me; they hurl insults, shaking their heads.

verses.kjv: He trusted on the LORD that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.
verses.modern: "He trusts in the LORD," they say, "let the LORD rescue Him. Let Him deliver Him, since He delights in Him."

verses.kjv: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother's breasts.
verses.modern: Yet You brought me out of the womb; You made me trust in You, even at my mother's breast.

verses.kjv: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother's belly.
verses.modern: From birth I was cast on You; from my mother's womb You have been my God.

verses.kjv: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.
verses.modern: Do not be far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.

verses.kjv: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
verses.modern: Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.

verses.kjv: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.
verses.modern: Roaring lions that tear their prey open their mouths wide against me.

verses.kjv: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.
verses.modern: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart has turned to wax; it has melted within me.

verses.kjv: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.
verses.modern: My mouth is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth; You lay me in the dust of death.

verses.kjv: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.
verses.modern: Dogs surround me, a pack of villains encircles me; they pierce my hands and my feet.

verses.kjv: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.
verses.modern: All my bones are on display; people stare and gloat over me.

verses.kjv: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
verses.modern: They divide my clothes among them and cast lots for my garment.

verses.kjv: But be not thou far from me, O LORD: O my strength, haste thee to help me.
verses.modern: But You, LORD, do not be far from me. You are my strength; come quickly to help me.

verses.kjv: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.
verses.modern: Deliver me from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dogs.

verses.kjv: Save me from the lion's mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.
verses.modern: Save me from the lion's mouth; for You have heard me from the horns of the unicorns.

verses.kjv: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.
verses.modern: I will declare Your name to my people; in the assembly I will praise You.

verses.kjv: Ye that fear the LORD, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.
verses.modern: You who fear the LORD, praise Him! All You descendants of Jacob, honor him! Revere him, all you descendants of Israel!

verses.kjv: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hidden his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.
verses.modern: For He has not despised or scorned the suffering of the afflicted one; He has not hidden His face from Him but has listened to His cry for help.

verses.kjv: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
verses.modern: From You comes the theme of my praise in the great assembly; before those who fear You I will fulfill my vows.

verses.kjv: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the LORD that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.
verses.modern: The poor will eat and be satisfied; those who seek the LORD will praise Him — may Your hearts live forever!

verses.kjv: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the LORD: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.
verses.modern: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before him,

verses.kjv: For the kingdom is the LORD'S: and he is the governor among the nations.
verses.modern: for dominion belongs to the LORD and He rules over the nations.

verses.kjv: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.
verses.modern: All the rich of the earth will feast and worship; all who go down to the dust will kneel before Him — those who cannot keep themselves alive.

verses.kjv: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.
verses.modern: Posterity will serve Him; future generations will be told about the Lord.

verses.kjv: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.
verses.modern: They will proclaim His righteousness, declaring to a people yet unborn: He has done it!

chapters.summary: The psalmist cries out "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?" and describes pierced hands and feet, bones out of joint, and enemies casting lots for his garments -- a prophetic portrait of the crucifixion. He vows that all the ends of the earth will turn to the LORD.

verses.kjv: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
verses.modern: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

verses.kjv: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
verses.modern: He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside the still waters.

verses.kjv: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
verses.modern: He restores my soul; He leads me in the paths of righteousness for His name's sake.

verses.kjv: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
verses.modern: Yes, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.

verses.kjv: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
verses.modern: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; You anoint my head with oil; my cup runs over.

verses.kjv: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
verses.modern: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.

chapters.summary: The psalmist declares the LORD is his shepherd and he shall not want. God leads him beside still waters, restores his soul, prepares a table before his enemies, and anoints his head with oil -- goodness and mercy shall follow him all the days of his life.

verses.kjv: The earth is the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.modern: The earth is the LORD's, and everything in it, the world. All who live in it;

verses.kjv: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.
verses.modern: for He founded it on the seas and established it on the waters.

verses.kjv: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place?
verses.modern: Who may ascend the mountain of the LORD? Who may stand in His holy place?

verses.kjv: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.
verses.modern: The one who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not trust in an idol or swear by a false god.

verses.kjv: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verses.modern: They will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from God their Savior.

verses.kjv: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.
verses.modern: Such is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face, God of Jacob.

verses.kjv: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
verses.modern: Lift up Your heads, You gates; be lifted up, You ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in.

verses.kjv: Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
verses.modern: Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

verses.kjv: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
verses.modern: Lift up Your heads, You gates; lift them up, You ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in.

verses.kjv: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.
verses.modern: Who is He, this King of glory? The LORD of hosts — He is the King of glory. Selah.

chapters.summary: The psalmist declares that the earth is the LORD's and all that is in it. He asks who may ascend the hill of the LORD and answers: the one with clean hands and a pure heart. The psalm calls for the everlasting doors to be lifted up so the King of glory may come in.

verses.kjv: Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.
verses.modern: To You, LORD, I lift up my soul.

verses.kjv: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.
verses.modern: I trust in You; do not let me be put to shame, nor let my enemies triumph over me.

verses.kjv: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.
verses.modern: No one who hopes in you will ever be put to shame, but shame will come on those who are treacherous without cause.

verses.kjv: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.
verses.modern: Show me Your ways, LORD, teach me Your paths.

verses.kjv: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.
verses.modern: Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are God my Savior, and my hope is in You all day long.

verses.kjv: Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.
verses.modern: Remember, LORD, Your tender mercies and Your lovingkindnesses, for they have been ever of old.

verses.kjv: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O LORD.
verses.modern: Do not remember the sins of my youth or my transgressions; according to Your mercy remember me, for Your goodness' sake, O LORD.

verses.kjv: Good and upright is the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.
verses.modern: Good and upright is the LORD; therefore He instructs sinners in His ways.

verses.kjv: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.
verses.modern: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them His way.

verses.kjv: All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.modern: All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth to such as keep His covenant and His testimonies.

verses.kjv: For thy name's sake, O LORD, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.
verses.modern: For the sake of Your name, LORD, forgive my iniquity, though it is great.

verses.kjv: What man is he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.
verses.modern: Who, then, are those who fear the LORD? He will instruct them in the ways they should choose.

verses.kjv: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.
verses.modern: They will spend their days in prosperity. Their descendants will inherit the land.

verses.kjv: The secret of the LORD is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.
verses.modern: The LORD confides in those who fear Him; He makes His covenant known to them.

verses.kjv: Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.modern: My eyes are ever on the LORD, for only He will release my feet from the snare.

verses.kjv: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.
verses.modern: Turn to me and be gracious to me, for I am lonely and afflicted.

verses.kjv: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.
verses.modern: Relieve the troubles of my heart and free me from my anguish.

verses.kjv: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.
verses.modern: Look on my affliction and my distress and take away all my sins.

verses.kjv: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.
verses.modern: See how numerous are my enemies and how fiercely they hate me!

verses.kjv: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.
verses.modern: Guard my life and rescue me; do not let me be put to shame, for I take refuge in You.

verses.kjv: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.
verses.modern: May integrity and uprightness protect me, because my hope, LORD, is in You.

verses.kjv: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
verses.modern: Deliver Israel, O God, from all their troubles!

chapters.summary: The psalmist lifts his soul to the LORD and asks to be taught God's paths and led in truth. He pleads for mercy, forgiveness, and deliverance, confessing his loneliness and affliction and trusting that the LORD will redeem Israel out of all his troubles.

verses.kjv: Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD; therefore I shall not slide.
verses.modern: Vindicate me, LORD, for I have led a blameless life; I have trusted in the LORD and have not faltered.

verses.kjv: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.
verses.modern: Test me, LORD, and try me, examine my heart and my mind;

verses.kjv: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.
verses.modern: for I have always been mindful of Your mercy and have lived in reliance on Your faithfulness.

verses.kjv: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.
verses.modern: I do not sit with the deceitful, nor do I associate with hypocrites.

verses.kjv: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.
verses.modern: I abhor the assembly of evildoers and refuse to sit with the wicked.

verses.kjv: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O LORD:
verses.modern: I wash my hands in innocence, and go about Your altar, LORD,

verses.kjv: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.
verses.modern: proclaiming aloud Your praise and telling of all Your wonderful deeds.

verses.kjv: LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.
verses.modern: LORD, I love the house where You live, the place where Your glory dwells.

verses.kjv: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:
verses.modern: Do not take away my soul along with sinners, my life with those who are bloodthirsty,

verses.kjv: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.
verses.modern: in whose hands are wicked schemes, whose right hands are full of bribes.

verses.kjv: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.
verses.modern: I lead a blameless life; deliver me and be merciful to me.
