verses.kjv: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD.
verses.modern: My feet stand on level ground; in the great assembly I will praise the LORD.

chapters.summary: The psalmist asks the LORD to judge him, declaring that he has walked in integrity and has not sat with vain persons or dissemblers. He loves the habitation of God's house and asks to be gathered not with sinners but redeemed by mercy.

verses.kjv: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
verses.modern: The LORD is my light and my salvation — whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life — of whom shall I be afraid?

verses.kjv: When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.
verses.modern: When the wicked advance against me to devour me, it is my enemies and my foes who will stumble and fall.

verses.kjv: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.
verses.modern: Though an army besiege me, my heart will not fear; though war break out against me, even then I will be confident.

verses.kjv: One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple.
verses.modern: One thing I ask from the LORD, this only do I seek: that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and to seek Him in His temple.

verses.kjv: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.
verses.modern: For in the day of trouble He will keep me safe in His dwelling; He will hide me in the shelter of His sacred tent and set me high upon a rock.

verses.kjv: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD.
verses.modern: Then my head will be exalted above the enemies who surround me; at His sacred tent I will sacrifice with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Hear, O LORD, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.
verses.modern: Hear my voice when I call, LORD; be merciful to me and answer me.

verses.kjv: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek.
verses.modern: My heart says of You, "Seek His face!" Your face, LORD, I will seek.

verses.kjv: Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.
verses.modern: Do not hide Your face from me, do not turn Your servant away in anger; You have been my help. Do not reject me or forsake me, God my Savior.

verses.kjv: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.
verses.modern: Though my father and mother forsake me, the LORD will receive me.

verses.kjv: Teach me thy way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.
verses.modern: Teach me Your way, LORD; lead me in a straight path because of my oppressors.

verses.kjv: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.
verses.modern: Do not turn me over to the desire of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, spouting malicious accusations.

verses.kjv: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
verses.modern: I remain confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

verses.kjv: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.
verses.modern: Wait for the LORD; be strong and take heart and wait for the LORD.

chapters.summary: The psalmist declares the LORD is his light and salvation and asks whom he shall fear. He desires one thing above all -- to dwell in the house of the LORD forever. Though father and mother forsake him, the LORD will take him up, and he resolves to wait on the LORD and be of good courage.

verses.kjv: Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
verses.modern: To You, LORD, I call; You are my Rock, do not turn a deaf ear to me. For if You remain silent, I will be like those who go down to the pit.

verses.kjv: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.
verses.modern: Hear the voice of my supplications when I cry to You, when I lift up my hands toward Your holy oracle.

verses.kjv: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.
verses.modern: Do not drag me away with the wicked, with those who do evil, who speak cordially with their neighbors but harbor malice in their hearts.

verses.kjv: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.
verses.modern: Repay them for their deeds and for their evil work; repay them for what their hands have done and bring back on them what they deserve.

verses.kjv: Because they regard not the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.
verses.modern: Because they have no regard for the deeds of the LORD and what His hands have done, He will tear them down and never build them up again.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.
verses.modern: Praise be to the LORD, for He has heard my cry for mercy.

verses.kjv: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
verses.modern: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him. He helps me. My heart leaps for joy, and with my song I praise Him.

verses.kjv: The LORD is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.
verses.modern: The LORD is their strength, and He is the saving strength of His anointed.

verses.kjv: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.
verses.modern: Save Your people and bless Your inheritance; be their shepherd and carry them forever.

chapters.summary: The psalmist cries to the LORD his rock, pleading not to be drawn away with the wicked who speak peace to their neighbors but have mischief in their hearts. He blesses the LORD who has heard his supplications and become his strength and shield.

verses.kjv: Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
verses.modern: Give to the LORD, O You mighty, give to the LORD glory and strength.

verses.kjv: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
verses.modern: Give to the LORD the glory due to His name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

verses.kjv: The voice of the LORD is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the LORD is upon many waters.
verses.modern: The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders, the LORD thunders over the mighty waters.

verses.kjv: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is full of majesty.
verses.modern: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.

verses.kjv: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.modern: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.kjv: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.
verses.modern: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.

verses.kjv: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.
verses.modern: The voice of the LORD strikes with flashes of lightning.

verses.kjv: The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.modern: The voice of the LORD shakes the desert; the LORD shakes the Desert of Kadesh.

verses.kjv: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.
verses.modern: The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in His temple all cry, "Glory!"

verses.kjv: The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.
verses.modern: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.

verses.kjv: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.
verses.modern: The LORD gives strength to His people; the LORD blesses His people with peace.

chapters.summary: The psalmist calls the mighty to give the LORD glory and strength. The voice of the LORD thunders over the waters, breaks the cedars of Lebanon, shakes the wilderness, and strips the forests bare -- and in His temple everything declares His glory.

verses.kjv: I will extol thee, O LORD; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
verses.modern: I will exalt You, LORD, for You lifted me out of the depths and did not let my enemies gloat over me.

verses.kjv: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
verses.modern: LORD my God, I called to You for help, and You healed me.

verses.kjv: O LORD, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
verses.modern: LORD, You have brought up my soul from the grave; You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

verses.kjv: Sing unto the LORD, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.modern: Sing to the LORD, O You saints of His, and give thanks at the remembrance of His holiness.

verses.kjv: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
verses.modern: For His anger lasts only a moment. But His favor lasts a lifetime; weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.

verses.kjv: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
verses.modern: When I felt secure, I said, "I will never be shaken."

verses.kjv: LORD, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.
verses.modern: LORD, when You favored me, You made my royal mountain stand firm; but when You hid Your face, I was dismayed.

verses.kjv: I cried to thee, O LORD; and unto the LORD I made supplication.
verses.modern: To You, LORD, I called; to the Lord I cried for mercy:

verses.kjv: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?
verses.modern: "What is gained if I am silenced, if I go down to the pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it proclaim Your faithfulness?

verses.kjv: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.
verses.modern: Hear, LORD, and be merciful to me; LORD, be my help."

verses.kjv: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
verses.modern: You turned my wailing into dancing; You removed my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,

verses.kjv: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
verses.modern: that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent. LORD my God, I will praise You forever.

chapters.summary: The psalmist praises the LORD for lifting him from the depths and healing him. He testifies that God's anger lasts a moment but His favor lasts a lifetime: weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning.

verses.kjv: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.
verses.modern: In You, LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; deliver me in Your righteousness.

verses.kjv: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.
verses.modern: Turn Your ear to me, come quickly to my rescue; be my rock of refuge, a strong fortress to save me.

verses.kjv: For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.
verses.modern: Since You are my rock and my fortress, for the sake of Your name lead and guide me.

verses.kjv: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.
verses.modern: Keep me free from the trap that is set for me, for You are my refuge.

verses.kjv: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.
verses.modern: Into Your hands I commit my spirit; deliver me, LORD, my faithful God.

verses.kjv: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.
verses.modern: I hate those who cling to worthless idols; as for me, I trust in the LORD.

verses.kjv: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;
verses.modern: I will be glad and rejoice in Your mercy, for You have considered my trouble; You have known my soul in adversities.

verses.kjv: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.
verses.modern: You have not given me into the hands of the enemy but have set my feet in a spacious place.

verses.kjv: Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.
verses.modern: Be merciful to me, LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes grow weak with sorrow, my soul and body with grief.

verses.kjv: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.
verses.modern: My life is consumed by anguish and my years by groaning; my strength fails because of my affliction, and my bones grow weak.

verses.kjv: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.
verses.modern: Because of all my enemies, I am the utter contempt of my neighbors and an object of dread to my closest friends — those who see me on the street flee from me.

verses.kjv: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.
verses.modern: I am forgotten as though I were dead; I have become like broken pottery.

verses.kjv: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.
verses.modern: For I hear many whispering, "Terror on every side!" They conspire against me and plot to take my life.

verses.kjv: But I trusted in thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my God.
verses.modern: But I trust in You, LORD; I say, "You are my God."

verses.kjv: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
verses.modern: My times are in Your hands; deliver me from the hands of my enemies, from those who pursue me.

verses.kjv: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies' sake.
verses.modern: Let Your face shine on Your servant; save me in Your mercy.

verses.kjv: Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.
verses.modern: Let me not be ashamed, LORD, for I have called on You; let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.

verses.kjv: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
verses.modern: Let their lying lips be silenced, for with pride and contempt they speak arrogantly against the righteous.

verses.kjv: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!
verses.modern: How abundant are the good things that You have stored up for those who fear You, that You bestow in the sight of all, on those who take refuge in You.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
verses.modern: You shall hide them in the secret of Your presence from the pride of man; You shall keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.
verses.modern: Blessed be the LORD, for He has shown me His marvellous kindness in a strong city.

verses.kjv: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.
verses.modern: In my alarm I said, "I am cut off from Your sight!" Yet You heard my cry for mercy when I called to You for help.

verses.kjv: O love the LORD, all ye his saints: for the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.
verses.modern: O love the LORD, all You His saints! For the LORD preserves the faithful, and plentifully rewards the proud doer.

verses.kjv: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.
verses.modern: Be strong and take heart, all You who hope in the LORD.

chapters.summary: The psalmist takes refuge in the LORD and commits his spirit into God's hands. He describes being forgotten like a dead man out of mind while enemies conspire against him, yet he trusts in the LORD's goodness and urges all the saints to love God and be of good courage.

verses.kjv: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
verses.modern: Blessed is the one whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

verses.kjv: Blessed is the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.
verses.modern: Blessed is the one whose sin the LORD does not count against them and in whose spirit is no deceit.

verses.kjv: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.
verses.modern: When I kept silent, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

verses.kjv: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
verses.modern: For day and night Your hand was heavy on me; my strength was sapped as in the heat of summer.

verses.kjv: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
verses.modern: Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not cover up my iniquity. I said, "I will confess my transgressions to the LORD." And You forgave the guilt of my sin.

verses.kjv: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.
verses.modern: Therefore let all the faithful pray to You while You may be found; surely the rising of the mighty waters will not reach them.

verses.kjv: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
verses.modern: You are my hiding place; You will protect me from trouble and surround me with songs of deliverance.

verses.kjv: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
verses.modern: I will instruct You and teach You in the way You should go; I will counsel You with my loving eye on You.

verses.kjv: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.
verses.modern: Do not be like the horse or the mule, which have no understanding but must be controlled by bit and bridle or they will not come to You.

verses.kjv: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy shall compass him about.
verses.modern: Many are the woes of the wicked. But The LORD's mercy surrounds the one who trusts in him.

verses.kjv: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.
verses.modern: Rejoice in the LORD and be glad, You righteous; sing, all You who are upright in heart!

chapters.summary: The psalmist declares blessed the man whose transgression is forgiven and whose sin is covered. He confesses that when he kept silent his bones wasted away, but when he acknowledged his sin the LORD forgave the iniquity of his heart. He calls the righteous to rejoice and shout for joy.

verses.kjv: Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.
verses.modern: Sing joyfully to the LORD, You righteous; it is fitting for the upright to praise Him.

verses.kjv: Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.
verses.modern: Praise the LORD with the harp; make music to Him on the ten-stringed lyre.

verses.kjv: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.
verses.modern: Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully, and shout for joy.

verses.kjv: For the word of the LORD is right; and all his works are done in truth.
verses.modern: For the word of the LORD is right and true; He is faithful in all He does.

verses.kjv: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.
verses.modern: He loves righteousness and judgment; the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.

verses.kjv: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
verses.modern: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, their starry host by the breath of His mouth.

verses.kjv: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.
verses.modern: He gathers the waters of the sea into jars; He puts the deep into storehouses.

verses.kjv: Let all the earth fear the LORD: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
verses.modern: Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the people of the world revere him.

verses.kjv: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.
verses.modern: For He spoke. It came to be; He commanded. It stood firm.

verses.kjv: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.
verses.modern: The LORD foils the plans of the nations; he thwarts the purposes of the peoples.

verses.kjv: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
verses.modern: But the plans of the LORD stand firm forever, the purposes of His heart through all generations.

verses.kjv: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.
verses.modern: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people he chose for his inheritance.

verses.kjv: The LORD looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.
verses.modern: From heaven the LORD looks down and sees all mankind;

verses.kjv: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.modern: from His dwelling place He watches all who live on earth —

verses.kjv: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.
verses.modern: he who forms the hearts of all, who considers everything they do.

verses.kjv: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.
verses.modern: No king is saved by the size of His army; no warrior escapes by His great strength.

verses.kjv: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.
verses.modern: A horse is a vain hope for deliverance; despite all its great strength it cannot save.

verses.kjv: Behold, the eye of the LORD is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;
verses.modern: But the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear Him, on those whose hope is in His mercy,

verses.kjv: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
verses.modern: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.

verses.kjv: Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he is our help and our shield.
verses.modern: We wait in hope for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.

verses.kjv: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
verses.modern: In Him our hearts rejoice, for we trust in His holy name.

verses.kjv: Let thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.
verses.modern: May Your mercy be with us, LORD, even as we put our hope in You.

chapters.summary: The psalmist calls the righteous to praise the LORD with harp and new song. He celebrates God's word that made the heavens, His sovereignty that overrules the counsel of nations, and His watchful eye over those who fear Him and hope in His mercy.

verses.kjv: I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
verses.modern: I will extol the LORD at all times; His praise will always be on my lips.

verses.kjv: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.
verses.modern: I will glory in the LORD; let the afflicted hear and rejoice.

verses.kjv: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.
verses.modern: Glorify the LORD with me; let us exalt His name together.

verses.kjv: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
verses.modern: I sought the LORD. He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.

verses.kjv: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
verses.modern: Those who look to Him are radiant; their faces are never covered with shame.

verses.kjv: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.modern: This poor man called. The LORD heard Him; He saved Him out of all His troubles.

verses.kjv: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
verses.modern: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him. He delivers them.

verses.kjv: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
verses.modern: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the one who takes refuge in him.

verses.kjv: O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.
verses.modern: Fear the LORD, You His holy people, for those who fear Him lack nothing.

verses.kjv: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing.
verses.modern: The lions may grow weak and hungry, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.

verses.kjv: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
verses.modern: Come, my children, listen to me; I will teach You the fear of the LORD.

verses.kjv: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?
verses.modern: Whoever of you loves life and desires to see many good days,

verses.kjv: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.
verses.modern: keep Your tongue from evil and Your lips from telling lies;

verses.kjv: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.modern: turn from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.

verses.kjv: The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.
verses.modern: The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous. His ears are attentive to their cry;

verses.kjv: The face of the LORD is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
verses.modern: but the face of the LORD is against those who do evil, to blot out their name from the earth.

verses.kjv: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
verses.modern: The righteous cry out. The LORD hears them; He delivers them from all their troubles.

verses.kjv: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
verses.modern: The LORD is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.

verses.kjv: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.
verses.modern: The righteous person may have many troubles. But The LORD delivers Him from them all;

verses.kjv: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.
verses.modern: he protects all His bones, not one of them will be broken.

verses.kjv: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.
verses.modern: Evil will slay the wicked; the foes of the righteous will be condemned.

verses.kjv: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
verses.modern: The LORD will rescue His servants; no one who takes refuge in him will be condemned.

chapters.summary: The psalmist vows to bless the LORD at all times and invites the humble to magnify God with him. He testifies that the LORD delivers those who fear Him, that the angel of the LORD encamps around them, and that many are the afflictions of the righteous but the LORD delivers him out of them all.

verses.kjv: Plead my cause, O LORD, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.
verses.modern: Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me; fight against those who fight against me.

verses.kjv: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.
verses.modern: Take up shield and armor; arise and come to my aid.

verses.kjv: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.
verses.modern: Brandish spear and javelin against those who pursue me. Say to me, "I am Your salvation."

verses.kjv: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.
verses.modern: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plot my ruin be turned back in dismay.

verses.kjv: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase them.
verses.modern: May they be like chaff before the wind, with the angel of the LORD driving them away;

verses.kjv: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD persecute them.
verses.modern: may their path be dark and slippery, with the angel of the LORD pursuing them.

verses.kjv: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.
verses.modern: Since they hid their net for me without cause and without cause dug a pit for me,

verses.kjv: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.
verses.modern: may ruin overtake them by surprise — may the net they hid entangle them, may they fall into the pit, to their ruin.

verses.kjv: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.
verses.modern: Then my soul will rejoice in the LORD and delight in His salvation.

verses.kjv: All my bones shall say, LORD, who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?
verses.modern: My whole being will exclaim, "Who is like You, LORD? You rescue the poor from those too strong for them, the poor and needy from those who rob them."

verses.kjv: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.
verses.modern: Ruthless witnesses come forward; they question me on things I know nothing about.

verses.kjv: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.
verses.modern: They repay me evil for good and leave me like one bereaved.

verses.kjv: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.
verses.modern: Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth and humbled myself with fasting. When my prayers returned to me unanswered,

verses.kjv: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.
verses.modern: I went about mourning as though for my friend or brother. I bowed my head in grief as though weeping for my mother.

verses.kjv: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:
verses.modern: But when I stumbled, they gathered in glee; assailants gathered against me without my knowledge. They slandered me without ceasing.

verses.kjv: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
verses.modern: Like the ungodly they maliciously mocked; they gnashed their teeth at me.

verses.kjv: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.
verses.modern: How long, Lord, will You look on? Rescue me from their ravages, my precious life from these lions.

verses.kjv: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.
verses.modern: I will give You thanks in the great assembly; among the throngs I will praise You.

verses.kjv: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
verses.modern: Do not let those gloat over me who are my enemies without cause; do not let those who hate me without reason maliciously wink the eye.

verses.kjv: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.
verses.modern: They do not speak peaceably, but devise false accusations against those who live quietly in the land.

verses.kjv: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.
verses.modern: They sneer at me and say, "Aha! Aha! With our own eyes we have seen it."

verses.kjv: This thou hast seen, O LORD: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.
verses.modern: LORD, You have seen this; do not be silent. Do not be far from me, Lord.

verses.kjv: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.
verses.modern: Awake, and rise to my defense! Contend for me, my God and Lord.

verses.kjv: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.
verses.modern: Vindicate me in Your righteousness, LORD my God; do not let them gloat over me.

verses.kjv: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
verses.modern: Do not let them think, "Aha, just what we wanted!" or say, "We have swallowed Him up."

verses.kjv: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.
verses.modern: May all who gloat over my distress be put to shame and confusion; may all who exalt themselves over me be clothed with shame and disgrace.

verses.kjv: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.
verses.modern: May those who delight in my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, "The LORD be exalted, who delights in the well-being of His servant."

verses.kjv: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.
verses.modern: My tongue will proclaim Your righteousness, Your praises all day long.

chapters.summary: The psalmist calls on the LORD to take up shield and spear and fight against those who persecute him without cause. He describes false witnesses who repay his good with evil, and asks God to vindicate him and put his enemies to shame.

verses.kjv: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.modern: I have a message from God in my heart concerning the sinfulness of the wicked: there is no fear of God before their eyes.

verses.kjv: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.
verses.modern: In their own eyes they flatter themselves too much to detect or hate their sin.

verses.kjv: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.
verses.modern: The words of their mouths are wicked and deceitful; they fail to act wisely or do good.

verses.kjv: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.
verses.modern: Even on their beds they plot evil; they commit themselves to a sinful course and do not reject what is wrong.

verses.kjv: Thy mercy, O LORD, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.
verses.modern: Your mercy, LORD, is in the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.

verses.kjv: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast.
verses.modern: Your righteousness is like the highest mountains, Your justice like the great deep. You, LORD, preserve both people and animals.

verses.kjv: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.
verses.modern: How excellent is Your lovingkindness, O God! Therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of Your wings.

verses.kjv: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.
verses.modern: They feast on the abundance of Your house; You give them drink from Your river of delights.

verses.kjv: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.
verses.modern: For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.

verses.kjv: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.modern: Continue Your lovingkindness to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.

verses.kjv: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.
verses.modern: May the foot of the proud not come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.

verses.kjv: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.
verses.modern: See how the evildoers lie fallen — thrown down, not able to rise!

chapters.summary: The psalmist describes the wicked who have no fear of God and flatter themselves in their own eyes. He contrasts this with the LORD whose mercy reaches to the heavens, whose faithfulness to the clouds, and in whose light we see light.

verses.kjv: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.
verses.modern: Do not fret because of those who are evil or be envious of those who do wrong;

verses.kjv: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
verses.modern: for like the grass they will soon wither, like green plants they will soon die away.

verses.kjv: Trust in the LORD, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
verses.modern: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and enjoy safe pasture.

verses.kjv: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
verses.modern: Take delight in the LORD. He will give You the desires of Your heart.

verses.kjv: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
verses.modern: Commit Your way to the LORD; trust in Him and He will do this:

verses.kjv: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.
verses.modern: He will make Your righteous reward shine like the dawn, Your vindication like the noonday sun.

verses.kjv: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
verses.modern: Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when people succeed in their ways, when they carry out their wicked schemes.

verses.kjv: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
verses.modern: Refrain from anger and turn from wrath; do not fret — it leads only to evil.

verses.kjv: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.
verses.modern: For those who are evil will be destroyed, but those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.

verses.kjv: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.
verses.modern: A little while, and the wicked will be no more; though you look for them, they will not be found.

verses.kjv: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
verses.modern: But the meek will inherit the land and enjoy peace and prosperity.

verses.kjv: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
verses.modern: The wicked plot against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them;

verses.kjv: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.
verses.modern: but the Lord laughs at the wicked, for he knows their day is coming.

verses.kjv: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.
verses.modern: The wicked draw the sword and bend the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.

verses.kjv: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
verses.modern: But their swords will pierce their own hearts. Their bows will be broken.

verses.kjv: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.
verses.modern: Better the little that the righteous have than the wealth of many wicked;

verses.kjv: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.
verses.modern: for the power of the wicked will be broken. But The LORD upholds the righteous.

verses.kjv: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.
verses.modern: The blameless spend their days under the LORD's care. Their inheritance will endure forever.

verses.kjv: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
verses.modern: In times of disaster they will not wither; in days of famine they will enjoy plenty.

verses.kjv: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.
verses.modern: But the wicked will perish: though the LORD's enemies are like the flowers of the field, they will be consumed, they will go up in smoke.

verses.kjv: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.
verses.modern: The wicked borrow and do not repay, but the righteous give generously;

verses.kjv: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.
verses.modern: those the LORD blesses will inherit the land, but those He curses will be destroyed.

verses.kjv: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.
verses.modern: The LORD makes firm the steps of the one who delights in him;

verses.kjv: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.
verses.modern: though He may stumble, He will not fall, for the LORD upholds Him with His hand.

verses.kjv: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
verses.modern: I was young and now I am old, yet I have never seen the righteous forsaken or their children begging bread.

verses.kjv: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.
verses.modern: They are always generous and lend freely; their children will be a blessing.

verses.kjv: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.
verses.modern: Turn from evil and do good; then You will dwell in the land forever.

verses.kjv: For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.modern: For the LORD loves the just and will not forsake His faithful ones. Wrongdoers will be completely destroyed; the seed of the wicked will perish.

verses.kjv: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
verses.modern: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.

verses.kjv: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.
verses.modern: The mouths of the righteous utter wisdom. Their tongues speak what is just.

verses.kjv: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.
verses.modern: The law of their God is in their hearts; their feet do not slip.

verses.kjv: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.
verses.modern: The wicked lie in wait for the righteous, intent on putting them to death;

verses.kjv: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
verses.modern: but the LORD will not leave them in the power of the wicked or let them be condemned when brought to trial.

verses.kjv: Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.
verses.modern: Hope in the LORD and keep His way. He will exalt You to inherit the land; when the wicked are destroyed, you will see it.

verses.kjv: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.
verses.modern: I have seen a wicked and ruthless man flourishing like a luxuriant native tree,

verses.kjv: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
verses.modern: but He soon passed away and was no more; though I looked for Him, He could not be found.

verses.kjv: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.
verses.modern: Consider the blameless, observe the upright; a future awaits those who seek peace.

verses.kjv: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.modern: But all sinners will be destroyed; there will be no future for the wicked.

verses.kjv: But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD: he is their strength in the time of trouble.
verses.modern: The salvation of the righteous comes from the LORD; He is their stronghold in time of trouble.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.
verses.modern: The LORD helps them and delivers them; He delivers them from the wicked and saves them, because they take refuge in Him.

chapters.summary: The psalmist counsels against fretting over evildoers, for they shall soon be cut down like grass. He urges trust in the LORD, delight in Him, and commitment of one's way to God, promising that the meek shall inherit the earth and the righteous shall never be forsaken.

verses.kjv: O LORD, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
verses.modern: LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.

verses.kjv: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.
verses.modern: Your arrows have pierced me, and Your hand has come down on me.

verses.kjv: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.
verses.modern: Because of Your wrath there is no health in my body; there is no soundness in my bones because of my sin.

verses.kjv: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
verses.modern: My guilt has overwhelmed me like a burden too heavy to bear.

verses.kjv: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.
verses.modern: My wounds fester and are loathsome because of my sinful folly.

verses.kjv: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
verses.modern: I am bowed down and brought very low; all day long I go about mourning.

verses.kjv: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.
verses.modern: My back is filled with searing pain; there is no health in my body.

verses.kjv: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
verses.modern: I am feeble and utterly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.

verses.kjv: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.
verses.modern: All my longings lie open before You, Lord; my sighing is not hidden from You.

verses.kjv: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.
verses.modern: My heart pounds, my strength fails me; even the light has gone from my eyes.

verses.kjv: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
verses.modern: My friends and companions avoid me because of my wounds; my neighbors stay far away.

verses.kjv: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.
verses.modern: Those who want to kill me set their traps, those who would harm me talk of my ruin; all day long they scheme and lie.

verses.kjv: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
verses.modern: I am like the deaf, who cannot hear, like the mute, who cannot speak;

verses.kjv: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.
verses.modern: I have become like one who does not hear, whose mouth can offer no reply.

verses.kjv: For in thee, O LORD, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.
verses.modern: LORD, I wait for You; You will answer, Lord my God.

verses.kjv: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.
verses.modern: For I said, "Do not let them gloat or exalt themselves over me when my feet slip."

verses.kjv: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.
verses.modern: For I am about to fall, and my pain is ever with me.

verses.kjv: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
verses.modern: I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.

verses.kjv: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
verses.modern: Many have become my enemies without cause; those who hate me without reason are numerous.

verses.kjv: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.
verses.modern: Those who repay my good with evil lodge accusations against me, though I seek only to do what is good.

verses.kjv: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.
verses.modern: LORD, do not forsake me; do not be far from me, my God.

verses.kjv: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.
verses.modern: Come quickly to help me, my Lord and my Savior.

chapters.summary: The psalmist groans under the LORD's chastening hand, confessing that his iniquities have gone over his head like a heavy burden. His wounds stink, his friends stand far off, and his enemies plot against him, yet he waits silently for the LORD and pleads: do not forsake me.

verses.kjv: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.
verses.modern: I said, "I will watch my ways and keep my tongue from sin; I will put a muzzle on my mouth while in the presence of the wicked."

verses.kjv: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.
verses.modern: So I remained utterly silent, not even saying anything good. But my anguish increased;

verses.kjv: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,
verses.modern: my heart grew hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned; then I spoke with my tongue:

verses.kjv: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how frail I am.
verses.modern: "Show me, LORD, my life's end and the number of my days; let me know how fleeting my life is.

verses.kjv: Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth; and mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.
verses.modern: You have made my days a mere handbreadth; the span of my years is as nothing before You. Everyone is but a breath, even those who seem secure.

verses.kjv: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.
verses.modern: Surely everyone goes around like a mere phantom; in vain they rush about, heaping up wealth without knowing whose it will finally be.

verses.kjv: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.
verses.modern: But now, Lord, what do I look for? My hope is in You.

verses.kjv: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.
verses.modern: Save me from all my transgressions; do not make me the scorn of fools.

verses.kjv: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.
verses.modern: I was silent; I would not open my mouth, for You are the one who has done this.

verses.kjv: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.
verses.modern: Remove Your scourge from me; I am overcome by the blow of Your hand.

verses.kjv: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.
verses.modern: When You rebuke and discipline anyone for their sin, you consume their wealth like a moth — surely everyone is but a breath.

verses.kjv: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.
verses.modern: Hear my prayer, LORD, listen to my cry for help; do not be deaf to my weeping. I dwell with You as a foreigner, a stranger, as all my ancestors were.

verses.kjv: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.
verses.modern: Look away from me, that I may enjoy life again before I depart and am no more."

chapters.summary: The psalmist resolves to guard his tongue but cannot hold back his grief. He asks the LORD to show him the measure of his days and confesses that every man at his best state is altogether vanity. He prays: spare me before I go away and am no more.

verses.kjv: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
verses.modern: I waited patiently for the LORD; He turned to me and heard my cry.

verses.kjv: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
verses.modern: He lifted me out of the slimy pit, out of the mud and mire; He set my feet on a rock and gave me a firm place to stand.

verses.kjv: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
verses.modern: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear the LORD and put their trust in Him.

verses.kjv: Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
verses.modern: Blessed is the one who trusts in the LORD, Who does not look to the proud, to those who turn aside to false gods.

verses.kjv: Many, O LORD my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.
verses.modern: Many, LORD my God, are the wonders You have done, the things You planned for us. None can compare with You; were I to speak and tell of Your deeds, they would be too many to declare.

verses.kjv: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.
verses.modern: Sacrifice and offering You did not desire — but my ears You have opened — burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not require.

verses.kjv: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,
verses.modern: Then I said, "Here I am, I have come — it is written about me in the scroll.

verses.kjv: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.
verses.modern: I desire to do Your will, my God; Your law is within my heart."

verses.kjv: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.
verses.modern: I proclaim Your saving acts in the great assembly; I do not seal my lips, LORD, as You know.

verses.kjv: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.
verses.modern: I have not hidden Your righteousness within my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and Your salvation. I have not concealed Your lovingkindness and Your truth from the great congregation.

verses.kjv: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.
verses.modern: Do not withhold Your tender mercies from me, LORD; let Your lovingkindness and Your truth continually preserve me.

verses.kjv: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.
verses.modern: For troubles without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me. I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart fails within me.

verses.kjv: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.
verses.modern: Be pleased to save me, LORD; come quickly, LORD, to help me.

verses.kjv: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.
verses.modern: May all who want to take my life be put to shame and confusion; may all who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

verses.kjv: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.
verses.modern: May those who say to me, "Aha! Aha!" be appalled at their own shame.

verses.kjv: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.
verses.modern: But may all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who long for Your saving help always say, "The LORD is great!"

verses.kjv: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.
verses.modern: But as for me, I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my help and my deliverer; You are my God, do not delay.

chapters.summary: The psalmist testifies that the LORD pulled him out of a horrible pit and set his feet on a rock. He declares that God desires no sacrifice or offering but an open ear, and says, "In the volume of the book it is written of me -- I delight to do your will." He closes pleading for swift deliverance.

verses.kjv: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.
verses.modern: Blessed are those who have regard for the weak; the LORD delivers them in times of trouble.

verses.kjv: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.
verses.modern: The LORD protects and preserves them — they are counted among the blessed in the land — He does not give them over to the desire of their foes.

verses.kjv: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.
verses.modern: The LORD sustains them on their sickbed and restores them from their bed of illness.

verses.kjv: I said, LORD, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.
verses.modern: I said, "Have mercy on me, LORD; heal me, for I have sinned against You."

verses.kjv: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?
verses.modern: My enemies say of me in malice, "When will He die and His name perish?"

verses.kjv: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.
verses.modern: When one of them comes to see me, He speaks falsely, while His heart gathers slander; then He goes out and spreads it around.

verses.kjv: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.
verses.modern: All my enemies whisper together against me; they imagine the worst for me, saying,

verses.kjv: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.
verses.modern: "A vile disease has afflicted Him; He will never get up from the place where He lies."

verses.kjv: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.
verses.modern: Even my close friend, someone I trusted, one who shared my bread, has turned against me.

verses.kjv: But thou, O LORD, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.
verses.modern: But may You have mercy on me, LORD; raise me up, that I may repay them.

verses.kjv: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.
verses.modern: I know that You are pleased with me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.

verses.kjv: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.
verses.modern: Because of my integrity You uphold me and set me in Your presence forever.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
verses.modern: Praise be to the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.

chapters.summary: The psalmist pronounces blessing on the one who considers the poor. He confesses his own sin, describes the betrayal of a close friend who lifted his heel against him, and closes with a doxology blessing the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting.

verses.kjv: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.
verses.modern: As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul pants for you, my God.

verses.kjv: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?
verses.modern: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When can I go and meet with God?

verses.kjv: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?
verses.modern: My tears have been my food day and night, while people say to me all day long, "Where is your God?"

verses.kjv: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.
verses.modern: These things I remember as I pour out my soul: how I used to go to the house of God under the protection of the Mighty One with shouts of joy and praise among the festive throng.

verses.kjv: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.
verses.modern: Why are You cast down, O my soul? And why are You disquieted within me? Hope in God, for I shall yet praise Him for the help of His countenance.

verses.kjv: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.
verses.modern: My soul is downcast within me; therefore I will remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon — from Mount Mizar.

verses.kjv: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.
verses.modern: Deep calls to deep in the roar of your waterfalls; all your waves and breakers have swept over me.

verses.kjv: Yet the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.
verses.modern: Yet the LORD will command His lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night His song shall be with me, and my prayer to the God of my life.

verses.kjv: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.modern: I say to God my Rock, "Why have You forgotten me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?"

verses.kjv: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?
verses.modern: My bones suffer mortal agony as my foes taunt me, saying to me all day long, "Where is Your God?"

verses.kjv: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
verses.modern: Why are You cast down, O my soul? And why are You disquieted within me? Hope in God, for I shall yet praise Him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

chapters.summary: The psalmist pants for God as a deer pants for streams of water, his soul thirsting for the living God. Tears are his food day and night as enemies taunt him, yet he preaches to his own soul: "Hope in God, for I shall yet praise Him."

verses.kjv: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
verses.modern: Vindicate me, my God, and plead my cause against an unfaithful nation. Rescue me from those who are deceitful and wicked.

verses.kjv: For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.modern: You are God my stronghold. Why have You rejected me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?

verses.kjv: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.
verses.modern: Send me Your light and Your faithful care, let them lead me; let them bring me to Your holy mountain, to the place where You dwell.

verses.kjv: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.
verses.modern: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my joy and my delight. I will praise You with the lyre, O God, my God.

verses.kjv: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
verses.modern: Why are You cast down, O my soul? And why are You disquieted within me? Hope in God, for I shall yet praise Him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

chapters.summary: The psalmist pleads with God to judge his cause against an ungodly nation and send out His light and truth to lead him to the holy hill. He again commands his own soul to hope in God, for he shall yet praise the LORD, the health of his countenance.

verses.kjv: We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.
verses.modern: We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us what work You did in their days, in the times of old.

verses.kjv: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.
verses.modern: How you drove out the heathen with your hand, and planted them; how you afflicted the people, and cast them out.

verses.kjv: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.
verses.modern: They did not get the land in possession by their own sword, nor did their own arm save them; but your right hand, and your arm, and the light of your countenance, because you had a favor to them.

verses.kjv: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.
verses.modern: You are my King and my God, Who decrees victories for Jacob.

verses.kjv: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
verses.modern: Through you we push back our enemies; through your name we trample our foes.

verses.kjv: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
verses.modern: I put no trust in my bow, my sword does not bring me victory;

verses.kjv: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.
verses.modern: but you give us victory over our enemies, you put our adversaries to shame.

verses.kjv: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.
verses.modern: In God we make our boast all day long. We will praise your name forever.

verses.kjv: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.
verses.modern: But now you have rejected and humbled us; you no longer go out with our armies.

verses.kjv: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.
verses.modern: You made us retreat before the enemy, and our adversaries have plundered us.

verses.kjv: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.
verses.modern: You gave us up to be devoured like sheep and have scattered us among the nations.

verses.kjv: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.
verses.modern: You sold your people for a pittance, gaining nothing from their sale.

verses.kjv: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
verses.modern: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, the scorn and derision of those around us.

verses.kjv: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.
verses.modern: You have made us a byword among the nations; the peoples shake their heads at us.

verses.kjv: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,
verses.modern: I live in disgrace all day long, and my face is covered with shame

verses.kjv: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.
verses.modern: at the taunts of those who reproach and revile me, because of the enemy, who is bent on revenge.

verses.kjv: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.
verses.modern: All this came upon us, though we had not forgotten you; we had not been false to your covenant.

verses.kjv: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;
verses.modern: Our hearts had not turned back; our feet had not strayed from your path.

verses.kjv: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
verses.modern: But you crushed us and made us a haunt for jackals; you covered us over with deep darkness.

verses.kjv: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;
verses.modern: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,

verses.kjv: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
verses.modern: would not God have discovered it, since He knows the secrets of the heart?

verses.kjv: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.modern: Yet for your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.

verses.kjv: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.
verses.modern: Awake, Lord! Why do you sleep? Rouse yourself! Do not reject us forever.

verses.kjv: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
verses.modern: Why do you hide your face and forget our misery and oppression?

verses.kjv: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
verses.modern: We are brought down to the dust; our bodies cling to the ground.

verses.kjv: Rise up for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake.
verses.modern: Rise up and help us; rescue us because of your mercy.

chapters.summary: The people recall how God drove out nations for their fathers, yet now He has cast them off and scattered them among the heathen. They protest their faithfulness, declaring that they are killed all the day long and counted as sheep for the slaughter, and plead with God to awake and redeem them.

verses.kjv: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
verses.modern: My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses for the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.

verses.kjv: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
verses.modern: You are the most excellent of men and your lips have been anointed with grace, since God has blessed you forever.

verses.kjv: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.
verses.modern: Gird your sword on your side, you mighty one; clothe yourself with splendor and majesty.

verses.kjv: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.
verses.modern: In your majesty ride forth victoriously in the cause of truth, humility and justice; let your right hand achieve awesome deeds.

verses.kjv: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king's enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.
verses.modern: Let your sharp arrows pierce the hearts of the king's enemies; let the nations fall beneath your feet.

verses.kjv: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.
verses.modern: Your throne, O God, will last for ever and ever; a scepter of justice will be the scepter of Your kingdom.

verses.kjv: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
verses.modern: You love righteousness and hate wickedness; therefore God, Your God, has set You above Your companions by anointing You with the oil of joy.

verses.kjv: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.
verses.modern: All your robes are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces adorned with ivory the music of the strings makes you glad.

verses.kjv: Kings' daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
verses.modern: Daughters of kings are among your honored women; at your right hand is the royal bride in gold of Ophir.

verses.kjv: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father's house;
verses.modern: Listen, daughter, and pay careful attention: forget your people and your father's house.

verses.kjv: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.
verses.modern: Let the king be enthralled by your beauty; honor him, for he is your lord.

verses.kjv: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.
verses.modern: The city of Tyre will come with a gift, people of wealth will seek your favor.

verses.kjv: The king's daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.
verses.modern: All glorious is the princess within her chamber; her gown is interwoven with gold.

verses.kjv: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.
verses.modern: In embroidered garments she is led to the king; her virgin companions follow her — those brought to be with her.

verses.kjv: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king's palace.
verses.modern: Led in with joy and gladness, they enter the palace of the king.

verses.kjv: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.
verses.modern: Your sons will take the place of your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.

verses.kjv: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.
verses.modern: I will perpetuate your memory through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you for ever and ever.

chapters.summary: The psalmist celebrates a royal wedding, praising the king as fairer than the children of men and declaring his throne eternal. The queen stands in gold of Ophir, and the psalm promises that the king's name shall be remembered in all generations.

verses.kjv: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verses.modern: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.

verses.kjv: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
verses.modern: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth give way and the mountains fall into the heart of the sea,

verses.kjv: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
verses.modern: though its waters roar and foam and the mountains quake with their surging.

verses.kjv: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.
verses.modern: There is a river, the streams of which shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the Most High.

verses.kjv: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.
verses.modern: God is within her, she will not fall; God will help her at break of day.

verses.kjv: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.
verses.modern: Nations are in uproar, kingdoms fall; He lifts His voice, the earth melts.

verses.kjv: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.modern: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

verses.kjv: Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.
verses.modern: Come, behold the works of the LORD, the desolations He has made in the earth.

verses.kjv: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.
