verses.modern: He makes wars to cease to the end of the earth; He breaks the bow and cuts the spear in pieces; He burns the chariot in the fire.

verses.kjv: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
verses.modern: "Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth."

verses.kjv: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.modern: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

chapters.summary: The psalmist declares God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble. Though the earth be removed and mountains fall into the sea, God dwells in the midst of His city and commands: "Be still, and know that I am God."

verses.kjv: O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.
verses.modern: Clap Your hands, all You nations; shout to God with cries of joy.

verses.kjv: For the LORD most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.
verses.modern: For the LORD Most High is awesome, the great King over all the earth.

verses.kjv: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.
verses.modern: He subdued nations under us, peoples under our feet.

verses.kjv: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
verses.modern: He chose our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom he loved.

verses.kjv: God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.modern: God has ascended amid shouts of joy, the LORD amid the sounding of trumpets.

verses.kjv: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
verses.modern: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises.

verses.kjv: For God is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.
verses.modern: For God is the King of all the earth; sing to him a psalm of praise.

verses.kjv: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.
verses.modern: God reigns over the nations; God is seated on His holy throne.

verses.kjv: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto God: he is greatly exalted.
verses.modern: The nobles of the nations assemble as the people of the God of Abraham, for the kings of the earth belong to God; He is greatly exalted.

chapters.summary: The psalmist calls all nations to clap their hands and shout to God, for the LORD Most High is a great King over all the earth. God has ascended with a shout and the sound of a trumpet; He reigns over the nations and sits on His holy throne.

verses.kjv: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.
verses.modern: Great is the LORD, and most worthy of praise, in the city of our God, His holy mountain.

verses.kjv: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
verses.modern: Beautiful in its loftiness, the joy of the whole earth, like the heights of Zaphon is Mount Zion, the city of the Great King.

verses.kjv: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.
verses.modern: God is in her citadels; He has shown Himself to be her fortress.

verses.kjv: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.
verses.modern: When the kings joined forces, when they advanced together,

verses.kjv: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.
verses.modern: they saw her and were astounded; they fled in terror.

verses.kjv: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.modern: Trembling seized them there, pain like that of a woman in labor.

verses.kjv: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
verses.modern: You destroyed them like ships of Tarshish shattered by an east wind.

verses.kjv: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.
verses.modern: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God; God will establish it forever. Selah.

verses.kjv: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.
verses.modern: We have thought of Your lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of Your temple.

verses.kjv: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.modern: Like Your name, O God, Your praise reaches to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is filled with righteousness.

verses.kjv: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.
verses.modern: Mount Zion rejoices, the villages of Judah are glad because of Your judgments.

verses.kjv: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.
verses.modern: Walk about Zion, go around her, count her towers,

verses.kjv: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.
verses.modern: consider well her ramparts, view her citadels, that You may tell of them to the next generation.

verses.kjv: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.
verses.modern: For this God is our God for ever and ever; He will be our guide even to the end.

chapters.summary: The psalmist praises the greatness of the LORD in the city of our God. Mount Zion, beautiful for situation, is the joy of the whole earth; when kings see her they marvel and flee. The psalm calls God's people to walk about Zion and count her towers.

verses.kjv: Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:
verses.modern: Hear this, all you peoples; listen, all who live in this world,

verses.kjv: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.
verses.modern: both low and high, rich and poor alike:

verses.kjv: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.
verses.modern: My mouth will speak words of wisdom; the meditation of my heart will give you understanding.

verses.kjv: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
verses.modern: I will turn my ear to a proverb; with the harp I will expound my riddle:

verses.kjv: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?
verses.modern: Why should I fear when evil days come, when wicked deceivers surround me —

verses.kjv: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;
verses.modern: those who trust in their wealth and boast of their great riches?

verses.kjv: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:
verses.modern: No one can redeem the life of another or give to God a sufficient ransom for them —

verses.kjv: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)
verses.modern: the ransom for a life is costly, no payment is ever enough —

verses.kjv: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.
verses.modern: so that they should live on forever and not see decay.

verses.kjv: For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.
verses.modern: For all can see that the wise die, that the foolish and the senseless also perish, leaving their wealth to others.

verses.kjv: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.
verses.modern: Their tombs will remain their houses forever, their dwellings for endless generations, though they had named lands after themselves.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.
verses.modern: People, despite their wealth, do not endure; they are like the beasts that perish.

verses.kjv: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.
verses.modern: This is the fate of those who trust in themselves, and of their followers, who approve their sayings.

verses.kjv: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.
verses.modern: They are like sheep and are destined to die; death will be their shepherd (but the upright will prevail over them in the morning). Their forms will decay in the grave, far from their princely mansions.

verses.kjv: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.
verses.modern: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave, for He shall receive me. Selah.

verses.kjv: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
verses.modern: Do not be overawed when others grow rich, when the splendor of their houses increases;

verses.kjv: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.
verses.modern: for they will take nothing with them when they die, their splendor will not descend with them.

verses.kjv: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.
verses.modern: Though while they live they count themselves blessed — and people praise you when you prosper —

verses.kjv: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.
verses.modern: they will join those who have gone before them, who will never again see the light of life.

verses.kjv: Man that is in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish.
verses.modern: People who have wealth but lack understanding are like the beasts that perish.

chapters.summary: The psalmist addresses all peoples with a wisdom meditation on death and riches. No man can redeem his brother or give God a ransom for his soul; the wise and the fool alike perish and leave their wealth to others. Man that is in honour and understands not is like the beasts that perish.

verses.kjv: The mighty God, even the LORD, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.
verses.modern: The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks and summons the earth from the rising of the sun to where it sets.

verses.kjv: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.
verses.modern: From Zion, perfect in beauty, God shines forth.

verses.kjv: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.
verses.modern: Our God comes and will not be silent; a fire devours before Him, and around Him a tempest rages.

verses.kjv: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.
verses.modern: He summons the heavens above, and the earth, that He may judge His people:

verses.kjv: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.
verses.modern: "Gather to me this consecrated people, who made a covenant with me by sacrifice."

verses.kjv: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. Selah.
verses.modern: the heavens proclaim His righteousness, for He is a God of justice.

verses.kjv: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I am God, even thy God.
verses.modern: "Listen, my people. I will speak; I will testify against You, Israel: I am God, Your God.

verses.kjv: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.
verses.modern: I bring no charges against You concerning Your sacrifices or concerning Your burnt offerings, which are ever before me.

verses.kjv: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.
verses.modern: I have no need of a bull from Your stall or of goats from Your pens,

verses.kjv: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.
verses.modern: for every animal of the forest is mine, and the cattle on a thousand hills.

verses.kjv: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.
verses.modern: I know every bird in the mountains, and the insects in the fields are mine.

verses.kjv: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.
verses.modern: If I were hungry I would not tell You, for the world is mine. All that is in it.

verses.kjv: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
verses.modern: Do I eat the flesh of bulls or drink the blood of goats?

verses.kjv: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:
verses.modern: Sacrifice thank offerings to God, fulfill Your vows to the Most High,

verses.kjv: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.
verses.modern: call on me in the day of trouble; I will deliver You, and You will honor me."

verses.kjv: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?
verses.modern: But to the wicked person, God says: "What right have you to recite my laws or take my covenant on your lips?

verses.kjv: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.
verses.modern: You hate my instruction and cast my words behind you.

verses.kjv: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.
verses.modern: When you see a thief, you join with him; you throw in your lot with adulterers.

verses.kjv: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.
verses.modern: You use your mouth for evil and harness your tongue to deceit.

verses.kjv: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother's son.
verses.modern: You sit and testify against your brother and slander your own mother's son.

verses.kjv: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.
verses.modern: When you did these things and I kept silent, you thought I was exactly like you. But I now arraign you and set my accusations before you.

verses.kjv: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.
verses.modern: Consider this, You who forget God, or I will tear You to pieces, with no one to rescue you:

verses.kjv: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.
verses.modern: Those who sacrifice thank offerings honor me, and to the blameless I will show my salvation."

chapters.summary: God summons the earth from the rising of the sun to its setting and shines forth from Zion. He rebukes His people for trusting in sacrifice while ignoring obedience, asking whether He eats the flesh of bulls or drinks the blood of goats. He commands: offer thanksgiving and call on Me in the day of trouble.

verses.kjv: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
verses.modern: Have mercy on me, O God, according to Your lovingkindness; according to the multitude of Your tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

verses.kjv: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
verses.modern: Wash away all my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.

verses.kjv: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.
verses.modern: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.

verses.kjv: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.
verses.modern: Against You, You only, have I sinned and done what is evil in Your sight; so You are right in Your verdict and justified when You judge.

verses.kjv: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.
verses.modern: Surely I was sinful at birth, sinful from the time my mother conceived me.

verses.kjv: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.
verses.modern: Yet You desired faithfulness even in the womb; You taught me wisdom in that secret place.

verses.kjv: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
verses.modern: Cleanse me with hyssop. I will be clean; wash me. I will be whiter than snow.

verses.kjv: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.
verses.modern: Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones You have crushed rejoice.

verses.kjv: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.
verses.modern: Hide Your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquity.

verses.kjv: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
verses.modern: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.

verses.kjv: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.
verses.modern: Do not cast me from Your presence or take Your Holy Spirit from me.

verses.kjv: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
verses.modern: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation and grant me a willing spirit, to sustain me.

verses.kjv: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.
verses.modern: Then I will teach transgressors Your ways, so that sinners will turn back to You.

verses.kjv: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.
verses.modern: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, You who are God my Savior, and my tongue will sing of Your righteousness.

verses.kjv: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.
verses.modern: Open my lips, Lord, and my mouth will declare Your praise.

verses.kjv: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.
verses.modern: You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; You do not take pleasure in burnt offerings.

verses.kjv: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
verses.modern: My sacrifice, O God, is a broken spirit; a broken and contrite heart You, God, will not despise.

verses.kjv: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.
verses.modern: May it please You to prosper Zion, to build up the walls of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.
verses.modern: Then You will delight in the sacrifices of the righteous, in burnt offerings offered whole; then bulls will be offered on Your altar.

chapters.summary: The psalmist confesses his sin against God and pleads for mercy according to the LORD's lovingkindness. He cries, "Create in me a clean heart, O God," and asks not to be cast from God's presence or to have the Holy Spirit taken from him. The sacrifice God desires is a broken and contrite heart.

verses.kjv: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God endureth continually.
verses.modern: Why do you boast of evil, you mighty hero? Why do you boast all day long, you who are a disgrace in the eyes of God?

verses.kjv: Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
verses.modern: You who practice deceit, your tongue plots destruction; it is like a sharpened razor.

verses.kjv: Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.
verses.modern: You love evil rather than good, falsehood rather than speaking the truth.

verses.kjv: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.
verses.modern: You love every harmful word, you deceitful tongue!

verses.kjv: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.
verses.modern: Surely God will bring you down to everlasting ruin: He will snatch you up and pluck you from your tent; He will uproot you from the land of the living.

verses.kjv: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:
verses.modern: The righteous will see and fear; they will laugh at you, saying,

verses.kjv: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.
verses.modern: "Here now is the man who did not make God His stronghold but trusted in His great wealth and grew strong by destroying others!"

verses.kjv: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.
verses.modern: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God; I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.

verses.kjv: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name; for it is good before thy saints.
verses.modern: I will praise you forever, because you have done it; and I will wait on your name, for it is good, before your saints.

chapters.summary: The psalmist rebukes a mighty man who boasts in evil, whose tongue is like a sharp razor. God will uproot him from the land of the living, and the righteous will see it and laugh. The psalmist trusts in the mercy of God forever and ever.

verses.kjv: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.
verses.modern: The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt. Their ways are vile; there is no one who does good.

verses.kjv: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.
verses.modern: God looks down from heaven on all mankind to see if there are any who understand, any who seek God.

verses.kjv: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.modern: Everyone has turned away, all have become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.

verses.kjv: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.
verses.modern: Do all these evildoers know nothing? They devour my people as though eating bread; they never call on God.

verses.kjv: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God hath despised them.
verses.modern: But there they were, overwhelmed with dread, where there was nothing to dread. God scattered the bones of those who attacked you; you put them to shame, for God despised them.

verses.kjv: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
verses.modern: Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion! When God restores His people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad!

chapters.summary: The psalmist repeats the charge that the fool denies God and that all have turned aside -- there is none that does good, not even one. God has scattered the bones of those who encamp against His people, and the psalm longs for salvation to come out of Zion.

verses.kjv: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.
verses.modern: Save me, O God, by Your name; vindicate me by Your might.

verses.kjv: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.modern: Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.

verses.kjv: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.
verses.modern: Arrogant foes are attacking me; ruthless people are trying to kill me — people without regard for God.

verses.kjv: Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.
verses.modern: Surely God is my help; the Lord is the one who sustains me.

verses.kjv: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.
verses.modern: Let evil recoil on those who slander me; in Your faithfulness destroy them.

verses.kjv: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD; for it is good.
verses.modern: I will sacrifice a freewill offering to You; I will praise Your name, LORD, for it is good.

verses.kjv: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.
verses.modern: You have delivered me from all my troubles, and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes.

chapters.summary: The psalmist cries for God to save him by His name when strangers rise against him and oppressors seek his soul. He trusts that God is his helper and vows to freely sacrifice and praise the LORD's name, for He has delivered him from all trouble.

verses.kjv: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.
verses.modern: Listen to my prayer, O God, do not ignore my plea;

verses.kjv: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;
verses.modern: hear me and answer me. My thoughts trouble me and I am distraught

verses.kjv: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.
verses.modern: because of what my enemy is saying, because of the threats of the wicked; for they bring down suffering on me and assail me in their anger.

verses.kjv: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
verses.modern: My heart is in anguish within me; the terrors of death have fallen on me.

verses.kjv: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.
verses.modern: Fear and trembling have beset me; horror has overwhelmed me.

verses.kjv: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.
verses.modern: I said, "Oh, that I had the wings of a dove! I would fly away and be at rest.

verses.kjv: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.
verses.modern: I would flee far away and stay in the desert;

verses.kjv: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.
verses.modern: I would hurry to my place of shelter, far from the tempest and storm."

verses.kjv: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
verses.modern: Lord, confuse the wicked, confound their words, for I see violence and strife in the city.

verses.kjv: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.
verses.modern: Day and night they prowl about on its walls; malice and abuse are within it.

verses.kjv: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.
verses.modern: Destructive forces are at work in the city; threats and lies never leave its streets.

verses.kjv: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
verses.modern: If an enemy were insulting me, I could endure it; if a foe were rising against me, I could hide.

verses.kjv: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.
verses.modern: But it is you, a man like myself, my companion, my close friend,

verses.kjv: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.
verses.modern: with whom I once enjoyed sweet fellowship at the house of God, as we walked about among the worshipers.

verses.kjv: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.
verses.modern: Let death seize them, and let them go down alive into hell, for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.

verses.kjv: As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.
verses.modern: As for me, I call to God. The LORD saves me.

verses.kjv: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
verses.modern: Evening, morning and noon I cry out in distress. He hears my voice.

verses.kjv: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.
verses.modern: He rescues me unharmed from the battle waged against me, even though many oppose me.

verses.kjv: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah: because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.
verses.modern: God, Who is enthroned from of old, who does not change — He will hear them and humble them, because they have no fear of God.

verses.kjv: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.
verses.modern: My companion attacks His friends; He violates His covenant.

verses.kjv: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.
verses.modern: His talk is smooth as butter, yet war is in His heart; His words are more soothing than oil, yet they are drawn swords.

verses.kjv: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
verses.modern: Cast Your cares on the LORD and He will sustain You; He will never let the righteous be shaken.

verses.kjv: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.
verses.modern: But You, God, will bring down the wicked into the pit of decay; the bloodthirsty and deceitful will not live out half their days. But as for me, I trust in You.

chapters.summary: The psalmist is overwhelmed by terror and wishes for the wings of a dove to fly away and be at rest. He grieves that a familiar friend has betrayed him, one with whom he walked to the house of God. He casts his burden on the LORD, trusting that God will sustain him.

verses.kjv: Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.
verses.modern: Be merciful to me, my God, for my enemies are in hot pursuit; all day long they press their attack.

verses.kjv: Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.
verses.modern: My adversaries pursue me all day long; in their pride many are attacking me.

verses.kjv: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
verses.modern: When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.

verses.kjv: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.
verses.modern: In God I will praise His word; in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do to me.

verses.kjv: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.
verses.modern: All day long they twist my words; all their schemes are for my ruin.

verses.kjv: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.
verses.modern: They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps, hoping to take my life.

verses.kjv: Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O God.
verses.modern: Because of their wickedness do not let them escape; in Your anger, God, bring the nations down.

verses.kjv: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
verses.modern: Record my misery; list my tears on your scroll — are they not in your record?

verses.kjv: When I cry unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.
verses.modern: Then my enemies will turn back when I call for help. By this I will know that God is for me.

verses.kjv: In God will I praise his word: in the LORD will I praise his word.
verses.modern: In God, whose word I praise, in the LORD, whose word I praise —

verses.kjv: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.
verses.modern: in God I trust and am not afraid. What can man do to me?

verses.kjv: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.
verses.modern: I am under vows to You, my God; I will present my thank offerings to You.

verses.kjv: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?
verses.modern: For You have delivered me from death and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.

chapters.summary: The psalmist declares that when he is afraid he will trust in God, and in God he will not fear what flesh can do to him. His enemies twist his words and watch his steps, but God records his tears in a bottle. He will walk before God in the light of the living.

verses.kjv: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
verses.modern: Have mercy on me, my God, have mercy on me, for in You I take refuge. I will take refuge in the shadow of Your wings until the disaster has passed.

verses.kjv: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.
verses.modern: I cry out to God Most High, to God, Who vindicates me.

verses.kjv: He shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.
verses.modern: He shall send from heaven and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth His mercy and His truth.

verses.kjv: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
verses.modern: I am in the midst of lions; I am forced to dwell among ravenous beasts — men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.

verses.kjv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all the earth.
verses.modern: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let Your glory be over all the earth.

verses.kjv: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.
verses.modern: They spread a net for my feet — I was bowed down in distress. They dug a pit in my path — but they have fallen into it themselves.

verses.kjv: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.
verses.modern: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise.

verses.kjv: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
verses.modern: Awake, my soul! Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.

verses.kjv: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.
verses.modern: I will praise you, Lord, among the nations; I will sing of you among the peoples.

verses.kjv: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens: and thy truth unto the clouds.
verses.modern: For your mercy is great to the heavens, and your truth to the clouds.

verses.kjv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.
verses.modern: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let Your glory be over all the earth.

chapters.summary: The psalmist takes refuge in the shadow of God's wings while surrounded by lions whose teeth are spears and arrows. His enemies dig a pit but fall into it themselves. His heart is fixed, and he vows to awake early and praise God among the nations.

verses.kjv: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?
verses.modern: Do you rulers indeed speak justly? Do you judge people with equity?

verses.kjv: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.
verses.modern: No, in your heart you devise injustice, and your hands mete out violence on the earth.

verses.kjv: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.
verses.modern: Even from birth the wicked go astray; from the womb they are wayward, spreading lies.

verses.kjv: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;
verses.modern: Their venom is like the venom of a snake, like that of a cobra that has stopped its ears,

verses.kjv: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.
verses.modern: that will not heed the tune of the charmer, however skillful the enchanter may be.

verses.kjv: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.
verses.modern: Break the teeth in their mouths, O God; LORD, tear out the fangs of those lions!

verses.kjv: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.
verses.modern: Let them vanish like water that flows away; when they draw the bow, let their arrows fall short.

verses.kjv: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.
verses.modern: May they be like a slug that melts away as it moves along, like a stillborn child that never sees the sun.

verses.kjv: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.
verses.modern: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns — whether they be green or dry — the wicked will be swept away.

verses.kjv: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
verses.modern: The righteous will be glad when they are avenged, when they dip their feet in the blood of the wicked.

verses.kjv: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.
verses.modern: Then people will say, "Surely the righteous still are rewarded; surely there is a God Who judges the earth."

chapters.summary: The psalmist challenges corrupt judges who devise wickedness in their hearts and distribute violence in the earth. The wicked are like a deaf serpent that will not listen to the voice of the charmer. He calls on God to break their teeth and melt them away, that men may say there is a God that judges in the earth.

verses.kjv: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.
verses.modern: Deliver me from my enemies, O God; be my fortress against those who are attacking me.

verses.kjv: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.
verses.modern: Deliver me from evildoers and save me from those who are after my blood.

verses.kjv: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O LORD.
verses.modern: See how they lie in wait for me! Fierce men conspire against me for no offense or sin of mine, LORD.

verses.kjv: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.
verses.modern: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Arise to help me; look on my plight!

verses.kjv: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.
verses.modern: You therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen; be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.

verses.kjv: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.modern: They return at evening, snarling like dogs, and prowl about the city.

verses.kjv: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, doth hear?
verses.modern: See what they spew from their mouths — the words from their lips are sharp as swords. They think, "Who can hear us?"

verses.kjv: But thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.
verses.modern: But You laugh at them, LORD; You scoff at all those nations.

verses.kjv: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.
verses.modern: You are my strength, I watch for You; You, God, are my fortress,

verses.kjv: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.
verses.modern: my God on whom I can rely. God will go before me and will let me gloat over those who slander me.

verses.kjv: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.
verses.modern: But do not kill them, Lord our shield, or my people will forget. In Your might uproot and bring them down.

verses.kjv: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.
verses.modern: For the sins of their mouths, for the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride. For the curses and lies they utter,

verses.kjv: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.
verses.modern: consume them in your wrath, consume them till they are no more. Then it will be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob.

verses.kjv: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.modern: They return at evening, snarling like dogs, and prowl about the city.

verses.kjv: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.
verses.modern: They wander about for food and howl if not satisfied.

verses.kjv: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.
verses.modern: But I will sing of your power; yes, I will sing aloud of your mercy in the morning, for you have been my defense and refuge in the day of my trouble.

verses.kjv: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.
verses.modern: To You, O my strength, will I sing; for God is my defense, and the God of my mercy.

chapters.summary: The psalmist pleads for deliverance from enemies who surround his house like snarling dogs. Though they lie in wait with no cause, he trusts that God will scatter them and let all Israel know that God rules in Jacob to the ends of the earth. He will sing of God's strength and mercy every morning.

verses.kjv: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.
verses.modern: You have rejected us, God, and burst upon us; You have been angry — now restore us!

verses.kjv: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
verses.modern: You have shaken the land and torn it open; mend its fractures, for it is quaking.

verses.kjv: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.
verses.modern: You have shown your people desperate times; you have given us wine that makes us stagger.

verses.kjv: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
verses.modern: But for those who fear you, you have raised a banner to be unfurled against the bow.

verses.kjv: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.
verses.modern: Save us and help us with your right hand, that those you love may be delivered.

verses.kjv: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.modern: God has spoken in His holiness: "I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

verses.kjv: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
verses.modern: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet, Judah is my scepter.

verses.kjv: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.
verses.modern: Moab is my washbasin, on Edom I toss my sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph."

verses.kjv: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.modern: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

verses.kjv: Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?
verses.modern: Is it not You, God, You who have now rejected us and no longer go out with our armies?

verses.kjv: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
verses.modern: Give us help from trouble, for vain is the help of man.

verses.kjv: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
verses.modern: With God we will gain the victory. He will trample down our enemies.

chapters.summary: The psalmist laments that God has cast off and scattered His people after a military defeat. Yet God has spoken in His holiness, claiming Shechem, Succoth, Gilead, Ephraim, and Judah as His own. Through God the people will do valiantly, for it is He who shall tread down their enemies.

verses.kjv: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.
verses.modern: Hear my cry, O God; listen to my prayer.

verses.kjv: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
verses.modern: From the ends of the earth I call to you, I call as my heart grows faint; lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

verses.kjv: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.
verses.modern: For you have been my refuge, a strong tower against the foe.

verses.kjv: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.
verses.modern: I long to dwell in your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of your wings.

verses.kjv: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.
verses.modern: For You, God, have heard my vows; You have given me the heritage of those who fear Your name.

verses.kjv: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: and his years as many generations.
verses.modern: Increase the days of the king's life, his years for many generations.

verses.kjv: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.
verses.modern: He shall abide before God forever; prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve Him.

verses.kjv: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
verses.modern: Then I will ever sing in praise of your name and fulfill my vows day after day.

chapters.summary: The psalmist cries to God from the end of the earth, overwhelmed and longing for the rock that is higher than he. He asks to dwell in God's tabernacle forever and to take refuge in the shelter of His wings. He prays for the king's life to be prolonged through many generations.

verses.kjv: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.
verses.modern: Truly my soul finds rest in God; my salvation comes from Him.

verses.kjv: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.
verses.modern: Truly He is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress, I will never be shaken.

verses.kjv: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.
verses.modern: How long will You assault me? Would all of You throw me down — this leaning wall, this tottering fence?

verses.kjv: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
verses.modern: Surely they intend to topple me from my lofty place; they take delight in lies. With their mouths they bless, but in their hearts they curse.

verses.kjv: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.
verses.modern: Yes, my soul, find rest in God; my hope comes from Him.

verses.kjv: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.
verses.modern: Truly He is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress, I will not be shaken.

verses.kjv: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
verses.modern: My salvation and my honor depend on God; He is my mighty rock, my refuge.

verses.kjv: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.
verses.modern: Trust in Him at all times, You people; pour out Your hearts to Him, for God is our refuge.

verses.kjv: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.
verses.modern: Surely the lowborn are but a breath, the highborn are but a lie. If weighed on a balance, they are nothing; together they are only a breath.

verses.kjv: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.
verses.modern: Do not trust in extortion or put vain hope in stolen goods; though Your riches increase, do not set Your heart on them.

verses.kjv: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto God.
verses.modern: One thing God has spoken, two things I have heard: "Power belongs to You, God,

verses.kjv: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.
verses.modern: Also to You, O Lord, belongs mercy; for You reward every man according to his work.

chapters.summary: The psalmist declares that his soul waits only on God, who alone is his rock, salvation, and defense. He rebukes those who plot against him with lying mouths, and counsels all to trust in God at all times, for power and mercy belong to the LORD.

verses.kjv: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
verses.modern: You, God, are my God, earnestly I seek You; I thirst for You, my whole being longs for You, in a dry and parched land where there is no water.

verses.kjv: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.
verses.modern: I have seen you in the sanctuary and beheld your power and your glory.

verses.kjv: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.
verses.modern: Because your lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.

verses.kjv: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.
verses.modern: I will praise you as long as I live, and in your name I will lift up my hands.

verses.kjv: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:
verses.modern: I will be fully satisfied as with the richest of foods; with singing lips my mouth will praise you.

verses.kjv: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.
verses.modern: On my bed I remember you; I think of you through the watches of the night.

verses.kjv: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
verses.modern: Because you are my help, I sing in the shadow of your wings.

verses.kjv: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.
verses.modern: I cling to you; your right hand upholds me.

verses.kjv: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
verses.modern: Those who want to kill me will be destroyed; they will go down to the depths of the earth.

verses.kjv: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.
verses.modern: They will be given over to the sword and become food for jackals.

verses.kjv: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
verses.modern: But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by God will glory in Him, while the mouths of liars will be silenced.

chapters.summary: The psalmist thirsts for God in a dry and parched land and declares that God's lovingkindness is better than life. He meditates on God through the night watches, rejoices in the shadow of His wings, and trusts that those who seek his life will go into the lower parts of the earth.

verses.kjv: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
verses.modern: Hear me, my God, as I voice my complaint; protect my life from the threat of the enemy.

verses.kjv: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:
verses.modern: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the plots of evildoers.

verses.kjv: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:
verses.modern: They sharpen their tongues like swords and aim cruel words like deadly arrows.

verses.kjv: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
verses.modern: They shoot from ambush at the innocent; they shoot suddenly, without fear.

verses.kjv: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?
verses.modern: They encourage each other in evil plans, they talk about hiding their snares; they say, "Who will see it?"

verses.kjv: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.
verses.modern: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search; both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.

verses.kjv: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.
verses.modern: But God will shoot them with his arrows; they will suddenly be struck down.

verses.kjv: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.
verses.modern: He will turn their own tongues against them and bring them to ruin; all who see them will shake their heads in scorn.

verses.kjv: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.
verses.modern: All people will fear; they will proclaim the works of God and ponder what He has done.

verses.kjv: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
verses.modern: The righteous will rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in Him; all the upright in heart will glory in Him!

chapters.summary: The psalmist asks God to hide him from the secret counsel of the wicked, who sharpen their tongues like swords. But God will shoot at them with His own arrow suddenly, and their own tongues will bring them to ruin. All men shall fear and declare the work of God.

verses.kjv: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.
verses.modern: Praise awaits You, our God, in Zion; to You our vows will be fulfilled.

verses.kjv: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
verses.modern: You who answer prayer, to you all people will come.

verses.kjv: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.
verses.modern: When we were overwhelmed by sins, you forgave our transgressions.

verses.kjv: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.
verses.modern: Blessed are those you choose and bring near to live in your courts! We are filled with the good things of your house, of your holy temple.

verses.kjv: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:
verses.modern: You answer us with awesome and righteous deeds, God our Savior, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas,

verses.kjv: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:
verses.modern: who formed the mountains by your power, having armed yourself with strength,

verses.kjv: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.
verses.modern: who stilled the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

verses.kjv: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
verses.modern: The whole earth is filled with awe at your wonders; where morning dawns, where evening fades, you call forth songs of joy.

verses.kjv: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.
verses.modern: You care for the land and water it; you enrich it abundantly. The streams of God are filled with water to provide the people with grain, for so you have ordained it.

verses.kjv: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.
verses.modern: You drench its furrows and level its ridges; you soften it with showers and bless its crops.

verses.kjv: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
verses.modern: You crown the year with your bounty, and your carts overflow with abundance.

verses.kjv: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.
verses.modern: The grasslands of the wilderness overflow; the hills are clothed with gladness.

verses.kjv: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.
verses.modern: The meadows are covered with flocks and the valleys are mantled with grain; they shout for joy and sing.

chapters.summary: The psalmist praises God in Zion for hearing prayer and forgiving transgressions. He celebrates God's awesome works in nature -- setting fast the mountains, stilling the seas, and crowning the year with goodness so that the pastures and valleys shout for joy and sing.

verses.kjv: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:
verses.modern: Shout for joy to God, all the earth!

verses.kjv: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
verses.modern: Sing the glory of his name; make his praise glorious.

verses.kjv: Say unto God, How terrible are thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.
verses.modern: Say to God, "How awesome are Your deeds! So great is Your power that Your enemies cringe before You.

verses.kjv: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.
verses.modern: All the earth bows down to you; they sing praise to you, they sing the praises of your name."

verses.kjv: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.
verses.modern: Come and see what God has done, His awesome deeds for mankind!

verses.kjv: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.
verses.modern: He turned the sea into dry land, they passed through the waters on foot — come, let us rejoice in him.

verses.kjv: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.
verses.modern: He rules forever by his power, his eyes watch the nations — let not the rebellious rise up against him.

verses.kjv: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:
verses.modern: Praise our God, all peoples, let the sound of His praise be heard;

verses.kjv: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.
verses.modern: he has preserved our lives and kept our feet from slipping.

verses.kjv: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.
verses.modern: For You, God, tested us; You refined us like silver.

verses.kjv: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.
verses.modern: You brought us into prison and laid burdens on our backs.

verses.kjv: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.
verses.modern: You let people ride over our heads; we went through fire and water, but you brought us to a place of abundance.

verses.kjv: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,
verses.modern: I will come to your temple with burnt offerings and fulfill my vows to you —

verses.kjv: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.
verses.modern: vows my lips promised and my mouth spoke when I was in trouble.

verses.kjv: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.
verses.modern: I will sacrifice fat animals to you and an offering of rams; I will offer bulls and goats.

verses.kjv: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
verses.modern: Come and hear, all you who fear God; let me tell you what He has done for me.

verses.kjv: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.
verses.modern: I cried out to him with my mouth; his praise was on my tongue.

verses.kjv: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me:
verses.modern: If I had cherished sin in my heart, the Lord would not have listened;

verses.kjv: But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
verses.modern: but God has surely listened and has heard my prayer.

verses.kjv: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.
verses.modern: Blessed be God, Who has not turned away my prayer, nor His mercy from me.

chapters.summary: The psalmist calls all the earth to make a joyful noise to God and to come see His awesome works. He recounts how God turned the sea to dry land, brought His people through fire and water into a wealthy place, and hears prayer because He has not turned away His mercy.

verses.kjv: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.
verses.modern: God be merciful to us, and bless us, and cause His countenance to shine on us. Selah.

verses.kjv: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.
verses.modern: so that your ways may be known on earth, your salvation among all nations.

verses.kjv: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
verses.modern: May the peoples praise you, God; may all the peoples praise you.

verses.kjv: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.
verses.modern: May the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you rule the peoples with equity and guide the nations of the earth.

verses.kjv: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
verses.modern: May the peoples praise you, God; may all the peoples praise you.

verses.kjv: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.
verses.modern: The land yields its harvest; God, our God, blesses us.

verses.kjv: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
verses.modern: May God bless us still, so that all the ends of the earth will fear Him.

chapters.summary: The psalmist asks God to be merciful and cause His face to shine on His people, so that His way may be known on earth and His salvation among all nations. He calls all the peoples to praise God and asks the earth to yield her increase.

verses.kjv: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.
verses.modern: May God arise, may His enemies be scattered; may His foes flee before Him.

verses.kjv: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
verses.modern: May you blow them away like smoke — as wax melts before the fire, may the wicked perish before God.

verses.kjv: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.
verses.modern: But may the righteous be glad and rejoice before God; may they be happy and joyful.

verses.kjv: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.
verses.modern: Sing to God, sing in praise of His name, extol Him who rides on the clouds; rejoice before Him — His name is the LORD.

verses.kjv: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
verses.modern: A father to the fatherless, a defender of widows, is God in His holy dwelling.

verses.kjv: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
verses.modern: God sets the lonely in families, He leads out the prisoners with singing; but the rebellious live in a sun-scorched land.

verses.kjv: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:
verses.modern: When You, God, went out before Your people, when You marched through the wilderness,

verses.kjv: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
verses.modern: the earth shook, the heavens poured down rain, before God, the One of Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.

verses.kjv: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
verses.modern: You gave abundant showers, O God; You refreshed Your weary inheritance.

verses.kjv: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.
verses.modern: Your people settled in it, and from Your bounty, God, You provided for the poor.

verses.kjv: The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.
verses.modern: The Lord announces the word, and the women who proclaim it are a mighty throng:

verses.kjv: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.
verses.modern: "Kings and their armies flee in haste; the women at home divide the plunder."

verses.kjv: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.
verses.modern: Even while You sleep among the sheep pens, the wings of my dove are sheathed with silver, its feathers with shining gold.

verses.kjv: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.
verses.modern: When the Almighty scattered the kings in the land, it was like snow fallen on Zalmon.

verses.kjv: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.
verses.modern: Mount Bashan, majestic mountain, Mount Bashan, rugged mountain,

verses.kjv: Why leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which God desireth to dwell in; yea, the LORD will dwell in it for ever.
verses.modern: why gaze in envy, You rugged mountain, at the mountain where God chooses to reign, where the LORD Himself will dwell forever?

verses.kjv: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.
verses.modern: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands; the Lord has come from Sinai into His sanctuary.

verses.kjv: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell among them.
verses.modern: When You ascended on high, You took many captives; You received gifts from people, even from the rebellious — that You, LORD God, might dwell there.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.
verses.modern: Praise be to the Lord, to God our Savior, who daily bears our burdens.

verses.kjv: He that is our God is the God of salvation; and unto GOD the Lord belong the issues from death.
verses.modern: He who is our God is the God of salvation; and to GOD the Lord belong the issues from death.

verses.kjv: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.
verses.modern: Surely God will crush the heads of His enemies, the hairy crowns of those who go on in their sins.

verses.kjv: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:
verses.modern: The Lord says, "I will bring them from Bashan; I will bring them from the depths of the sea,

verses.kjv: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, and the tongue of thy dogs in the same.
verses.modern: that Your feet may wade in the blood of Your foes, while the tongues of Your dogs have their share."

verses.kjv: They have seen thy goings, O God; even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.
verses.modern: Your procession, God, has come into view, the procession of my God and King into the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.
verses.modern: In front are the singers, after them the musicians; with them are the young women playing the timbrels.

verses.kjv: Bless ye God in the congregations, even the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.
verses.modern: Praise God in the great congregation; praise the LORD in the assembly of Israel.

verses.kjv: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
verses.modern: There is the little tribe of Benjamin, leading them, there the great throng of Judah's princes, and there the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali.

verses.kjv: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.
verses.modern: Summon Your power, God; show us Your strength, our God, as You have done before.

verses.kjv: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.
verses.modern: Because of Your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring You gifts.

verses.kjv: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people that delight in war.
verses.modern: Rebuke the beast among the reeds, the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations. Humbled, may the beast bring bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.

verses.kjv: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.
verses.modern: Envoys will come from Egypt; Cush will submit herself to God.

verses.kjv: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:
verses.modern: Sing to God, You kingdoms of the earth, sing praise to the Lord,

verses.kjv: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.
verses.modern: to him who rides across the highest heavens, the ancient heavens, who thunders with mighty voice.

verses.kjv: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.
verses.modern: Proclaim the power of God, whose majesty is over Israel, whose power is in the heavens.

verses.kjv: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.
verses.modern: You, God, are awesome in Your sanctuary; the God of Israel gives power and strength to His people. Praise be to God!

chapters.summary: The psalmist calls on God to arise and scatter His enemies like smoke. He celebrates the LORD as a father of the fatherless, a God who rides on the heavens and led His people through the wilderness. He recounts God's triumphant ascent to the high place, receiving gifts for men, and praises His awesome power from the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.
verses.modern: Save me, O God, for the waters have come up to my neck.

verses.kjv: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
verses.modern: I sink in the miry depths, where there is no foothold. I have come into the deep waters; the floods engulf me.

verses.kjv: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
verses.modern: I am worn out calling for help; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.

verses.kjv: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.
verses.modern: Those who hate me without reason outnumber the hairs of my head; many are my enemies without cause, those who seek to destroy me. I am forced to restore what I did not steal.

verses.kjv: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.
verses.modern: You, God, know my folly; my guilt is not hidden from You.

verses.kjv: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.
verses.modern: Let not those who wait on You, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake; let not those who seek You be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.

verses.kjv: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.
verses.modern: For I endure scorn for Your sake, and shame covers my face.

verses.kjv: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's children.
verses.modern: I am a foreigner to my own family, a stranger to my own mother's children;

verses.kjv: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.
verses.modern: for zeal for Your house consumes me, and the insults of those who insult You fall on me.

verses.kjv: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.
verses.modern: When I weep and fast, I must endure scorn;

verses.kjv: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.
verses.modern: when I put on sackcloth, people make sport of me.

verses.kjv: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.
verses.modern: Those who sit at the gate mock me. I am the song of the drunkards.

verses.kjv: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O LORD, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.
verses.modern: But as for me, my prayer is to You, O LORD, in an acceptable time; O God, in the multitude of Your mercy hear me, in the truth of Your salvation.

verses.kjv: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
verses.modern: Rescue me from the mire, do not let me sink; deliver me from those who hate me, from the deep waters.

verses.kjv: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
verses.modern: Do not let the floodwaters engulf me or the depths swallow me up or the pit close its mouth over me.

verses.kjv: Hear me, O LORD; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.
verses.modern: Hear me, O LORD, for Your lovingkindness is good; turn to me according to the multitude of Your tender mercies.

verses.kjv: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.
verses.modern: Do not hide Your face from Your servant; answer me quickly, for I am in trouble.

verses.kjv: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.
verses.modern: Come near and rescue me; deliver me because of my foes.

verses.kjv: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.
verses.modern: You know how I am scorned, disgraced and shamed; all my enemies are before You.

verses.kjv: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.
verses.modern: Scorn has broken my heart and has left me helpless; I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters. But I found none.

verses.kjv: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
verses.modern: They put gall in my food and gave me vinegar for my thirst.

verses.kjv: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.
verses.modern: May the table set before them become a snare; may it become retribution and a trap.

verses.kjv: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.
verses.modern: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see. Their backs be bent forever.

verses.kjv: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.
verses.modern: Pour out Your wrath on them; let Your fierce anger overtake them.

verses.kjv: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.
verses.modern: May their place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in their tents.

verses.kjv: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.
verses.modern: For they persecute those You wound and talk about the pain of those You hurt.

verses.kjv: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.
verses.modern: Charge them with crime upon crime; do not let them share in Your salvation.

verses.kjv: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.
verses.modern: May they be blotted out of the book of life and not be listed with the righteous.

verses.kjv: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.
verses.modern: But as for me, afflicted and in pain — may Your salvation, God, protect me.

verses.kjv: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
verses.modern: I will praise God's name in song and glorify Him with thanksgiving.

verses.kjv: This also shall please the LORD better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
verses.modern: This will please the LORD more than an ox, more than a bull with its horns and hooves.

verses.kjv: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.
verses.modern: The poor will see and be glad — you who seek God, may Your hearts live!

verses.kjv: For the LORD heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.
verses.modern: The LORD hears the needy and does not despise His captive people.

verses.kjv: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.
verses.modern: Let heaven and earth praise Him, the seas and all that move in them,
