verses.kjv: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.
verses.modern: for God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah. Then people will settle there and possess it;

verses.kjv: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
verses.modern: the children of His servants will inherit it, and those who love his name will dwell there.

chapters.summary: The psalmist sinks in deep mire as waters rise to his neck, crying for God to save him. Zeal for God's house has consumed him, and the reproaches of those who reproach God have fallen on him. He prophetically describes being given gall and vinegar to drink and calls on God to vindicate him -- a psalm the apostles applied to Christ's suffering.

verses.kjv: Make haste, O God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O LORD.
verses.modern: Hasten, O God, to save me; come quickly, LORD, to help me.

verses.kjv: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.
verses.modern: May those who want to take my life be put to shame and confusion; may all who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

verses.kjv: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.
verses.modern: May those who say to me, "Aha! Aha!" turn back because of their shame.

verses.kjv: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
verses.modern: But may all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who long for Your saving help always say, "The LORD is great!"

verses.kjv: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD, make no tarrying.
verses.modern: But as for me, I am poor and needy; come quickly to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; LORD, do not delay.

chapters.summary: The psalmist urgently pleads for God to hasten to deliver him. He asks that those who seek his life be put to shame, while those who seek God rejoice. Poor and needy, he declares God is his help and deliverer and begs the LORD not to delay.

verses.kjv: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.
verses.modern: In You, LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.

verses.kjv: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.
verses.modern: In Your righteousness, rescue me and deliver me; turn Your ear to me and save me.

verses.kjv: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.
verses.modern: Be my rock of refuge, to which I can always go; give the command to save me, for You are my rock and my fortress.

verses.kjv: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
verses.modern: Deliver me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of those who are evil and cruel.

verses.kjv: For thou art my hope, O Lord GOD: thou art my trust from my youth.
verses.modern: For You are my hope, O Lord GOD; You are my trust from my youth.

verses.kjv: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.
verses.modern: From birth I have relied on You; You brought me forth from my mother's womb. I will ever praise You.

verses.kjv: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.
verses.modern: I have become a sign to many; You are my strong refuge.

verses.kjv: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.
verses.modern: My mouth is filled with Your praise, declaring Your splendor all day long.

verses.kjv: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.
verses.modern: Do not cast me away when I am old; do not forsake me when my strength is gone.

verses.kjv: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,
verses.modern: For my enemies speak against me; those who wait to kill me conspire together.

verses.kjv: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.
verses.modern: They say, "God has forsaken Him; pursue Him and seize Him, for no one will rescue him."

verses.kjv: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.
verses.modern: Do not be far from me, my God; come quickly, God, to help me.

verses.kjv: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.
verses.modern: May my accusers perish in shame; may those who want to harm me be covered with scorn and disgrace.

verses.kjv: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.
verses.modern: As for me, I will always have hope; I will praise You more and more.

verses.kjv: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.
verses.modern: My mouth will tell of Your righteous deeds, of Your saving acts all day long — though I know not how to relate them all.

verses.kjv: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.
verses.modern: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD; I will make mention of Your righteousness, even of Yours only.

verses.kjv: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.
verses.modern: Since my youth, God, You have taught me, and to this day I declare Your marvelous deeds.

verses.kjv: Now also when I am old and greyheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.
verses.modern: Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, my God, till I declare Your power to the next generation, Your mighty acts to all who are to come.

verses.kjv: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!
verses.modern: Your righteousness, God, reaches to the heavens, You who have done great things. Who is like You, God?

verses.kjv: Thou, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
verses.modern: Though You have made me see troubles, many and bitter, You will restore my life again; from the depths of the earth You will again bring me up.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.
verses.modern: You will increase my honor and comfort me once more.

verses.kjv: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.
verses.modern: I will praise You with the harp for Your faithfulness, my God; I will sing praise to You with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.
verses.modern: My lips will shout for joy when I sing praise to You — I whom You have delivered.

verses.kjv: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.
verses.modern: My tongue will tell of Your righteous acts all day long, for those who wanted to harm me have been put to shame and confusion.

chapters.summary: The psalmist, now old and gray-headed, takes refuge in the LORD who has been his trust from youth and his hope from his mother's womb. He asks God not to cast him off in the time of old age, and vows to praise God's righteousness and declare His wondrous works to the next generation.

verses.kjv: Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.
verses.modern: Endow the king with your justice, O God, the royal son with Your righteousness.

verses.kjv: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.
verses.modern: May he judge your people in righteousness, your afflicted ones with justice.

verses.kjv: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.
verses.modern: May the mountains bring prosperity to the people, the hills the fruit of righteousness.

verses.kjv: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.
verses.modern: May he defend the afflicted among the people and save the children of the needy; may he crush the oppressor.

verses.kjv: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.
verses.modern: May he endure as long as the sun, as long as the moon, through all generations.

verses.kjv: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.
verses.modern: May he be like rain falling on a mown field, like showers watering the earth.

verses.kjv: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.
verses.modern: In his days may the righteous flourish and prosperity abound till the moon is no more.

verses.kjv: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.
verses.modern: May he rule from sea to sea and from the River to the ends of the earth.

verses.kjv: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.
verses.modern: May the desert tribes bow before him and his enemies lick the dust.

verses.kjv: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
verses.modern: May the kings of Tarshish and of distant shores bring tribute to him. May the kings of Sheba and Seba present him gifts.

verses.kjv: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.
verses.modern: May all kings bow down to him and all nations serve him.

verses.kjv: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.
verses.modern: For he will deliver the needy who cry out, the afflicted who have no one to help.

verses.kjv: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.
verses.modern: He will take pity on the weak and the needy and save the needy from death.

verses.kjv: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.
verses.modern: He will rescue them from oppression and violence, for precious is their blood in his sight.

verses.kjv: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.
verses.modern: Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him and bless him all day long.

verses.kjv: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
verses.modern: May grain abound throughout the land; on the tops of the hills may it sway. May the crops flourish like Lebanon and thrive like the grass of the field.

verses.kjv: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.
verses.modern: May his name endure forever; may it continue as long as the sun. Then all nations will be blessed through him. They will call him blessed.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.
verses.modern: Praise be to the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

verses.kjv: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.
verses.modern: Praise be to His glorious name forever; may the whole earth be filled with His glory. Amen and Amen.

verses.kjv: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
verses.modern: This concludes the prayers of David son of Jesse.

chapters.summary: The psalmist prays for the king to judge the people with righteousness and the poor with justice. The king's dominion shall reach from sea to sea, all kings shall fall down before him, and his name shall endure forever. The psalm closes with a doxology: blessed be the LORD God of Israel who alone does wondrous things.

verses.kjv: Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.
verses.modern: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

verses.kjv: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
verses.modern: But as for me, my feet had almost slipped; I had nearly lost my foothold.

verses.kjv: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
verses.modern: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

verses.kjv: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.
verses.modern: They have no struggles; their bodies are healthy and strong.

verses.kjv: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.
verses.modern: They are not in trouble as other men, nor are they plagued like other men.

verses.kjv: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.
verses.modern: Therefore pride is their necklace; they clothe themselves with violence.

verses.kjv: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.
verses.modern: From their callous hearts comes iniquity; their evil imaginations have no limits.

verses.kjv: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.
verses.modern: They scoff, and speak with malice; with arrogance they threaten oppression.

verses.kjv: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.
verses.modern: Their mouths lay claim to heaven. Their tongues take possession of the earth.

verses.kjv: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.
verses.modern: Therefore their people turn to them and drink up waters in abundance.

verses.kjv: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?
verses.modern: They say, "How would God know? Does the Most High know anything?"

verses.kjv: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.
verses.modern: This is what the wicked are like — always free of care, they go on amassing wealth.

verses.kjv: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.
verses.modern: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure and have washed my hands in innocence.

verses.kjv: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.
verses.modern: All day long I have been afflicted, and every morning brings new punishments.

verses.kjv: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.
verses.modern: If I had spoken out like that, I would have betrayed your children.

verses.kjv: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;
verses.modern: When I tried to understand all this, it troubled me deeply

verses.kjv: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.
verses.modern: till I entered the sanctuary of God; then I understood their final destiny.

verses.kjv: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.
verses.modern: Surely you place them on slippery ground; you cast them down to ruin.

verses.kjv: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.
verses.modern: How suddenly are they destroyed, completely swept away by terrors!

verses.kjv: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.
verses.modern: They are like a dream when one awakes; when you arise, Lord, you will despise them as fantasies.

verses.kjv: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.
verses.modern: When my heart was grieved and my spirit embittered,

verses.kjv: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.
verses.modern: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before you.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.
verses.modern: Yet I am always with you; you hold me by my right hand.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
verses.modern: You guide me with your counsel, and afterward you will take me into glory.

verses.kjv: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.
verses.modern: Whom have I in heaven but you? And earth has nothing I desire besides you.

verses.kjv: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
verses.modern: My flesh and my heart may fail. But God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

verses.kjv: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.
verses.modern: Those who are far from you will perish; you destroy all who are unfaithful to you.

verses.kjv: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all thy works.
verses.modern: But it is good for me to draw near to God; I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all Your works.

chapters.summary: The psalmist nearly stumbles when he envies the prosperity of the wicked, who seem to suffer no pain and grow fat with ease. But when he enters the sanctuary of God, he understands their end -- they are set in slippery places. He concludes that God is the strength of his heart and his portion forever.

verses.kjv: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?
verses.modern: O God, why have You rejected us forever? Why does Your anger smolder against the sheep of Your pasture?

verses.kjv: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.
verses.modern: Remember the nation you purchased long ago, the people of your inheritance, whom you redeemed — Mount Zion, where you lived.

verses.kjv: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.
verses.modern: Turn your steps toward these everlasting ruins, all this destruction the enemy has brought on the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.
verses.modern: Your enemies roar in the midst of your congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.

verses.kjv: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.
verses.modern: They behaved like men wielding axes to cut through a thicket of trees.

verses.kjv: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.
verses.modern: They smashed all the carved paneling with their axes and hatchets.

verses.kjv: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.
verses.modern: They burned your sanctuary to the ground; they defiled the dwelling place of your Name.

verses.kjv: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.
verses.modern: They said in their hearts, "We will crush them completely!" They burned every place where God was worshiped in the land.

verses.kjv: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.
verses.modern: We are given no signs from God; no prophets are left, and none of us knows how long this will be.

verses.kjv: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?
verses.modern: How long will the enemy mock you, God? Will the foe revile your name forever?

verses.kjv: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.
verses.modern: Why do you hold back your hand, your right hand? Take it from the folds of your garment and destroy them!

verses.kjv: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
verses.modern: But God is my King from long ago; He brings salvation on the earth.

verses.kjv: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.
verses.modern: It was you who split open the sea by your power; you broke the heads of the monster in the waters.

verses.kjv: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
verses.modern: It was you who crushed the heads of Leviathan and gave it as food to the creatures of the desert.

verses.kjv: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.
verses.modern: It was you who opened up springs and streams; you dried up the ever-flowing rivers.

verses.kjv: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
verses.modern: The day is yours, and yours also the night; you established the sun and moon.

verses.kjv: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.
verses.modern: It was you who set all the boundaries of the earth; you made both summer and winter.

verses.kjv: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O LORD, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.
verses.modern: Remember how the enemy has mocked you, LORD, how foolish people have reviled Your name.

verses.kjv: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.
verses.modern: Do not hand over the life of Your dove to wild beasts; do not forget the lives of Your afflicted people forever.

verses.kjv: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.
verses.modern: Have regard for Your covenant, because haunts of violence fill the dark places of the land.

verses.kjv: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.
verses.modern: Do not let the oppressed retreat in disgrace; may the poor and needy praise Your name.

verses.kjv: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.
verses.modern: Rise up, O God, and defend Your cause; remember how fools mock You all day long.

verses.kjv: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.
verses.modern: Do not ignore the clamor of Your adversaries, the uproar of Your enemies, which rises continually.

chapters.summary: The psalmist laments the destruction of the sanctuary, where enemies have roared, set up their ensigns, smashed the carved work, and burned God's dwelling place to the ground. He pleads with God to remember His covenant, arise, and no longer allow the foolish to reproach His name.

verses.kjv: Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.
verses.modern: We praise You, God, we praise You, for Your Name is near; people tell of Your wonderful deeds.

verses.kjv: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.
verses.modern: You say, "I choose the appointed time; it is I who judge with equity.

verses.kjv: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.
verses.modern: When the earth and all its people quake, it is I who hold its pillars firm.

verses.kjv: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
verses.modern: To the arrogant I say, 'Boast no more,' and to the wicked, 'Do not lift up your horns.

verses.kjv: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.
verses.modern: Do not lift your horns against heaven; do not speak so defiantly.' "

verses.kjv: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.
verses.modern: No one from the east or the west or from the desert can exalt themselves.

verses.kjv: But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.
verses.modern: It is God Who judges: He brings one down, He exalts another.

verses.kjv: For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.
verses.modern: In the hand of the LORD is a cup full of foaming wine mixed with spices; He pours it out. All the wicked of the earth drink it down to its very dregs.

verses.kjv: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.modern: As for me, I will declare this forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob,

verses.kjv: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
verses.modern: who says, "I will cut off the horns of all the wicked, but the horns of the righteous will be lifted up."

chapters.summary: The people give thanks because God's name is near and His wondrous works declare it. God speaks, warning the arrogant not to lift up the horn, for promotion comes neither from the east nor the west -- it is God who judges, putting down one and setting up another. The wicked shall drink the dregs of His cup of wrath.

verses.kjv: In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.
verses.modern: God is renowned in Judah; in Israel His name is great.

verses.kjv: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.
verses.modern: his tent is in Salem, his dwelling place in Zion.

verses.kjv: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.
verses.modern: There he broke the flashing arrows, the shields and the swords, the weapons of war.

verses.kjv: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.
verses.modern: You are radiant with light, more majestic than mountains rich with game.

verses.kjv: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.
verses.modern: The valiant lie plundered, they sleep their last sleep; not one of the warriors can lift his hands.

verses.kjv: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
verses.modern: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both horse and chariot lie still.

verses.kjv: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?
verses.modern: It is you alone who are to be feared. Who can stand before you when you are angry?

verses.kjv: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,
verses.modern: From heaven you pronounced judgment, and the land feared and was quiet —

verses.kjv: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.
verses.modern: when You, God, rose up to judge, to save all the afflicted of the land.

verses.kjv: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.
verses.modern: Human wrath brings you praise, and the survivors of your wrath are restrained.

verses.kjv: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
verses.modern: Make vows to the LORD Your God and fulfill them; let all the neighboring lands bring gifts to the One to be feared.

verses.kjv: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.
verses.modern: He breaks the spirit of rulers; He is feared by the kings of the earth.

chapters.summary: The psalmist celebrates God's victory from Zion, where He broke the weapons of war and judged the earth. All are called to fear the God who cuts off the spirit of rulers and terrifies the kings of the earth.

verses.kjv: I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.
verses.modern: I cried out to God for help; I cried out to God to hear me.

verses.kjv: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.
verses.modern: When I was in distress, I sought the Lord; at night I stretched out untiring hands. I would not be comforted.

verses.kjv: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
verses.modern: I remembered you, God. I groaned; I meditated, and my spirit grew faint.

verses.kjv: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
verses.modern: You kept my eyes from closing; I was too troubled to speak.

verses.kjv: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
verses.modern: I thought about the former days, the years of long ago;

verses.kjv: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
verses.modern: I remembered my songs in the night. My heart meditated and my spirit asked:

verses.kjv: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?
verses.modern: "Will the Lord reject forever? Will He never show His favor again?

verses.kjv: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?
verses.modern: Has his mercy vanished forever? Has his promise failed for all time?

verses.kjv: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
verses.modern: Has God forgotten to be merciful? Has He in anger withheld His compassion?"

verses.kjv: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.
verses.modern: Then I thought, "To this I will appeal: the years when the Most High stretched out His right hand.

verses.kjv: I will remember the works of the LORD: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.
verses.modern: I will remember the deeds of the LORD; yes, I will remember Your miracles of long ago.

verses.kjv: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.
verses.modern: I will consider all Your works and meditate on all Your mighty deeds."

verses.kjv: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?
verses.modern: Your ways, God, are holy. What god is as great as our God?

verses.kjv: Thou art the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.
verses.modern: You are the God Who performs miracles; You display Your power among the peoples.

verses.kjv: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
verses.modern: With your mighty arm you redeemed your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.

verses.kjv: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.
verses.modern: The waters saw You, God, the waters saw You and writhed; the very depths were convulsed.

verses.kjv: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.
verses.modern: The clouds poured down water, the heavens resounded with thunder; your arrows flashed back and forth.

verses.kjv: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.
verses.modern: Your thunder was heard in the whirlwind, your lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and quaked.

verses.kjv: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.
verses.modern: Your path led through the sea, your way through the mighty waters, though your footprints were not seen.

verses.kjv: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.modern: You led your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

chapters.summary: The psalmist cries out to God in deep distress, unable to sleep or be comforted, wondering whether the Lord has forgotten His mercy. He turns from despair to remembrance, recalling God's mighty works at the Red Sea and His faithful leading of Israel through Moses and Aaron.

verses.kjv: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
verses.modern: My people, hear my teaching; listen to the words of my mouth.

verses.kjv: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:
verses.modern: I will open my mouth with a parable; I will utter hidden things, things from of old —

verses.kjv: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
verses.modern: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

verses.kjv: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.
verses.modern: We will not hide them from their descendants; we will tell the next generation the praiseworthy deeds of the LORD, His power, and the wonders He has done.

verses.kjv: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:
verses.modern: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children,

verses.kjv: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:
verses.modern: so the next generation would know them, even the children yet to be born. They in turn would tell their children.

verses.kjv: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:
verses.modern: Then they would put their trust in God and would not forget His deeds but would keep His commands.

verses.kjv: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.
verses.modern: They would not be like their ancestors — a stubborn and rebellious generation, whose hearts were not loyal to God, whose spirits were not faithful to Him.

verses.kjv: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
verses.modern: The men of Ephraim, though armed with bows, turned back on the day of battle;

verses.kjv: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;
verses.modern: they did not keep God's covenant and refused to live by His law.

verses.kjv: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.
verses.modern: They forgot what he had done, the wonders he had shown them.

verses.kjv: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
verses.modern: He did miracles in the sight of their ancestors in the land of Egypt, in the region of Zoan.

verses.kjv: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.
verses.modern: He divided the sea and led them through; he made the water stand up like a wall.

verses.kjv: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.
verses.modern: He guided them with the cloud by day and with light from the fire all night.

verses.kjv: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.
verses.modern: He split the rocks in the wilderness and gave them water as abundant as the seas;

verses.kjv: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
verses.modern: he brought streams out of a rocky crag and made water flow down like rivers.

verses.kjv: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.
verses.modern: But they continued to sin against Him, rebelling in the wilderness against the Most High.

verses.kjv: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.
verses.modern: They willfully put God to the test by demanding the food they craved.

verses.kjv: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?
verses.modern: They spoke against God; they said, "Can God really spread a table in the wilderness?

verses.kjv: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?
verses.modern: True, He struck the rock, and water gushed out, streams flowed abundantly, but can He also give us bread? Can He supply meat for His people?"

verses.kjv: Therefore the LORD heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;
verses.modern: When the LORD heard them, He was furious; His fire broke out against Jacob. His wrath rose against Israel,

verses.kjv: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:
verses.modern: for they did not believe in God or trust in His deliverance.

verses.kjv: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,
verses.modern: Yet He gave a command to the skies above and opened the doors of the heavens;

verses.kjv: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.
verses.modern: he rained down manna for the people to eat, he gave them the grain of heaven.

verses.kjv: Man did eat angels' food: he sent them meat to the full.
verses.modern: Man ate angels' food; He sent them meat to the full.

verses.kjv: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.
verses.modern: He let loose the east wind from the heavens and by His power made the south wind blow.

verses.kjv: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:
verses.modern: He rained meat down on them like dust, birds like sand on the seashore.

verses.kjv: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.
verses.modern: He made them come down inside their camp, all around their tents.

verses.kjv: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;
verses.modern: They ate till they were gorged — he had given them what they craved.

verses.kjv: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,
verses.modern: But before they turned from what they craved, even while the food was still in their mouths,

verses.kjv: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.
verses.modern: God's anger rose against them; He put to death the sturdiest among them, cutting down the young men of Israel.

verses.kjv: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.
verses.modern: In spite of all this, they kept on sinning; in spite of His wonders, they did not believe.

verses.kjv: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.
verses.modern: So He ended their days in futility and their years in terror.

verses.kjv: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.
verses.modern: Whenever God slew them, they would seek Him; they eagerly turned to Him again.

verses.kjv: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.
verses.modern: They remembered that God was their Rock, that God Most High was their Redeemer.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.
verses.modern: But then they would flatter Him with their mouths, lying to Him with their tongues;

verses.kjv: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.
verses.modern: their hearts were not loyal to Him, they were not faithful to His covenant.

verses.kjv: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.
verses.modern: Yet He was merciful; He forgave their iniquities and did not destroy them. Time after time He restrained His anger and did not stir up His full wrath.

verses.kjv: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
verses.modern: He remembered that they were but flesh, a passing breeze that does not return.

verses.kjv: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!
verses.modern: How often they rebelled against Him in the wilderness and grieved Him in the wasteland!

verses.kjv: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.
verses.modern: Again and again they put God to the test; they vexed the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.
verses.modern: They did not remember His power — the day He redeemed them from the oppressor,

verses.kjv: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:
verses.modern: the day He displayed His signs in Egypt, His wonders in the region of Zoan.

verses.kjv: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.
verses.modern: He turned their river into blood; they could not drink from their streams.

verses.kjv: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
verses.modern: He sent swarms of flies that devoured them, and frogs that devastated them.

verses.kjv: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.
verses.modern: He gave their crops to the grasshopper, their produce to the locust.

verses.kjv: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.
verses.modern: He destroyed their vines with hail and their sycamore-figs with sleet.

verses.kjv: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
verses.modern: He gave over their cattle to the hail, their livestock to bolts of lightning.

verses.kjv: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.
verses.modern: He unleashed against them His hot anger, His wrath, indignation and hostility — a band of destroying angels.

verses.kjv: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;
verses.modern: He prepared a path for His anger; He did not spare them from death but gave them over to the plague.

verses.kjv: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:
verses.modern: He struck down all the firstborn of Egypt, the firstfruits of manhood in the tents of Ham.

verses.kjv: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
verses.modern: But he brought his people out like a flock; he led them like sheep through the wilderness.

verses.kjv: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
verses.modern: He guided them safely, so they were unafraid; but the sea engulfed their enemies.

verses.kjv: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.
verses.modern: so he brought them to the border of his holy land, to the hill country his right hand had taken.

verses.kjv: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
verses.modern: He drove out nations before them and allotted their lands to them as an inheritance; he settled the tribes of Israel in their homes.

verses.kjv: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:
verses.modern: But they put God to the test and rebelled against the Most High; they did not keep His statutes.

verses.kjv: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
verses.modern: Like their ancestors they were disloyal and faithless, as unreliable as a faulty bow.

verses.kjv: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
verses.modern: They angered Him with their high places; they aroused His jealousy with their idols.

verses.kjv: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:
verses.modern: When God heard them, He was furious; He rejected Israel completely.

verses.kjv: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
verses.modern: So that He forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which He placed among men,

verses.kjv: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.
verses.modern: He sent the ark of His might into captivity, His splendor into the hands of the enemy.

verses.kjv: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.
verses.modern: He gave His people over to the sword; He was furious with His inheritance.

verses.kjv: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.
verses.modern: Fire consumed their young men. Their young women had no wedding songs;

verses.kjv: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.
verses.modern: their priests were put to the sword. Their widows could not weep.

verses.kjv: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
verses.modern: Then the Lord awoke as if from sleep, as a warrior wakes from the stupor of wine.

verses.kjv: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.
verses.modern: He beat back His enemies; He put them to everlasting shame.

verses.kjv: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
verses.modern: Then he rejected the tents of Joseph, he did not choose the tribe of Ephraim;

verses.kjv: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.
verses.modern: but he chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which he loved.

verses.kjv: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.
verses.modern: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth that he established forever.

verses.kjv: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:
verses.modern: He chose David his servant and took him from the sheep pens;

verses.kjv: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.
verses.modern: from tending the sheep he brought him to be the shepherd of his people Jacob, of Israel his inheritance.

verses.kjv: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
verses.modern: David shepherded them with integrity of heart; with skillful hands he led them.

chapters.summary: Asaph recounts Israel's history from the exodus through the wilderness to David's kingship, tracing a pattern of God's mighty deliverance met by the people's stubborn rebellion. Despite Israel's repeated unfaithfulness, God shows compassion again and again, finally choosing Judah, Zion, and David to shepherd His people.

verses.kjv: O God, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.
verses.modern: O God, the nations have invaded your inheritance; they have defiled Your holy temple, they have reduced Jerusalem to rubble.

verses.kjv: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.
verses.modern: They have left the dead bodies of your servants as food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your own people for the animals of the wild.

verses.kjv: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.
verses.modern: They have poured out blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there is no one to bury the dead.

verses.kjv: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.
verses.modern: We are objects of contempt to our neighbors, of scorn and derision to those around us.

verses.kjv: How long, LORD? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?
verses.modern: How long, LORD? Will You be angry forever? How long will Your jealousy burn like fire?

verses.kjv: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.
verses.modern: Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge you, on the kingdoms that do not call on Your name;

verses.kjv: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.
verses.modern: for they have devoured Jacob and devastated his homeland.

verses.kjv: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.
verses.modern: Do not hold against us the sins of past generations; may your mercy come quickly to meet us, for we are in desperate need.

verses.kjv: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name's sake.
verses.modern: Help us, God our Savior, for the glory of your name; deliver us and forgive our sins for your name's sake.

verses.kjv: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.
verses.modern: Why should the nations say, "Where is their God?" Before our eyes, make known among the nations that you avenge the outpoured blood of your servants.

verses.kjv: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;
verses.modern: May the groans of the prisoners come before you; with your strong arm preserve those condemned to die.

verses.kjv: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.
verses.modern: Pay back into the laps of our neighbors seven times the contempt they have hurled at you, Lord.

verses.kjv: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.
verses.modern: Then we your people, the sheep of your pasture, will praise you forever; from generation to generation we will proclaim your praise.

chapters.summary: The psalmist laments the destruction of Jerusalem and the temple by invading nations, crying out to God over the unburied dead and the mockery of enemies. He pleads for God to pour out His wrath on the nations and to show mercy to His suffering people for the sake of His name.

verses.kjv: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.
verses.modern: Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock. You who sit enthroned between the cherubim, shine forth

verses.kjv: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.
verses.modern: before Ephraim, Benjamin and Manasseh. Awaken your might; come and save us.

verses.kjv: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.modern: Turn us again, O God, and cause Your countenance to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.kjv: O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?
verses.modern: O LORD God of hosts, how long will You be angry against the prayer of Your people?

verses.kjv: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.
verses.modern: You have fed them with the bread of tears; You have made them drink tears by the bowlful.

verses.kjv: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.
verses.modern: You have made us an object of contention to our neighbors, and our enemies mock us.

verses.kjv: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.modern: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause Your countenance to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.kjv: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.
verses.modern: You transplanted a vine from Egypt; You drove out the nations and planted it.

verses.kjv: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.
verses.modern: You cleared the ground for it. It took root and filled the land.

verses.kjv: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.
verses.modern: The mountains were covered with its shade, the mighty cedars with its branches.

verses.kjv: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.
verses.modern: Its branches reached as far as the Sea, its shoots as far as the River.

verses.kjv: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?
verses.modern: Why have You broken down its walls so that all who pass by pick its grapes?

verses.kjv: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.
verses.modern: Boars from the forest ravage it, and insects from the fields feed on it.

verses.kjv: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;
verses.modern: Return, we ask, O God of hosts; look down from heaven, see, and visit this vine,

verses.kjv: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.
verses.modern: the root Your right hand has planted, the son You have raised up for Yourself.

verses.kjv: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
verses.modern: It is burned with fire, it is cut down; they perish at the rebuke of Your countenance.

verses.kjv: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.
verses.modern: Let your hand rest on the man at your right hand, the son of man you have raised up for yourself.

verses.kjv: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.
verses.modern: Then we will not turn away from you; revive us. We will call on your name.

verses.kjv: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.modern: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause Your countenance to shine; and we shall be saved.

chapters.summary: The psalmist pleads with the Shepherd of Israel to shine forth and restore His people, using the image of a vine transplanted from Egypt that once filled the land but now lies broken and burned. The repeated refrain begs God to turn them again and cause His countenance to shine, that they may be saved.

verses.kjv: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.
verses.modern: Sing for joy to God our strength; shout aloud to the God of Jacob!

verses.kjv: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
verses.modern: Begin the music, strike the timbrel, play the melodious harp and lyre.

verses.kjv: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.
verses.modern: Sound the ram's horn at the New Moon, and when the moon is full, on the day of our festival;

verses.kjv: For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.
verses.modern: this is a decree for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

verses.kjv: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.
verses.modern: When God went out against Egypt, He established it as a statute for Joseph. I heard an unknown voice say:

verses.kjv: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.
verses.modern: "I removed the burden from their shoulders; their hands were set free from the basket.

verses.kjv: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
verses.modern: In your distress you called and I rescued you, I answered you out of a thundercloud; I tested you at the waters of Meribah.

verses.kjv: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;
verses.modern: Hear me, my people. I will warn you — if you would only listen to me, Israel!

verses.kjv: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.
verses.modern: You shall have no foreign god among you; you shall not worship any god other than me.

verses.kjv: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
verses.modern: I am the LORD Your God, Who brought You up out of Egypt. Open wide Your mouth and I will fill it.

verses.kjv: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.
verses.modern: But my people would not listen to me; Israel would not submit to me.

verses.kjv: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: and they walked in their own counsels.
verses.modern: So I gave them over to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices.

verses.kjv: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!
verses.modern: If my people would only listen to me, if Israel would only follow my ways,

verses.kjv: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.
verses.modern: how quickly I would subdue their enemies and turn my hand against their foes!

verses.kjv: The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.
verses.modern: Those who hate the LORD would cringe before Him. Their punishment would last forever.

verses.kjv: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.
verses.modern: But You would be fed with the finest of wheat; with honey from the rock I would satisfy You."

chapters.summary: God calls Israel to joyful worship, reminding them of His deliverance from Egypt and His longing to bless them. He laments that His people would not listen, and declares that if they had obeyed, He would have subdued their enemies and fed them with the finest wheat and honey from the rock.

verses.kjv: God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.
verses.modern: God presides in the great assembly; He renders judgment among the gods:

verses.kjv: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.
verses.modern: "How long will you defend the unjust and show partiality to the wicked?

verses.kjv: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.
verses.modern: Defend the weak and the fatherless; uphold the cause of the poor and the oppressed.

verses.kjv: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.modern: Rescue the weak and the needy; deliver them from the hand of the wicked.

verses.kjv: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.
verses.modern: The 'gods' know nothing, they understand nothing. They walk about in darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.

verses.kjv: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.
verses.modern: I said, 'You are gods; You are all sons of the Most High.'

verses.kjv: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.
verses.modern: But You shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

verses.kjv: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.
verses.modern: Rise up, O God, judge the earth, for all the nations are your inheritance.

chapters.summary: God stands in the divine assembly and rebukes the unjust rulers who show partiality to the wicked and fail to defend the poor and fatherless. He declares that though they are called gods, they will die like men, and He calls on God to rise up and judge the whole earth.

verses.kjv: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
verses.modern: O God, do not remain silent; do not turn a deaf ear, do not stand aloof, O God.

verses.kjv: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
verses.modern: See how Your enemies growl, how Your foes rear their heads.

verses.kjv: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.
verses.modern: With cunning they conspire against Your people; they plot against those You cherish.

verses.kjv: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
verses.modern: "Come," they say, "let us destroy them as a nation, so that Israel's name is remembered no more."

verses.kjv: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:
verses.modern: With one mind they plot together; they form an alliance against You —

verses.kjv: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
verses.modern: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,

verses.kjv: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;
verses.modern: Byblos, Ammon and Amalek, Philistia, with the people of Tyre.

verses.kjv: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.
verses.modern: Even Assyria has joined them to reinforce Lot's descendants.

verses.kjv: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
verses.modern: Do to them as you did to Midian, as you did to Sisera and Jabin at the river Kishon,

verses.kjv: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.
verses.modern: who perished at Endor and became like dung on the ground.

verses.kjv: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:
verses.modern: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

verses.kjv: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.
verses.modern: who said, "Let us take possession of the pasturelands of God."

verses.kjv: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.
verses.modern: Make them like tumbleweed, my God, like chaff before the wind.

verses.kjv: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;
verses.modern: As fire consumes the forest or a flame sets the mountains ablaze,

verses.kjv: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.
verses.modern: so pursue them with your tempest and terrify them with your storm.

verses.kjv: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.
verses.modern: Cover their faces with shame, LORD, so that they will seek Your name.

verses.kjv: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:
verses.modern: May they ever be ashamed and dismayed; may they perish in disgrace.

verses.kjv: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, art the most high over all the earth.
verses.modern: That men may know that You, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, are the Most High over all the earth.

chapters.summary: The psalmist urgently pleads with God not to remain silent as a coalition of nations conspires to destroy Israel and wipe out its name. He calls on God to do to these enemies what He did to Midian, Sisera, and Jabin, so that all may know that JEHOVAH alone is the Most High over all the earth.

verses.kjv: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!
verses.modern: How lovely are Your tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!

verses.kjv: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the LORD: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.
verses.modern: My soul yearns, even faints, for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

verses.kjv: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O LORD of hosts, my King, and my God.
verses.modern: Yes, the sparrow has found a house, and the swallow a nest for herself where she may lay her young — even Your altars, O LORD of hosts, my King and my God.

verses.kjv: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.
verses.modern: Blessed are those who dwell in Your house; they are ever praising You.

verses.kjv: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.
verses.modern: Blessed are those whose strength is in You, whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.

verses.kjv: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.
verses.modern: As they pass through the Valley of Baka, they make it a place of springs; the autumn rains also cover it with pools.

verses.kjv: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.
verses.modern: They go from strength to strength, till each appears before God in Zion.

verses.kjv: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.
verses.modern: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.

verses.kjv: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.
verses.modern: Behold, O God our shield, and look on the face of Your anointed.

verses.kjv: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
verses.modern: Better is one day in Your courts than a thousand elsewhere; I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.

verses.kjv: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
verses.modern: For the LORD God is a sun and shield; the LORD bestows favor and honor; no good thing does He withhold from those whose walk is blameless.

verses.kjv: O LORD of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.
verses.modern: O LORD of hosts, blessed is the man who trusts in you.

chapters.summary: The psalmist expresses deep longing for the courts of the LORD, declaring that even a single day in God's house is better than a thousand elsewhere. He pronounces blessings on those whose strength is in the LORD and who set their hearts on pilgrimage to Zion.

verses.kjv: LORD, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
verses.modern: You, LORD, showed favor to Your land; You restored the fortunes of Jacob.

verses.kjv: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
verses.modern: You forgave the iniquity of Your people and covered all their sins.

verses.kjv: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.
verses.modern: You set aside all Your wrath and turned from Your fierce anger.

verses.kjv: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.
verses.modern: Restore us again, God our Savior, and put away Your displeasure toward us.

verses.kjv: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
verses.modern: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You prolong Your anger through all generations?

verses.kjv: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
verses.modern: Will You not revive us again, that Your people may rejoice in You?

verses.kjv: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.
verses.modern: Show us Your mercy, LORD, and grant us Your salvation.

verses.kjv: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
verses.modern: I will hear what God the LORD will speak, for He will speak peace to His people and to His saints; but let them not turn again to folly.

verses.kjv: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
verses.modern: Surely His salvation is near those who fear Him, that glory may dwell in our land.

verses.kjv: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
verses.modern: Mercy and truth have met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

verses.kjv: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.
verses.modern: Faithfulness springs forth from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.

verses.kjv: Yea, the LORD shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.
verses.modern: The LORD will indeed give what is good, and our land will yield its harvest.

verses.kjv: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.
verses.modern: Righteousness goes before Him and prepares the way for His steps.

chapters.summary: The psalmist recalls how the LORD showed favor to His land and forgave His people, then pleads for revival and renewed mercy. He envisions a day when mercy and truth meet together, righteousness and peace kiss, and the LORD gives what is good so that the land yields its harvest.

verses.kjv: Bow down thine ear, O LORD, hear me: for I am poor and needy.
verses.modern: Hear me, LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

verses.kjv: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
verses.modern: Guard my life, for I am faithful to You; save Your servant who trusts in You. You are my God;

verses.kjv: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.
verses.modern: have mercy on me, Lord, for I call to You all day long.

verses.kjv: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
verses.modern: Bring joy to Your servant, Lord, for I put my trust in You.

verses.kjv: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.
verses.modern: For You, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, and plenteous in mercy to all who call on You.

verses.kjv: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.
verses.modern: Hear my prayer, LORD; listen to my cry for mercy.

verses.kjv: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.
verses.modern: When I am in distress, I call to You, because You answer me.

verses.kjv: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like unto thy works.
verses.modern: Among the gods there is none like You, Lord; no deeds can compare with Yours.

verses.kjv: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.
verses.modern: All the nations you have made will come and worship before You, Lord; they will bring glory to Your name.

verses.kjv: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God alone.
verses.modern: For You are great and do marvelous deeds; You alone are God.

verses.kjv: Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.
verses.modern: Teach me Your way, LORD, that I may rely on Your faithfulness; give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.

verses.kjv: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.
verses.modern: I will praise You, Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify Your name forever.

verses.kjv: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.
verses.modern: For great is Your mercy toward me; and You have delivered my soul from the lowest hell.

verses.kjv: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.
verses.modern: Arrogant foes are attacking me, O God; ruthless people are trying to kill me — they have no regard for You.

verses.kjv: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
verses.modern: But You, O Lord, are a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.

verses.kjv: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.
verses.modern: Turn to me and have mercy on me; show Your strength in behalf of Your servant; save me, the son of Your servant.

verses.kjv: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, LORD, hast holpen me, and comforted me.
verses.modern: Give me a sign of Your goodness, that my enemies may see it and be put to shame, for You, LORD, have helped me and comforted me.

chapters.summary: David pleads for mercy as a poor and needy servant, declaring that among the gods there is none like the LORD who is good, ready to forgive, and plenteous in mercy. He asks God for an undivided heart, protection from arrogant foes, and a sign of His goodness.

verses.kjv: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
verses.modern: He has founded his city on the holy mountain.

verses.kjv: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
verses.modern: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the other dwellings of Jacob.

verses.kjv: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.
verses.modern: Glorious things are said of You, city of God:

verses.kjv: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.
verses.modern: "I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me — Philistia too, and Tyre, along with Cush — and will say, 'This one was born in Zion.' "

verses.kjv: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
verses.modern: Indeed, of Zion it will be said, "This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High Himself will establish her."

verses.kjv: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.
verses.modern: The LORD will write in the register of the peoples: "This one was born in Zion."

verses.kjv: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.
verses.modern: As they make music they will sing, "All my fountains are in You."

chapters.summary: The psalmist celebrates Zion as God's beloved city, founded on the holy mountains and loved above all the dwellings of Jacob. God Himself registers the peoples of the nations as born in Zion, declaring that all the fountains of life spring from her.

verses.kjv: O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:
verses.modern: LORD, You are the God Who saves me; day and night I cry out to You.

verses.kjv: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;
verses.modern: May my prayer come before You; turn Your ear to my cry.

verses.kjv: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.
verses.modern: I am overwhelmed with troubles and my life draws near to death.

verses.kjv: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:
verses.modern: I am counted among those who go down to the pit; I am like one without strength.

verses.kjv: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.
verses.modern: I am set apart with the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom You remember no more, who are cut off from Your care.

verses.kjv: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
verses.modern: You have put me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

verses.kjv: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.
verses.modern: Your wrath lies heavily on me; You have overwhelmed me with all Your waves.

verses.kjv: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
verses.modern: You have taken from me my closest friends and have made me repulsive to them. I am confined and cannot escape;

verses.kjv: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.
verses.modern: my eyes are dim with grief. I call to You, LORD, every day; I spread out my hands to You.

verses.kjv: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.
verses.modern: Do You show Your wonders to the dead? Do their spirits rise up and praise You?

verses.kjv: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?
verses.modern: Shall Your lovingkindness be declared in the grave, or Your faithfulness in destruction?

verses.kjv: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
verses.modern: Are Your wonders known in the place of darkness, or Your righteous deeds in the land of oblivion?

verses.kjv: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.
verses.modern: But I cry to You for help, LORD; in the morning my prayer comes before You.

verses.kjv: LORD, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?
verses.modern: Why, LORD, do You reject me and hide Your face from me?

verses.kjv: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
verses.modern: From my youth I have suffered and been close to death; I have borne Your terrors and am in despair.

verses.kjv: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.
verses.modern: Your wrath has swept over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.

verses.kjv: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.
verses.modern: All day long they surround me like a flood; they have completely engulfed me.

verses.kjv: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.
verses.modern: You have taken from me friend and neighbor — darkness is my closest friend.

chapters.summary: The psalmist cries out from the brink of death, overwhelmed by God's wrath, abandoned by friends, and surrounded by darkness with no relief in sight. This is the darkest psalm in the Psalter — it ends without resolution, with darkness as the psalmist's only companion.

verses.kjv: I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
verses.modern: I will sing of the mercies of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will make known Your faithfulness to all generations.

verses.kjv: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.
verses.modern: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up forever; Your faithfulness You shall establish in the very heavens.

verses.kjv: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,
verses.modern: You said, "I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David my servant,

verses.kjv: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.
verses.modern: 'I will establish your line forever and make your throne firm through all generations.' "
