verses.kjv: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
verses.modern: The heavens praise Your wonders, LORD, Your faithfulness too, in the assembly of the holy ones.

verses.kjv: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?
verses.modern: For who in the skies above can compare with the LORD? Who is like the LORD among the heavenly beings?

verses.kjv: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.
verses.modern: In the council of the holy ones God is greatly feared; He is more awesome than all who surround Him.

verses.kjv: O LORD God of hosts, who is a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?
verses.modern: O LORD God of hosts, who is a strong LORD like You? Or to Your faithfulness round about You?

verses.kjv: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
verses.modern: You rule over the surging sea; when its waves mount up, You still them.

verses.kjv: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.
verses.modern: You crushed Rahab like one of the slain; with Your strong arm You scattered Your enemies.

verses.kjv: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
verses.modern: The heavens are Yours, and Yours also the earth; You founded the world and all that is in it.

verses.kjv: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.
verses.modern: You created the north and the south; Tabor and Hermon sing for joy at Your name.

verses.kjv: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.
verses.modern: Your arm is endowed with power; Your hand is strong, Your right hand exalted.

verses.kjv: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.
verses.modern: Justice and judgment are the habitation of Your throne; mercy and truth shall go before Your face.

verses.kjv: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.
verses.modern: Blessed are the people who know the joyful sound; they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of Your countenance.

verses.kjv: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.
verses.modern: They rejoice in Your name all day long; they celebrate Your righteousness.

verses.kjv: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.
verses.modern: For You are their glory and strength, and by Your favor You exalt our horn.

verses.kjv: For the LORD is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.
verses.modern: Indeed, our shield belongs to the LORD, our king to the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.
verses.modern: Then You spoke in vision to Your holy one, and said, "I have laid help on one who is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

verses.kjv: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:
verses.modern: I have found David my servant; with my sacred oil I have anointed him.

verses.kjv: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.
verses.modern: My hand will sustain him; surely my arm will strengthen him.

verses.kjv: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
verses.modern: The enemy will not get the better of him; the wicked will not oppress him.

verses.kjv: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.
verses.modern: I will crush his foes before him and strike down his adversaries.

verses.kjv: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
verses.modern: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him, and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

verses.kjv: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
verses.modern: I will set his hand over the sea, his right hand over the rivers.

verses.kjv: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.
verses.modern: He will call out to me, 'You are my Father, my God, the Rock my Savior.'

verses.kjv: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.
verses.modern: I will appoint him to be my firstborn, the most exalted of the kings of the earth.

verses.kjv: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
verses.modern: My mercy I will keep for him forever, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.

verses.kjv: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
verses.modern: I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.

verses.kjv: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;
verses.modern: If his sons forsake my law and do not follow my statutes,

verses.kjv: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
verses.modern: if they violate my decrees and fail to keep my commands,

verses.kjv: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
verses.modern: I will punish their sin with the rod, their iniquity with flogging;

verses.kjv: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
verses.modern: Nevertheless my lovingkindness I will not utterly take from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.

verses.kjv: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
verses.modern: I will not violate my covenant or alter what my lips have uttered.

verses.kjv: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.
verses.modern: Once for all, I have sworn by my holiness — and I will not lie to David —

verses.kjv: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.
verses.modern: that his line will continue forever and his throne endure before me like the sun;

verses.kjv: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.
verses.modern: it will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky."

verses.kjv: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
verses.modern: But you have cast off and abhorred; you have been angry with your anointed.

verses.kjv: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.
verses.modern: You have renounced the covenant with your servant and have defiled his crown in the dust.

verses.kjv: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.
verses.modern: You have broken through all his walls and reduced his strongholds to ruins.

verses.kjv: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
verses.modern: All who pass by have plundered him; he has become the scorn of his neighbors.

verses.kjv: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
verses.modern: You have exalted the right hand of his foes; you have made all his enemies rejoice.

verses.kjv: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.
verses.modern: Indeed, you have turned back the edge of his sword and have not supported him in battle.

verses.kjv: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.
verses.modern: You have put an end to his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.

verses.kjv: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
verses.modern: You have cut short the days of his youth; you have covered him with a mantle of shame.

verses.kjv: How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?
verses.modern: How long, LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? How long will Your wrath burn like fire?

verses.kjv: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?
verses.modern: Remember how short my time is; why have You made all men in vain?

verses.kjv: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.
verses.modern: Who can live and not see death, or who can escape the power of the grave?

verses.kjv: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?
verses.modern: Lord, where are your former lovingkindnesses, which you swore to David in your truth?

verses.kjv: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;
verses.modern: Remember, Lord, how your servant has been mocked, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the nations,

verses.kjv: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
verses.modern: with which Your enemies have reproached, O LORD; with which they have reproached the footsteps of Your anointed.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
verses.modern: Praise be to the LORD forever! Amen and Amen.

chapters.summary: Ethan celebrates God's covenant with David, praising His faithfulness and His sworn oath to establish David's throne forever. But the psalm turns to anguish as the psalmist confronts the apparent ruin of that covenant — the king is cast down, the crown defiled — and he cries out, asking how long the LORD will hide Himself.

verses.kjv: LORD, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.
verses.modern: Lord, you have been our dwelling place throughout all generations.

verses.kjv: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.
verses.modern: Before the mountains were born or you brought forth the whole world, from everlasting to everlasting you are God.

verses.kjv: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.
verses.modern: You turn man to destruction, and say, "Return, you children of men."

verses.kjv: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.
verses.modern: A thousand years in your sight are like a day that has just gone by, or like a watch in the night.

verses.kjv: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.
verses.modern: Yet you sweep people away in the sleep of death — they are like the new grass of the morning:

verses.kjv: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
verses.modern: In the morning it springs up new, but by evening it is dry and withered.

verses.kjv: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.
verses.modern: We are consumed by your anger and terrified by your indignation.

verses.kjv: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.
verses.modern: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your countenance.

verses.kjv: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.
verses.modern: All our days pass away under your wrath; we finish our years with a moan.

verses.kjv: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
verses.modern: Our days may come to seventy years, or eighty, if our strength endures; yet the best of them are but trouble and sorrow, for they quickly pass. We fly away.

verses.kjv: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.
verses.modern: If only we knew the power of your anger! Your wrath is as great as the fear that is your due.

verses.kjv: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
verses.modern: Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

verses.kjv: Return, O LORD, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.
verses.modern: Relent, LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on Your servants.

verses.kjv: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
verses.modern: O satisfy us early with Your mercy, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

verses.kjv: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.
verses.modern: Make us glad for as many days as You have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen trouble.

verses.kjv: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.
verses.modern: May Your deeds be shown to Your servants, Your splendor to their children.

verses.kjv: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
verses.modern: May the favor of the Lord our God rest on us; establish the work of our hands for us — yes, establish the work of our hands.

chapters.summary: Moses meditates on God's eternity against the brevity of human life, noting that a thousand years are like a day in God's sight and man's years are but seventy or eighty. He prays that God would teach His people to number their days, satisfy them with mercy, and establish the work of their hands.

verses.kjv: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.modern: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

verses.kjv: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
verses.modern: I will say of the LORD, "He is my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust."

verses.kjv: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.
verses.modern: Surely He will save You from the fowler's snare and from the deadly pestilence.

verses.kjv: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
verses.modern: He will cover You with His feathers, and under His wings You will find refuge; His faithfulness will be Your shield and rampart.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
verses.modern: You will not fear the terror of night, nor the arrow that flies by day,

verses.kjv: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
verses.modern: nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the plague that destroys at midday.

verses.kjv: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.
verses.modern: A thousand may fall at Your side, ten thousand at Your right hand. But It will not come near You.

verses.kjv: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.
verses.modern: You will only observe with your eyes and see the punishment of the wicked.

verses.kjv: Because thou hast made the LORD, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;
verses.modern: If You say, "The LORD is my refuge," and You make the Most High Your dwelling,

verses.kjv: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.
verses.modern: no harm will overtake You, no disaster will come near Your tent.

verses.kjv: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
verses.modern: For He will command His angels concerning You to guard You in all Your ways;

verses.kjv: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.modern: they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.
verses.modern: You will tread on the lion and the cobra; you will trample the great lion and the serpent.

verses.kjv: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
verses.modern: Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him; I will set him on high, because he has known my name.

verses.kjv: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.
verses.modern: He will call on me. I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble, I will deliver him and honor him.

verses.kjv: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.
verses.modern: With long life I will satisfy him and show him my salvation."

chapters.summary: The psalmist declares that whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will be protected from pestilence, terror, and every danger, with angels guarding their way. God Himself speaks the closing promise: because the faithful one has set his love on the LORD, He will deliver, honor, and satisfy him with long life.

verses.kjv: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:
verses.modern: It is good to praise the LORD and make music to Your name, O Most High,

verses.kjv: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,
verses.modern: to show forth Your lovingkindness in the morning, and Your faithfulness every night,

verses.kjv: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.
verses.modern: to the music of the ten-stringed lyre and the melody of the harp.

verses.kjv: For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
verses.modern: For You make me glad by Your deeds, LORD; I sing for joy at what Your hands have done.

verses.kjv: O LORD, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.
verses.modern: How great are Your works, LORD, how profound Your thoughts!

verses.kjv: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.
verses.modern: Senseless people do not know, fools do not understand,

verses.kjv: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:
verses.modern: that though the wicked spring up like grass and all evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.

verses.kjv: But thou, LORD, art most high for evermore.
verses.modern: But You, LORD, are forever exalted.

verses.kjv: For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
verses.modern: For surely Your enemies, LORD, surely Your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.

verses.kjv: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
verses.modern: But my horn You shall exalt like the horn of a unicorn; I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

verses.kjv: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.
verses.modern: My eyes have seen the defeat of my adversaries; my ears have heard the rout of my wicked foes.

verses.kjv: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.modern: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, they will grow like a cedar of Lebanon;

verses.kjv: Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.
verses.modern: planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.

verses.kjv: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;
verses.modern: They will still bear fruit in old age, they will stay fresh and green,

verses.kjv: To shew that the LORD is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
verses.modern: proclaiming, "The LORD is upright; He is my Rock, and there is no wickedness in Him."

chapters.summary: The psalmist declares it good to praise the LORD with music, rejoicing in God's works and the downfall of the wicked. While evildoers spring up like grass only to be destroyed, the righteous flourish like palm trees and cedars, bearing fruit even in old age.

verses.kjv: The LORD reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.
verses.modern: The LORD reigns, He is robed in majesty; the LORD is robed in majesty and armed with strength; indeed, the world is established, firm and secure.

verses.kjv: Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.
verses.modern: Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.

verses.kjv: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.
verses.modern: The seas have lifted up, LORD, the seas have lifted up their voice; the seas have lifted up their pounding waves.

verses.kjv: The LORD on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.
verses.modern: Mightier than the thunder of the great waters, mightier than the breakers of the sea — the LORD on high is mighty.

verses.kjv: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.
verses.modern: Your statutes, LORD, stand firm; holiness adorns Your house for endless days.

chapters.summary: The psalmist proclaims that the LORD reigns, robed in majesty and armed with strength, His throne established from all eternity. Mightier than the roaring seas, the LORD on high is supreme, and His statutes stand forever firm.

verses.kjv: O LORD God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.
verses.modern: The LORD is a God Who avenges. O God Who avenges, shine forth.

verses.kjv: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.
verses.modern: Rise up, Judge of the earth; pay back to the proud what they deserve.

verses.kjv: LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
verses.modern: How long, LORD, will the wicked, how long will the wicked be jubilant?

verses.kjv: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
verses.modern: They pour out arrogant words; all the evildoers are full of boasting.

verses.kjv: They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.
verses.modern: They crush Your people, LORD; they oppress Your inheritance.

verses.kjv: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.
verses.modern: They slay the widow and the foreigner; they murder the fatherless.

verses.kjv: Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.
verses.modern: They say, "The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob takes no notice."

verses.kjv: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?
verses.modern: Take notice, You senseless ones among the people; you fools, when will you become wise?

verses.kjv: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?
verses.modern: Does He who fashioned the ear not hear? Does he who formed the eye not see?

verses.kjv: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?
verses.modern: Does He who disciplines nations not punish? Does he who teaches mankind lack knowledge?

verses.kjv: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.
verses.modern: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.

verses.kjv: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, and teachest him out of thy law;
verses.modern: Blessed is the one You discipline, LORD, the one You teach from Your law;

verses.kjv: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.
verses.modern: you grant them relief from days of trouble, till a pit is dug for the wicked.

verses.kjv: For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
verses.modern: For the LORD will not reject His people; He will never forsake His inheritance.

verses.kjv: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.
verses.modern: Judgment will again be founded on righteousness. All the upright in heart will follow it.

verses.kjv: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
verses.modern: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will take a stand for me against evildoers?

verses.kjv: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.
verses.modern: Unless the LORD had given me help, I would soon have lived in the silence of death.

verses.kjv: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.
verses.modern: When I said, "My foot slips," Your mercy, O LORD, held me up.

verses.kjv: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
verses.modern: When anxiety was great within me, Your consolation brought me joy.

verses.kjv: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?
verses.modern: Can a corrupt throne be allied with You — a throne that brings on misery by its decrees?

verses.kjv: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
verses.modern: The wicked band together against the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.

verses.kjv: But the LORD is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.
verses.modern: But the LORD has become my fortress, and my God the rock in whom I take refuge.

verses.kjv: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the LORD our God shall cut them off.
verses.modern: He will repay them for their sins and destroy them for their wickedness; the LORD our God will destroy them.

chapters.summary: The psalmist calls on the God of vengeance to rise up against the wicked who crush His people, slay the widow, and murder the fatherless. He finds comfort in knowing that the LORD will not abandon His inheritance, and that God's discipline brings blessing while the wicked face certain destruction.

verses.kjv: O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
verses.modern: Come, let us sing for joy to the LORD; let us shout aloud to the Rock of our salvation.

verses.kjv: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
verses.modern: Let us come before Him with thanksgiving and extol Him with music and song.

verses.kjv: For the LORD is a great God, and a great King above all gods.
verses.modern: For the LORD is the great God, the great King above all gods.

verses.kjv: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.
verses.modern: In His hand are the depths of the earth, and the mountain peaks belong to Him.

verses.kjv: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.
verses.modern: The sea is His, for He made it. His hands formed the dry land.

verses.kjv: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
verses.modern: Come, let us bow down in worship, let us kneel before the LORD our Maker;

verses.kjv: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,
verses.modern: for He is our God and we are the people of his pasture, the flock under his care. Today, if only You would hear His voice,

verses.kjv: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
verses.modern: "Do not harden Your hearts as You did at Meribah, as You did that day at Massah in the wilderness,

verses.kjv: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.
verses.modern: when Your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.

verses.kjv: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:
verses.modern: For forty years I was angry with that generation; I said, 'They are a people whose hearts go astray. They have not known my ways.'

verses.kjv: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.
verses.modern: So I declared on oath in my anger, 'They shall never enter my rest.' "

chapters.summary: The psalmist calls the people to sing joyfully to the LORD, their Maker and Shepherd, and to worship before Him with thanksgiving. He warns them not to harden their hearts as Israel did at Meribah and Massah, where God swore in His wrath that the rebellious generation would never enter His rest.

verses.kjv: O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.
verses.modern: Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.

verses.kjv: Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.
verses.modern: Sing to the LORD, praise His name; proclaim His salvation day after day.

verses.kjv: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.
verses.modern: Declare His glory among the nations, his marvelous deeds among all peoples.

verses.kjv: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.
verses.modern: For great is the LORD and most worthy of praise; He is to be feared above all gods.

verses.kjv: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.
verses.modern: For all the gods of the nations are idols. But The LORD made the heavens.

verses.kjv: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
verses.modern: Splendor and majesty are before Him; strength and glory are in His sanctuary.

verses.kjv: Give unto the LORD, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
verses.modern: Ascribe to the LORD, all You families of nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

verses.kjv: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.
verses.modern: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and come into His courts.

verses.kjv: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.
verses.modern: Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness; tremble before Him, all the earth.

verses.kjv: Say among the heathen that the LORD reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.
verses.modern: Say among the nations, "The LORD reigns." The world is firmly established, it cannot be moved; He will judge the peoples with equity.

verses.kjv: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.
verses.modern: Let the heavens rejoice, let the earth be glad; let the sea resound. All that is in it.

verses.kjv: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
verses.modern: Let the fields be jubilant, and everything in them; let all the trees of the forest sing for joy.

verses.kjv: Before the LORD: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.
verses.modern: Let all creation rejoice before the LORD, for He comes, He comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in His faithfulness.

chapters.summary: The psalmist calls all the earth to sing a new song to the LORD, declaring His glory among the nations and proclaiming that all other gods are mere idols. Creation itself — the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the trees of the forest — rejoices because the LORD comes to judge the world in righteousness.

verses.kjv: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.
verses.modern: The LORD reigns, let the earth be glad; let the distant shores rejoice.

verses.kjv: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.
verses.modern: Clouds and thick darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice are the foundation of His throne.

verses.kjv: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.
verses.modern: Fire goes before Him and consumes His foes on every side.

verses.kjv: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.
verses.modern: His lightning lights up the world; the earth sees and trembles.

verses.kjv: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.modern: The mountains melt like wax before the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.

verses.kjv: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.
verses.modern: The heavens proclaim His righteousness. All peoples see His glory.

verses.kjv: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.
verses.modern: All who worship images are put to shame, those who boast in idols — worship Him, all You gods!

verses.kjv: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.
verses.modern: Zion hears and rejoices and the villages of Judah are glad because of Your judgments, LORD.

verses.kjv: For thou, LORD, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.
verses.modern: For You, LORD, are the Most High over all the earth; You are exalted far above all gods.

verses.kjv: Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.modern: Let those who love the LORD hate evil, for He guards the lives of His faithful ones and delivers them from the hand of the wicked.

verses.kjv: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.modern: Light shines on the righteous and joy on the upright in heart.

verses.kjv: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.modern: Rejoice in the LORD, You who are righteous, and praise His holy name.

chapters.summary: The psalmist proclaims that the LORD reigns in fire and lightning, melting mountains like wax and putting all idol-worshipers to shame. Zion rejoices at His judgments, and those who love the LORD are called to hate evil, for light and gladness are sown for the righteous.

verses.kjv: O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.
verses.modern: Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done marvelous things; His right hand and His holy arm have worked salvation for Him.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.
verses.modern: The LORD has made His salvation known and revealed His righteousness to the nations.

verses.kjv: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.modern: He has remembered His mercy and His truth toward the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

verses.kjv: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
verses.modern: Shout for joy to the LORD, all the earth, burst into jubilant song with music;

verses.kjv: Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.
verses.modern: make music to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the sound of singing,

verses.kjv: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.
verses.modern: with trumpets and the blast of the ram's horn — shout for joy before the LORD, the King.

verses.kjv: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.modern: Let the sea resound, and everything in it, the world. All who live in it.

verses.kjv: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together
verses.modern: Let the rivers clap their hands, let the mountains sing together for joy;

verses.kjv: Before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.
verses.modern: let them sing before the LORD, for He comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples with equity.

chapters.summary: The psalmist calls for a new song because the LORD has revealed His salvation to the nations, remembering His mercy and truth toward Israel. All creation — the sea, the rivers, and the mountains — is summoned to shout for joy before the LORD who comes to judge the earth with righteousness and equity.

verses.kjv: The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.
verses.modern: The LORD reigns, let the nations tremble; he sits enthroned between the cherubim, let the earth shake.

verses.kjv: The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.
verses.modern: Great is the LORD in Zion; He is exalted over all the nations.

verses.kjv: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.
verses.modern: Let them praise Your great and awesome name — he is holy.

verses.kjv: The king's strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.modern: The King is mighty, he loves justice — you have established equity; in Jacob you have done what is just and right.

verses.kjv: Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.
verses.modern: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His footstool; He is holy.

verses.kjv: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.
verses.modern: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who called on his name; they called on the LORD and He answered them.

verses.kjv: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.
verses.modern: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept His statutes and the decrees He gave them.

verses.kjv: Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.
verses.modern: LORD our God, You answered them; You were to Israel a forgiving God, though You punished their misdeeds.

verses.kjv: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.
verses.modern: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.

chapters.summary: The psalmist declares that the LORD reigns from His throne between the cherubim, exalted over all the nations in holiness. Moses, Aaron, and Samuel called on Him and He answered; He is a God who forgives yet also punishes wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.
verses.modern: Shout for joy to the LORD, all the earth.

verses.kjv: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
verses.modern: Worship the LORD with gladness; come before Him with joyful songs.

verses.kjv: Know ye that the LORD he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.modern: Know that the LORD is God. It is He who made us. We are his; we are his people, the sheep of His pasture.

verses.kjv: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
verses.modern: Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and praise His name.

verses.kjv: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.
verses.modern: For the LORD is good; His mercy is everlasting, and His truth endures to all generations.

chapters.summary: The psalmist calls all the earth to shout for joy and worship the LORD with gladness, entering His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise. He declares that the LORD is good, His mercy everlasting, and His truth endures to all generations.

verses.kjv: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.
verses.modern: I will sing of mercy and judgment; to You, O LORD, I will sing.

verses.kjv: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
verses.modern: I will be careful to lead a blameless life — when will You come to me? I will conduct the affairs of my house with a blameless heart.

verses.kjv: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.
verses.modern: I will not look with approval on anything that is vile. I hate what faithless people do; I will have no part in it.

verses.kjv: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.
verses.modern: The perverse of heart shall be far from me; I will have nothing to do with what is evil.

verses.kjv: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.
verses.modern: Whoever slanders their neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; whoever has haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not tolerate.

verses.kjv: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.
verses.modern: My eyes will be on the faithful in the land, that they may dwell with me; the one whose walk is blameless will minister to me.

verses.kjv: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
verses.modern: No one who practices deceit will dwell in my house; no one who speaks falsely will stand in my presence.

verses.kjv: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.
verses.modern: Every morning I will put to silence all the wicked in the land; I will cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.

chapters.summary: David pledges to conduct himself and his household with integrity, refusing to set any wicked thing before his eyes and cutting off slanderers and the proud. He resolves to surround himself with the faithful and to banish all deceit and wickedness from the city of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come unto thee.
verses.modern: Hear my prayer, LORD; let my cry for help come to You.

verses.kjv: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.
verses.modern: Do not hide Your face from me when I am in distress. Turn Your ear to me; when I call, answer me quickly.

verses.kjv: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
verses.modern: For my days vanish like smoke; my bones burn like glowing embers.

verses.kjv: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.
verses.modern: My heart is blighted and withered like grass; I forget to eat my food.

verses.kjv: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
verses.modern: In my distress I groan aloud and am reduced to skin and bones.

verses.kjv: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
verses.modern: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.

verses.kjv: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
verses.modern: I lie awake; I have become like a bird alone on a rooftop.

verses.kjv: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
verses.modern: All day long my enemies taunt me; those who rail against me use my name as a curse.

verses.kjv: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping.
verses.modern: For I eat ashes as my food and mingle my drink with tears

verses.kjv: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
verses.modern: because of Your great wrath, for You have taken me up and thrown me aside.

verses.kjv: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.
verses.modern: My days are like the evening shadow; I wither away like grass.

verses.kjv: But thou, O LORD, shall endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.
verses.modern: But You, LORD, sit enthroned forever; Your renown endures through all generations.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
verses.modern: You will arise and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show favor to her; the appointed time has come.

verses.kjv: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.
verses.modern: For her stones are dear to Your servants; her very dust moves them to pity.

verses.kjv: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
verses.modern: The nations will fear the name of the LORD, all the kings of the earth will revere Your glory.

verses.kjv: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.
verses.modern: For the LORD will rebuild Zion and appear in His glory.

verses.kjv: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
verses.modern: He will respond to the prayer of the destitute; He will not despise their plea.

verses.kjv: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.
verses.modern: Let this be written for a future generation, that a people not yet created may praise the LORD.

verses.kjv: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth;
verses.modern: The LORD looked down from His sanctuary on high, from heaven He viewed the earth,

verses.kjv: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;
verses.modern: to hear the groans of the prisoners and release those condemned to death.

verses.kjv: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
verses.modern: So the name of the LORD will be declared in Zion and His praise in Jerusalem

verses.kjv: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
verses.modern: when the peoples and the kingdoms assemble to worship the LORD.

verses.kjv: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
verses.modern: In the course of my life He broke my strength; He cut short my days.

verses.kjv: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.
verses.modern: So I said: "Do not take me away, my God, in the midst of my days; Your years go on through all generations.

verses.kjv: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.
verses.modern: In the beginning You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.

verses.kjv: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
verses.modern: They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing You will change them and they will be discarded.

verses.kjv: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.
verses.modern: But You remain the same, and Your years will never end.

verses.kjv: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.
verses.modern: The children of Your servants will live in Your presence; their descendants will be established before You."

chapters.summary: The afflicted psalmist pours out his complaint, describing his days vanishing like smoke and his body wasting away in lonely grief. Yet he turns from his suffering to God's eternal throne, trusting that the LORD will rebuild Zion, appear in glory, and show compassion on a future generation.

verses.kjv: Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
verses.modern: Praise the LORD, my soul; all my inmost being, praise His holy name.

verses.kjv: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
verses.modern: Praise the LORD, my soul, and forget not all His benefits —

verses.kjv: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;
verses.modern: who forgives all Your sins and heals all Your diseases,

verses.kjv: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
verses.modern: who redeems Your life from destruction, who crowns You with lovingkindness and tender mercies,

verses.kjv: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.
verses.modern: who satisfies Your desires with good things so that Your youth is renewed like the eagle's.

verses.kjv: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.
verses.modern: The LORD works righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.

verses.kjv: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.
verses.modern: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
verses.modern: The LORD is merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy.

verses.kjv: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.
verses.modern: He will not always accuse, nor will He harbor His anger forever;

verses.kjv: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
verses.modern: he does not treat us as our sins deserve or repay us according to our iniquities.

verses.kjv: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.
verses.modern: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is His mercy toward those who fear Him.

verses.kjv: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
verses.modern: as far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.

verses.kjv: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.
verses.modern: As a father has compassion on His children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him;

verses.kjv: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
verses.modern: for He knows how we are formed, He remembers that we are dust.

verses.kjv: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
verses.modern: As for man, His days are as grass; as a flower of the field, so He flourishes.

verses.kjv: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.
verses.modern: the wind blows over it and it is gone, and its place remembers it no more.

verses.kjv: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children;
verses.modern: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting on those who fear Him, and His righteousness to children's children,

verses.kjv: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.
verses.modern: with those who keep His covenant and remember to obey His precepts.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.
verses.modern: The LORD has established His throne in heaven. His kingdom rules over all.

verses.kjv: Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.
verses.modern: Praise the LORD, You His angels, You mighty ones who do His bidding, who obey His word.

verses.kjv: Bless ye the LORD, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
verses.modern: Praise the LORD, all His heavenly hosts, You His servants who do his will.

verses.kjv: Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.
verses.modern: Praise the LORD, all His works everywhere in His dominion. Praise the LORD, my soul.

chapters.summary: David calls his soul to bless the LORD, cataloging God's benefits — forgiveness, healing, redemption, lovingkindness, and the renewal of youth. He celebrates God's mercy, which is as high as the heavens, His compassion like a father's, and His covenant love that endures from everlasting to everlasting on those who fear Him.

verses.kjv: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.
verses.modern: Praise the LORD, my soul. LORD my God, You are very great; You are clothed with splendor and majesty.

verses.kjv: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:
verses.modern: The LORD wraps Himself in light as with a garment; He stretches out the heavens like a tent

verses.kjv: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:
verses.modern: lays the beams of His upper chambers on their waters. He makes the clouds his chariot and rides on the wings of the wind.

verses.kjv: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:
verses.modern: He makes winds His messengers, flames of fire His servants.

verses.kjv: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.
verses.modern: He set the earth on its foundations; it can never be moved.

verses.kjv: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.
verses.modern: You covered it with the watery depths as with a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.

verses.kjv: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.
verses.modern: But at Your rebuke the waters fled, at the sound of Your thunder they took to flight;

verses.kjv: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.
verses.modern: they flowed over the mountains, they went down into the valleys, to the place You assigned for them.

verses.kjv: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.
verses.modern: You set a boundary they cannot cross; never again will they cover the earth.

verses.kjv: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.
verses.modern: He makes springs pour water into the ravines; it flows between the mountains.

verses.kjv: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.
verses.modern: They give water to all the animals of the wild; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.

verses.kjv: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.
verses.modern: The birds of the sky nest by the waters; they sing among the branches.

verses.kjv: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.
verses.modern: He waters the mountains from His upper chambers; the land is satisfied by the fruit of His work.

verses.kjv: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
verses.modern: He makes grass grow for the cattle, and plants for people to cultivate — bringing forth food from the earth:

verses.kjv: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man's heart.
verses.modern: and wine that makes glad the heart of man, and oil to make His face shine, and bread which strengthens man's heart.

verses.kjv: The trees of the LORD are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
verses.modern: The trees of the LORD are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted.

verses.kjv: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.
verses.modern: There the birds make their nests; the stork has its home in the junipers.

verses.kjv: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.
verses.modern: The high mountains belong to the wild goats; the crags are a refuge for the hyrax.

verses.kjv: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.
verses.modern: He made the moon to mark the seasons, and the sun knows when to go down.

verses.kjv: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.
verses.modern: You bring darkness, it becomes night. All the beasts of the forest prowl.

verses.kjv: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.
verses.modern: The lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.

verses.kjv: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.
verses.modern: The sun rises. They steal away; they return and lie down in their dens.

verses.kjv: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.
verses.modern: Then people go out to their work, to their labor until evening.

verses.kjv: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.
verses.modern: How many are Your works, LORD! In wisdom You made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.

verses.kjv: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
verses.modern: There is the sea, vast and spacious, teeming with creatures beyond number — living things both large and small.

verses.kjv: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.
verses.modern: There the ships go to and fro, and Leviathan, which You formed to frolic there.

verses.kjv: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.
verses.modern: All creatures look to You to give them their food at the proper time.

verses.kjv: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.
verses.modern: When You give it to them, they gather it up; when You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good things.

verses.kjv: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
verses.modern: When You hide Your face, they are terrified; when You take away their breath, they die and return to the dust.

verses.kjv: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.
verses.modern: When You send Your Spirit, they are created, and You renew the face of the ground.

verses.kjv: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.
verses.modern: May the glory of the LORD endure forever; may the LORD rejoice in His works —

verses.kjv: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.
verses.modern: he who looks at the earth. It trembles, who touches the mountains. They smoke.

verses.kjv: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
verses.modern: I will sing to the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.

verses.kjv: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.
verses.modern: May my meditation be pleasing to Him, as I rejoice in the LORD.

verses.kjv: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.modern: But may sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Praise the LORD, my soul. Praise the LORD.

chapters.summary: The psalmist praises God as Creator, sweeping from the foundations of the earth to the waters, the animals, the forests, the sea, and Leviathan playing in the deep. All creatures depend on God's open hand for life, and the psalmist vows to sing to the LORD as long as he lives.

verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
verses.modern: Give praise to the LORD, proclaim His name; make known among the nations what he has done.

verses.kjv: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.
verses.modern: Sing to Him, sing praise to Him; tell of all His wonderful acts.

verses.kjv: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
verses.modern: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

verses.kjv: Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.
verses.modern: Look to the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.

verses.kjv: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
verses.modern: Remember the wonders He has done, His miracles, and the judgments He pronounced,

verses.kjv: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.
verses.modern: you his servants, the descendants of Abraham, his chosen ones, the children of Jacob.

verses.kjv: He is the LORD our God: his judgments are in all the earth.
verses.modern: He is the LORD our God; His judgments are in all the earth.

verses.kjv: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.
verses.modern: He remembers His covenant forever, the promise He made, for a thousand generations,

verses.kjv: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;
verses.modern: the covenant he made with Abraham, the oath he swore to Isaac.

verses.kjv: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:
verses.modern: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:

verses.kjv: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:
verses.modern: "To you I will give the land of Canaan as the portion you will inherit."

verses.kjv: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.
verses.modern: When they were but few in number, few indeed, and strangers in it,

verses.kjv: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;
verses.modern: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.

verses.kjv: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;
verses.modern: He allowed no one to oppress them; for their sake he rebuked kings:

verses.kjv: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
verses.modern: Saying, "Touch not my anointed, and do my prophets no harm."

verses.kjv: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.
verses.modern: He called down famine on the land and destroyed all their supplies of food;

verses.kjv: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:
verses.modern: he sent a man before them — Joseph, sold as a slave.

verses.kjv: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
verses.modern: They bruised his feet with shackles, his neck was put in irons,

verses.kjv: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.
verses.modern: till what He foretold came to pass, till the word of the LORD proved Him true.

verses.kjv: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.
verses.modern: The king sent and released him, the ruler of peoples set him free.

verses.kjv: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:
verses.modern: He made him master of his household, ruler over all he possessed,

verses.kjv: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.
verses.modern: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.

verses.kjv: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
verses.modern: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob lived as a foreigner in the land of Ham.

verses.kjv: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.
verses.modern: The LORD made His people very fruitful; He made them too numerous for their foes,

verses.kjv: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.
verses.modern: whose hearts He turned to hate His people, to conspire against His servants.

verses.kjv: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.
verses.modern: He sent Moses his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

verses.kjv: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.modern: They performed his signs among them, his wonders in the land of Ham.

verses.kjv: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
verses.modern: He sent darkness and made the land dark — for had they not rebelled against his words?

verses.kjv: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
verses.modern: He turned their waters into blood, causing their fish to die.

verses.kjv: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
verses.modern: Their land teemed with frogs, which went up into the bedrooms of their rulers.

verses.kjv: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.
verses.modern: He spoke, and there came swarms of flies, and gnats throughout their country.

verses.kjv: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.
verses.modern: He turned their rain into hail, with lightning throughout their land;

verses.kjv: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.
verses.modern: he struck down their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.

verses.kjv: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,
verses.modern: He spoke, and the locusts came, grasshoppers without number;

verses.kjv: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
verses.modern: they ate up every green thing in their land, ate up the produce of their soil.

verses.kjv: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.
verses.modern: Then he struck down all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their manhood.

verses.kjv: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.
verses.modern: He brought out Israel, laden with silver and gold, and from among their tribes no one faltered.

verses.kjv: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.
verses.modern: Egypt was glad when they left, because dread of Israel had fallen on them.

verses.kjv: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.
verses.modern: He spread out a cloud as a covering, and a fire to give light at night.

verses.kjv: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
verses.modern: They asked. He brought them quail; he fed them well with the bread of heaven.

verses.kjv: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.
verses.modern: He opened the rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.

verses.kjv: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.
verses.modern: For he remembered his holy promise given to his servant Abraham.

verses.kjv: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:
verses.modern: He brought out his people with rejoicing, his chosen ones with shouts of joy;

verses.kjv: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;
verses.modern: he gave them the lands of the nations. They fell heir to what others had toiled for —

verses.kjv: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.modern: that they might keep His precepts and observe His laws. Praise the LORD.

chapters.summary: The psalmist recounts God's faithfulness to His covenant with Abraham, tracing His providential hand through the stories of Joseph, the plagues of Egypt, the exodus, and the wilderness provision. The purpose of all God's mighty works is that His people might keep His statutes and observe His laws.

verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: Praise the LORD. Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD? who can shew forth all his praise?
verses.modern: Who can proclaim the mighty acts of the LORD or fully declare His praise?

verses.kjv: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.
verses.modern: Blessed are those who act justly, who always do what is right.

verses.kjv: Remember me, O LORD, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;
verses.modern: Remember me, LORD, when You show favor to Your people; come to my aid when You save them,

verses.kjv: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.
verses.modern: that I may enjoy the prosperity of Your chosen ones, that I may share in the joy of Your nation and join Your inheritance in giving praise.

verses.kjv: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
verses.modern: We have sinned with our fathers; we have committed iniquity; we have done wickedly.

verses.kjv: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.
verses.modern: Our fathers did not understand Your wonders in Egypt; they did not remember the multitude of Your mercies; but provoked Him at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.
verses.modern: Yet He saved them for His name's sake, to make His mighty power known.

verses.kjv: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
verses.modern: He rebuked the Red Sea. It dried up; He led them through the depths as through a desert.

verses.kjv: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
verses.modern: He saved them from the hand of the foe; from the hand of the enemy he redeemed them.

verses.kjv: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.
verses.modern: The waters covered their adversaries; not one of them survived.

verses.kjv: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.
verses.modern: Then they believed His promises and sang His praise.

verses.kjv: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:
verses.modern: But they soon forgot what He had done and did not wait for His plan to unfold.

verses.kjv: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.
verses.modern: In the desert they gave in to their craving; in the wilderness they put God to the test.

verses.kjv: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.
verses.modern: So He gave them what they asked for, but sent a wasting disease among them.

verses.kjv: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the LORD.
verses.modern: In the camp they grew envious of Moses and of Aaron, who was consecrated to the LORD.

verses.kjv: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
verses.modern: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it buried the company of Abiram.

verses.kjv: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
verses.modern: Fire blazed among their followers; a flame consumed the wicked.

verses.kjv: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.
verses.modern: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped an idol cast from metal.

verses.kjv: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.
verses.modern: They exchanged their glorious God for an image of a bull, which eats grass.

verses.kjv: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;
verses.modern: They forgot the God Who saved them, who had done great things in Egypt,

verses.kjv: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.
verses.modern: miracles in the land of Ham and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.

verses.kjv: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.
verses.modern: So he said he would destroy them — had not Moses, his chosen one, stood in the breach before him to keep his wrath from destroying them.

verses.kjv: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:
verses.modern: Then they despised the pleasant land; they did not believe his promise.

verses.kjv: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.
verses.modern: They grumbled in their tents and did not obey the LORD.

verses.kjv: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:
verses.modern: So He swore to them with uplifted hand that He would make them fall in the wilderness,

verses.kjv: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.
verses.modern: make their descendants fall among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.

verses.kjv: They joined themselves also unto Baalpeor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
verses.modern: They yoked themselves to the Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods;

verses.kjv: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.
verses.modern: they aroused the LORD's anger by their wicked deeds, and a plague broke out among them.

verses.kjv: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.
verses.modern: But Phinehas stood up and intervened, and the plague was checked.

verses.kjv: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.
verses.modern: This was credited to Him as righteousness for endless generations to come.

verses.kjv: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:
verses.modern: By the waters of Meribah they angered the LORD, and trouble came to Moses because of them;

verses.kjv: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
verses.modern: for they rebelled against the Spirit of God, and rash words came from Moses' lips.

verses.kjv: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the LORD commanded them:
verses.modern: They did not destroy the peoples as the LORD had commanded them,

verses.kjv: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.
verses.modern: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.

verses.kjv: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.
verses.modern: They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.

verses.kjv: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,
verses.modern: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to false gods.

verses.kjv: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.
verses.modern: They shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was desecrated by their blood.

verses.kjv: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.
verses.modern: They defiled themselves by what they did; by their deeds they prostituted themselves.

verses.kjv: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.
verses.modern: Therefore the LORD was angry with His people and abhorred His inheritance.

verses.kjv: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.
verses.modern: He gave them into the hands of the nations. Their foes ruled over them.

verses.kjv: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.
verses.modern: Their enemies oppressed them and subjected them to their power.

verses.kjv: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.
verses.modern: Many times He delivered them, but they provoked Him with their counsel and were brought low for their iniquity.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:
verses.modern: Yet He took note of their distress when He heard their cry;

verses.kjv: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
verses.modern: And He remembered for them His covenant, and relented according to the multitude of His mercies.

verses.kjv: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.
verses.modern: He caused all who held them captive to show them mercy.

verses.kjv: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.
verses.modern: Save us, LORD our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name and glory in Your praise.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.modern: Praise be to the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, "Amen!" Praise the LORD.

chapters.summary: The psalmist confesses Israel's long history of sin — from the Red Sea to the golden calf, from Baal-peor to the sacrifice of children to idols — showing a repeating cycle of rebellion, judgment, and God's merciful deliverance. Despite it all, God remembers His covenant and relents according to the multitude of His mercies.

verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;
verses.modern: Let the redeemed of the LORD tell their story — those He redeemed from the hand of the enemy,

verses.kjv: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.
verses.modern: those He gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.

verses.kjv: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.
verses.modern: Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no way to a city where they could settle.

verses.kjv: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
verses.modern: They were hungry and thirsty, and their lives ebbed away.

verses.kjv: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
