verses.modern: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and He delivered them from their distress.

verses.kjv: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
verses.modern: He led them by a straight way to a city where they could settle.

verses.kjv: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.modern: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His mercy and His wonderful works for mankind,

verses.kjv: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
verses.modern: for He satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.

verses.kjv: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;
verses.modern: Some sat in darkness and deep shadow, prisoners suffering in iron chains,

verses.kjv: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:
verses.modern: because they had rebelled against God's commands and despised the counsel of the Most High.

verses.kjv: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.
verses.modern: So He subjected them to bitter labor; they stumbled and there was no one to help.

verses.kjv: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
verses.modern: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.

verses.kjv: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.
verses.modern: He brought them out of darkness and deep shadow and broke away their chains.

verses.kjv: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.modern: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His mercy and His wonderful works for mankind,

verses.kjv: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.
verses.modern: for He breaks down gates of bronze and cuts through bars of iron.

verses.kjv: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
verses.modern: Some became fools through their rebellious ways and suffered affliction because of their iniquities.

verses.kjv: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.
verses.modern: They loathed all food and drew near to the gates of death.

verses.kjv: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.
verses.modern: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.

verses.kjv: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
verses.modern: He sent out His word and healed them; He rescued them from the grave.

verses.kjv: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.modern: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His mercy and His wonderful works for mankind.

verses.kjv: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
verses.modern: Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and tell of His works with songs of joy.

verses.kjv: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
verses.modern: Some went out on the sea in ships; they were merchants on the mighty waters.

verses.kjv: These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.
verses.modern: They saw the works of the LORD, His wonderful deeds in the deep.

verses.kjv: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.
verses.modern: For He spoke and stirred up a tempest that lifted high the waves.

verses.kjv: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.
verses.modern: They mounted up to the heavens and went down to the depths; in their peril their courage melted away.

verses.kjv: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits' end.
verses.modern: They reeled and staggered like drunkards; they were at their wits' end.

verses.kjv: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.
verses.modern: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distress.

verses.kjv: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
verses.modern: He stilled the storm to a whisper; the waves of the sea were hushed.

verses.kjv: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
verses.modern: They were glad when it grew calm, and He guided them to their desired haven.

verses.kjv: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.modern: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His mercy and His wonderful works for mankind.

verses.kjv: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
verses.modern: Let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people and praise him in the council of the elders.

verses.kjv: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;
verses.modern: He turns rivers into a desert, flowing springs into thirsty ground,

verses.kjv: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
verses.modern: and fruitful land into a salt waste, because of the wickedness of those who live there.

verses.kjv: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.
verses.modern: He turns the desert into pools of water and the parched ground into flowing springs;

verses.kjv: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;
verses.modern: there He brings the hungry to live, and they found a city where they could settle.

verses.kjv: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.
verses.modern: They sow fields and plant vineyards that yield a fruitful harvest.

verses.kjv: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
verses.modern: He blesses them and their numbers grow greatly, and He does not let their herds diminish.

verses.kjv: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
verses.modern: Then their numbers decreased and they were humbled by oppression, calamity, and sorrow;

verses.kjv: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.
verses.modern: he who pours contempt on nobles made them wander in a trackless waste.

verses.kjv: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.
verses.modern: But He lifted the needy out of their affliction and made their families like flocks of sheep.

verses.kjv: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
verses.modern: The upright see and rejoice, while all the wicked shut their mouths.

verses.kjv: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.
verses.modern: Whoever is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.

chapters.summary: The psalmist calls the redeemed to give thanks, recounting four portraits of human distress — wanderers in the desert, prisoners in darkness, fools near death, and sailors in a storm — each delivered by crying out to the LORD. The refrain repeats: let them praise the LORD for His mercy and His wonderful works for mankind.

verses.kjv: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
verses.modern: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.

verses.kjv: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
verses.modern: Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.

verses.kjv: I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
verses.modern: I will praise You, LORD, among the nations; I will sing of you among the peoples.

verses.kjv: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.
verses.modern: For Your mercy is great above the heavens, and Your truth reaches to the clouds.

verses.kjv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;
verses.modern: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let Your glory be over all the earth.

verses.kjv: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.
verses.modern: Save us and help us with Your right hand, that those You love may be delivered.

verses.kjv: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.modern: God has spoken in His holiness: "I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

verses.kjv: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
verses.modern: Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet, Judah is my scepter.

verses.kjv: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
verses.modern: Moab is my washbasin, on Edom I toss my sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph."

verses.kjv: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.modern: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

verses.kjv: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?
verses.modern: Is it not You, God, You who have now rejected us and no longer go out with our armies?

verses.kjv: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
verses.modern: Give us help from trouble, for vain is the help of man.

verses.kjv: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
verses.modern: With God we will gain the victory, and He will trample down our enemies.

chapters.summary: David praises God with a fixed heart, declaring God's mercy above the heavens and His sovereignty over all the lands of Israel and its neighbors. He asks God for help in battle, knowing that with God they will gain the victory, for the help of man is worthless.

verses.kjv: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
verses.modern: O God, whom I praise, do not remain silent,

verses.kjv: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
verses.modern: for wicked and deceitful mouths have opened against me; they have spoken to me with lying tongues.

verses.kjv: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
verses.modern: With words of hatred they surround me; they attack me without cause.

verses.kjv: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.
verses.modern: In return for my friendship they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.

verses.kjv: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
verses.modern: They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my friendship.

verses.kjv: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.
verses.modern: Appoint someone evil to oppose my enemy; let an accuser stand at His right hand.

verses.kjv: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.
verses.modern: When He is tried, let Him be found guilty, and may His prayers condemn Him.

verses.kjv: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.
verses.modern: May His days be few; may another take His place of leadership.

verses.kjv: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
verses.modern: May His children be fatherless and his wife a widow.

verses.kjv: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
verses.modern: May His children wander about and beg; may they be driven from their ruined homes.

verses.kjv: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.
verses.modern: May a creditor seize all He has; may strangers plunder the fruits of His labor.

verses.kjv: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
verses.modern: May no one extend kindness to him or take pity on his fatherless children.

verses.kjv: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
verses.modern: May His descendants be cut off, their names blotted out from the next generation.

verses.kjv: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
verses.modern: May the iniquity of His fathers be remembered before the LORD; may the sin of His mother never be blotted out.

verses.kjv: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
verses.modern: May their sins always remain before the LORD, that He may blot out their name from the earth.

verses.kjv: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
verses.modern: For He never thought of doing a kindness, but hounded to death the poor, the needy, and the brokenhearted.

verses.kjv: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
verses.modern: He loved to curse — may it come back on Him. He found no pleasure in blessing — may it be far from Him.

verses.kjv: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
verses.modern: He wore cursing as His garment; it entered His body like water, like oil into His bones.

verses.kjv: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
verses.modern: May it be like a cloak wrapped about Him, like a belt tied forever around Him.

verses.kjv: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
verses.modern: May this be the LORD's payment to my accusers, to those who speak evil against me.

verses.kjv: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.
verses.modern: But do for me, O GOD the Lord, for Your name's sake; because Your mercy is good, deliver me.

verses.kjv: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
verses.modern: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

verses.kjv: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth; I am tossed up and down as the locust.
verses.modern: I fade away like an evening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.

verses.kjv: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.
verses.modern: My knees give way from fasting; my body is thin and gaunt.

verses.kjv: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their head.
verses.modern: I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads.

verses.kjv: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:
verses.modern: Help me, LORD my God; save me according to Your mercy.

verses.kjv: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, LORD, hast done it.
verses.modern: Let them know that it is Your hand, that You, LORD, have done it.

verses.kjv: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
verses.modern: While they curse, may You bless; may those who attack me be put to shame, but may Your servant rejoice.

verses.kjv: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
verses.modern: May my accusers be clothed with disgrace and wrapped in shame as in a cloak.

verses.kjv: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
verses.modern: With my mouth I will greatly praise the LORD; in the midst of the crowd I will praise Him.

verses.kjv: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.
verses.modern: For He stands at the right hand of the needy, to save their lives from those who would condemn them.

chapters.summary: David cries out against enemies who repay his love with hatred and his friendship with lies, calling down detailed curses on the one who persecuted the poor and brokenhearted. He then turns to God for deliverance, declaring his own poverty and trusting that the LORD stands at the right hand of the needy.

verses.kjv: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.modern: The LORD says to my lord: "Sit at my right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet."

verses.kjv: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
verses.modern: The LORD will extend Your mighty scepter from Zion, saying, "Rule in the midst of Your enemies!"

verses.kjv: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.
verses.modern: Your troops will be willing on Your day of battle. Arrayed in holy splendor, Your young men will come to You like dew from the morning's womb.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
verses.modern: The LORD has sworn and will not change His mind: "You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek."

verses.kjv: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
verses.modern: The Lord is at Your right hand; He will crush kings on the day of His wrath.

verses.kjv: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.
verses.modern: He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead and crushing the rulers of the whole earth.

verses.kjv: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
verses.modern: He will drink from a brook along the way, and so He will lift His head high.

chapters.summary: The LORD speaks to David's Lord, commanding Him to sit at His right hand until His enemies are made His footstool, and swearing an irrevocable oath that He is a priest forever after the order of Melchizedek. This is the most-quoted psalm in the New Testament, pointing directly to Christ as both King and eternal Priest.

verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.
verses.modern: Praise the LORD. I will extol the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.

verses.kjv: The works of the LORD are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
verses.modern: Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.

verses.kjv: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.modern: Glorious and majestic are His deeds, and His righteousness endures forever.

verses.kjv: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.
verses.modern: He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.

verses.kjv: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.
verses.modern: He provides food for those who fear Him; He remembers His covenant forever.

verses.kjv: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
verses.modern: He has shown His people the power of His works, giving them the lands of other nations.

verses.kjv: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.
verses.modern: The works of His hands are faithful and just; all His precepts are trustworthy.

verses.kjv: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.
verses.modern: They are established for ever and ever, enacted in faithfulness and uprightness.

verses.kjv: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.
verses.modern: He provided redemption for His people; He ordained His covenant forever — holy and awesome is His name.

verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.
verses.modern: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts have good understanding. His praise endures forever.

chapters.summary: The psalmist praises the LORD with his whole heart, declaring that God's works are great, His righteousness endures forever, and He has sent redemption to His people. The psalm closes with the foundational declaration that the fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom.

verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.
verses.modern: Praise the LORD. Blessed are those who fear the LORD, Who find great delight in His commands.

verses.kjv: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
verses.modern: Their children will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.

verses.kjv: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.modern: Wealth and riches are in their houses, and their righteousness endures forever.

verses.kjv: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
verses.modern: Even in darkness light dawns for the upright, for those who are gracious and compassionate and righteous.

verses.kjv: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
verses.modern: Good will come to those who are generous and lend freely, who conduct their affairs with justice.

verses.kjv: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
verses.modern: Surely the righteous will never be shaken; they will be remembered forever.

verses.kjv: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.
verses.modern: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings; His heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.

verses.kjv: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.
verses.modern: Their hearts are secure, they will have no fear; in the end they will look in triumph on their foes.

verses.kjv: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
verses.modern: They have freely scattered their gifts to the poor; their righteousness endures forever; their horn will be lifted high in honor.

verses.kjv: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
verses.modern: The wicked will see and be vexed; they will gnash their teeth and waste away; the longings of the wicked will come to nothing.

chapters.summary: The psalmist describes the blessings of the one who fears the LORD and delights in His commands — prosperity, generosity, a secure heart, and triumph over enemies. The wicked see it and are vexed, but the righteousness of the godly endures forever.

verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.
verses.modern: Praise the LORD. Praise the LORD, You His servants; praise the name of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.
verses.modern: Let the name of the LORD be praised, both now and forevermore.

verses.kjv: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD'S name is to be praised.
verses.modern: From the rising of the sun to the place where it sets, the name of the LORD is to be praised.

verses.kjv: The LORD is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.
verses.modern: The LORD is exalted over all the nations, his glory above the heavens.

verses.kjv: Who is like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,
verses.modern: Who is like the LORD our God, the One who sits enthroned on high,

verses.kjv: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!
verses.modern: who stoops down to look on the heavens and the earth?

verses.kjv: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;
verses.modern: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap;

verses.kjv: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
verses.modern: he seats them with princes, with the princes of His people.

verses.kjv: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.modern: He settles the childless woman in her home as a happy mother of children. Praise the LORD.

chapters.summary: The psalmist calls the servants of the LORD to praise His name from the rising of the sun to its setting, exalting God who sits enthroned on high yet stoops down to regard heaven and earth. He raises the poor from the dust and the needy from the ash heap, seating them with princes and giving the barren woman a home as a joyful mother.

verses.kjv: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
verses.modern: When Israel came out of Egypt, Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,

verses.kjv: Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.
verses.modern: Judah became God's sanctuary, Israel His domain.

verses.kjv: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.
verses.modern: The sea looked and fled, the Jordan turned back;

verses.kjv: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.
verses.modern: the mountains leaped like rams, the hills like lambs.

verses.kjv: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?
verses.modern: Why was it, sea, that you fled? Why, Jordan, did you turn back?

verses.kjv: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?
verses.modern: Why, mountains, did you leap like rams, you hills, like lambs?

verses.kjv: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;
verses.modern: Tremble, earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

verses.kjv: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
verses.modern: who turned the rock into a pool, the hard rock into springs of water.

chapters.summary: The psalmist celebrates the exodus in vivid poetic imagery: the sea fled, the Jordan turned back, the mountains skipped like rams, and the hills like lambs. All creation trembles at the presence of the God of Jacob, who turns rock into pools of water.

verses.kjv: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth's sake.
verses.modern: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to Your name give glory, for Your mercy, and for Your truth's sake.

verses.kjv: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?
verses.modern: Why do the nations say, "Where is their God?"

verses.kjv: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.
verses.modern: Our God is in heaven; He does whatever pleases Him.

verses.kjv: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
verses.modern: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

verses.kjv: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:
verses.modern: They have mouths, but cannot speak; eyes, but cannot see.

verses.kjv: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:
verses.modern: They have ears, but cannot hear; noses, but cannot smell.

verses.kjv: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.
verses.modern: They have hands, but cannot feel; feet, but cannot walk; nor can they utter a sound with their throats.

verses.kjv: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.
verses.modern: Those who make them will be like them, and so will all who trust in them.

verses.kjv: O Israel, trust thou in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
verses.modern: All You Israelites, trust in the LORD — He is their help and shield.

verses.kjv: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
verses.modern: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD — He is their help and shield.

verses.kjv: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
verses.modern: You who fear Him, trust in the LORD — He is their help and shield.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.modern: The LORD remembers us and will bless us: He will bless His people Israel, He will bless the house of Aaron,

verses.kjv: He will bless them that fear the LORD, both small and great.
verses.modern: he will bless those who fear the LORD — small and great alike.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall increase you more and more, you and your children.
verses.modern: May the LORD cause You to flourish, both You and Your children.

verses.kjv: Ye are blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.
verses.modern: May You be blessed by the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

verses.kjv: The heaven, even the heavens, are the LORD'S: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.
verses.modern: The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth He has given to mankind.

verses.kjv: The dead praise not the LORD, neither any that go down into silence.
verses.modern: It is not the dead who praise the LORD, those who go down to the place of silence;

verses.kjv: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD.
verses.modern: it is we who extol the LORD, both now and forevermore. Praise the LORD.

chapters.summary: The psalmist contrasts the living God in heaven, who does whatever He pleases, with the lifeless idols of the nations — silver and gold that cannot see, hear, or speak. He calls Israel, the house of Aaron, and all who fear the LORD to trust in Him as their help and shield.

verses.kjv: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.
verses.modern: I love the LORD, for He heard my voice; He heard my cry for mercy.

verses.kjv: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.
verses.modern: Because He turned His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.

verses.kjv: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
verses.modern: The cords of death entangled me, the anguish of hell came over me; I was overcome by distress and sorrow.

verses.kjv: Then called I upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
verses.modern: Then I called on the name of the LORD: "LORD, save me!"

verses.kjv: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.
verses.modern: The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.

verses.kjv: The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.
verses.modern: The LORD protects the unwary; when I was brought low, He saved me.

verses.kjv: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.
verses.modern: Return to Your rest, my soul, for the LORD has been good to You.

verses.kjv: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
verses.modern: For You, LORD, have delivered me from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling,

verses.kjv: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
verses.modern: that I may walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

verses.kjv: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
verses.modern: I trusted in the LORD when I said, "I am greatly afflicted";

verses.kjv: I said in my haste, All men are liars.
verses.modern: in my alarm I said, "Everyone is a liar."

verses.kjv: What shall I render unto the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
verses.modern: What shall I return to the LORD for all His goodness to me?

verses.kjv: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.
verses.modern: I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.

verses.kjv: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.
verses.modern: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people.

verses.kjv: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.
verses.modern: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of His faithful servants.

verses.kjv: O LORD, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.
verses.modern: Truly I am Your servant, LORD; I serve You just as my mother did; You have freed me from my chains.

verses.kjv: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.
verses.modern: I will sacrifice a thank offering to You and call on the name of the LORD.

verses.kjv: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people,
verses.modern: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people,

verses.kjv: In the courts of the LORD'S house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.modern: in the courts of the house of the LORD — in Your midst, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD.

chapters.summary: The psalmist declares his love for the LORD who heard his cry when the cords of death entangled him and delivered his soul from death, his eyes from tears, and his feet from stumbling. He asks what he can render to the LORD for all His benefits, and answers by lifting the cup of salvation and paying his vows in the presence of all God's people.

verses.kjv: O praise the LORD, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.
verses.modern: Praise the LORD, all You nations; extol Him, all you peoples.

verses.kjv: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.modern: For great is His mercy toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Praise the LORD.

chapters.summary: The shortest chapter in the Bible calls all nations and all peoples to praise the LORD, for His mercy toward us is great and His truth endures forever.

verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: Let Israel say: "His mercy endures forever."

verses.kjv: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: Let the house of Aaron say: "His mercy endures forever."

verses.kjv: Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: Let those who fear the LORD say: "His mercy endures forever."

verses.kjv: I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, and set me in a large place.
verses.modern: When hard pressed, I cried to the LORD; He brought me into a spacious place.

verses.kjv: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
verses.modern: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear. What can man do to me?

verses.kjv: The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.
verses.modern: The LORD is with me; He is my helper. I look in triumph on my enemies.

verses.kjv: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.
verses.modern: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.

verses.kjv: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.
verses.modern: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.

verses.kjv: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them.
verses.modern: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them down.

verses.kjv: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
verses.modern: They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the LORD I cut them down.

verses.kjv: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
verses.modern: They swarmed around me like bees, but they were consumed as quickly as burning thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them down.

verses.kjv: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me.
verses.modern: I was pushed back and about to fall, but the LORD helped me.

verses.kjv: The LORD is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.
verses.modern: The LORD is my strength and my defense; He has become my salvation.

verses.kjv: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
verses.modern: Shouts of joy and victory resound in the tents of the righteous: "The LORD's right hand has done mighty things!"

verses.kjv: The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
verses.modern: The LORD's right hand is lifted high; the LORD's right hand has done mighty things!

verses.kjv: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD.
verses.modern: I will not die but live, and will proclaim what the LORD has done.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.
verses.modern: The LORD has chastened me severely, but He has not given me over to death.

verses.kjv: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the LORD:
verses.modern: Open for me the gates of the righteous; I will enter and give thanks to the LORD.

verses.kjv: This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter.
verses.modern: This is the gate of the LORD through which the righteous may enter.

verses.kjv: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.
verses.modern: I will give You thanks, for You answered me; You have become my salvation.

verses.kjv: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.
verses.modern: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone;

verses.kjv: This is the LORD'S doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.
verses.modern: the LORD has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes.

verses.kjv: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.modern: The LORD has done it this very day; let us rejoice and be glad in it.

verses.kjv: Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD: O LORD, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.
verses.modern: LORD, save us! LORD, grant us success!

verses.kjv: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.
verses.modern: Blessed is He who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless You.

verses.kjv: God is the LORD, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.
verses.modern: The LORD is God, and He has made His light shine on us. With boughs in hand, join in the festal procession up to the horns of the altar.

verses.kjv: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.
verses.modern: You are my God, and I will praise You; You are my God, and I will exalt You.

verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His mercy endures forever.

chapters.summary: The psalmist gives thanks to the LORD for His enduring mercy, recounting how God answered him in distress and became his salvation when enemies surrounded him on every side. He proclaims that the stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone, and blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.
verses.modern: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the law of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.
verses.modern: Blessed are those who keep His statutes and seek Him with all their heart —

verses.kjv: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
verses.modern: they do no wrong but follow His ways.

verses.kjv: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.
verses.modern: You have laid down precepts that are to be fully obeyed.

verses.kjv: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!
verses.modern: O that my ways were directed to keep Your statutes!

verses.kjv: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.
verses.modern: Then I would not be put to shame when I consider all Your commands.

verses.kjv: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.
verses.modern: I will praise You with an upright heart as I learn Your righteous laws.

verses.kjv: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.
verses.modern: I will obey Your decrees; do not utterly forsake me.

verses.kjv: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.
verses.modern: How can a young person stay on the path of purity? By living according to Your word.

verses.kjv: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.
verses.modern: I seek You with all my heart; do not let me stray from Your commands.

verses.kjv: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
verses.modern: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.

verses.kjv: Blessed art thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.
verses.modern: Praise be to You, LORD; teach me Your decrees.

verses.kjv: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.
verses.modern: With my lips I recount all the laws that come from Your mouth.

verses.kjv: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.
verses.modern: I rejoice in following Your statutes as one rejoices in great riches.

verses.kjv: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.
verses.modern: I meditate on Your precepts and consider Your ways.

verses.kjv: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.
verses.modern: I delight in Your decrees; I will not neglect Your word.

verses.kjv: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.
verses.modern: Be good to Your servant while I live, that I may obey Your word.

verses.kjv: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.
verses.modern: Open my eyes that I may see wonderful things in Your law.

verses.kjv: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.
verses.modern: I am a stranger on earth; do not hide Your commands from me.

verses.kjv: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.
verses.modern: My soul is consumed with longing for Your laws at all times.

verses.kjv: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.
verses.modern: You rebuke the arrogant, who are accursed, those who stray from Your commands.

verses.kjv: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.
verses.modern: Remove from me their scorn and contempt, for I keep Your statutes.

verses.kjv: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.
verses.modern: Though rulers sit together and slander me, Your servant will meditate on Your decrees.

verses.kjv: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.
verses.modern: Your statutes are my delight; they are my counselors.

verses.kjv: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.
verses.modern: I am laid low in the dust; preserve my life according to Your word.

verses.kjv: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.
verses.modern: I gave an account of my ways and You answered me; teach me Your decrees.

verses.kjv: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.
verses.modern: Cause me to understand the way of Your precepts, that I may meditate on Your wonderful deeds.

verses.kjv: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
verses.modern: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to Your word.

verses.kjv: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.
verses.modern: Keep me from deceitful ways; be gracious to me and teach me Your law.

verses.kjv: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.
verses.modern: I have chosen the way of faithfulness; I have set my heart on Your laws.

verses.kjv: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.
verses.modern: I hold fast to Your statutes, LORD; do not let me be put to shame.

verses.kjv: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.
verses.modern: I run in the path of Your commands, for You have broadened my understanding.

verses.kjv: Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.
verses.modern: Teach me, LORD, the way of Your decrees, that I may follow it to the end.

verses.kjv: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
verses.modern: Give me understanding, so that I may keep Your law and obey it with all my heart.

verses.kjv: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
verses.modern: Direct me in the path of Your commands, for there I find delight.

verses.kjv: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.
verses.modern: Turn my heart toward Your statutes and not toward selfish gain.

verses.kjv: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.
verses.modern: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; preserve my life according to Your word.

verses.kjv: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.
verses.modern: Fulfill Your promise to Your servant, so that You may be feared.

verses.kjv: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.
verses.modern: Take away the disgrace I dread, for Your laws are good.

verses.kjv: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.
verses.modern: How I long for Your precepts! In Your righteousness preserve my life.

verses.kjv: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD, even thy salvation, according to thy word.
verses.modern: Let Your mercies come also to me, O LORD, even Your salvation, according to Your word.

verses.kjv: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.
verses.modern: then I can answer anyone who taunts me, for I trust in your word.

verses.kjv: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.
verses.modern: Never take Your word of truth from my mouth, for I have put my hope in Your laws.

verses.kjv: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.
verses.modern: I will always obey Your law, for ever and ever.

verses.kjv: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.
verses.modern: I will walk about in freedom, for I have sought out Your precepts.

verses.kjv: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.
verses.modern: I will speak of Your statutes before kings and will not be put to shame,

verses.kjv: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.
verses.modern: for I delight in Your commands because I love them.

verses.kjv: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.
verses.modern: I reach out for Your commands, which I love, and I meditate on Your decrees.

verses.kjv: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
verses.modern: Remember Your word to Your servant, for You have given me hope.

verses.kjv: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
verses.modern: My comfort in my suffering is this: Your promise preserves my life.

verses.kjv: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.
verses.modern: The arrogant mock me without restraint, but I do not turn from Your law.

verses.kjv: I remembered thy judgments of old, O LORD; and have comforted myself.
verses.modern: I remember, LORD, Your ancient laws, and I find comfort in them.

verses.kjv: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
verses.modern: Indignation grips me because of the wicked, who have forsaken your law.

verses.kjv: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
verses.modern: Your decrees are the theme of my song wherever I lodge.

verses.kjv: I have remembered thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have kept thy law.
verses.modern: In the night, LORD, I remember Your name, that I may keep Your law.

verses.kjv: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.
verses.modern: This has been my practice: I obey Your precepts.

verses.kjv: Thou art my portion, O LORD: I have said that I would keep thy words.
verses.modern: You are my portion, LORD; I have promised to obey Your words.

verses.kjv: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.
verses.modern: I have sought Your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to Your promise.

verses.kjv: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
verses.modern: I have considered my ways and have turned my steps to Your statutes.

verses.kjv: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.
verses.modern: I will hasten and not delay to obey Your commands.

verses.kjv: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.
verses.modern: Though the wicked bind me with ropes, I will not forget your law.

verses.kjv: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.
verses.modern: At midnight I rise to give you thanks for your righteous laws.

verses.kjv: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.
verses.modern: I am a friend to all who fear you, to all who follow your precepts.

verses.kjv: The earth, O LORD, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.
verses.modern: The earth, O LORD, is full of Your mercy; teach me Your statutes.

verses.kjv: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD, according unto thy word.
verses.modern: Do good to Your servant, LORD, according to Your word.

verses.kjv: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.
verses.modern: Teach me knowledge and good judgment, for I trust Your commands.

verses.kjv: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.
verses.modern: Before I was afflicted I went astray, but now I obey Your word.

verses.kjv: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.
verses.modern: You are good, and what You do is good; teach me Your decrees.

verses.kjv: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.
verses.modern: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep Your precepts with all my heart.

verses.kjv: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.
verses.modern: Their hearts are callous and unfeeling, but I delight in Your law.

verses.kjv: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.
verses.modern: It was good for me to be afflicted so that I might learn Your decrees.

verses.kjv: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.
verses.modern: The law from Your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of silver and gold.

verses.kjv: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
verses.modern: Your hands made me and formed me; give me understanding to learn Your commands.

verses.kjv: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.
verses.modern: May those who fear You rejoice when they see me, for I have put my hope in Your word.

verses.kjv: I know, O LORD, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.
verses.modern: I know, LORD, that Your laws are righteous, and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.

verses.kjv: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.
verses.modern: Let, I pray, Your merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to Your word to Your servant.

verses.kjv: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.
verses.modern: Let Your compassion come to me that I may live, for Your law is my delight.

verses.kjv: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.
verses.modern: May the arrogant be put to shame for wronging me without cause; but I will meditate on Your precepts.

verses.kjv: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.
verses.modern: May those who fear You turn to me, those who understand Your statutes.

verses.kjv: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.
verses.modern: May I wholeheartedly follow Your decrees, that I may not be put to shame.

verses.kjv: My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.
verses.modern: My soul faints with longing for Your salvation, but I have put my hope in Your word.

verses.kjv: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?
verses.modern: My eyes fail, looking for Your promise; I say, "When will You comfort me?"

verses.kjv: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.
verses.modern: Though I am like a wineskin in the smoke, I do not forget Your decrees.

verses.kjv: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
verses.modern: How long must Your servant wait? When will You punish my persecutors?

verses.kjv: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.
verses.modern: The arrogant dig pits for me, contrary to Your law.

verses.kjv: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
verses.modern: All Your commands are trustworthy; help me, for I am being persecuted without cause.

verses.kjv: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.
verses.modern: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken Your precepts.

verses.kjv: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.
verses.modern: Quicken me according to Your lovingkindness, so I shall keep the testimony of Your mouth.

verses.kjv: For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.
verses.modern: Your word, LORD, is eternal; it stands firm in the heavens.

verses.kjv: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
verses.modern: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; You established the earth, and it endures.

verses.kjv: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.
verses.modern: Your laws endure to this day, for all things serve You.

verses.kjv: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
verses.modern: If Your law had not been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.

verses.kjv: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.
verses.modern: I will never forget Your precepts, for by them You have preserved my life.

verses.kjv: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.
verses.modern: Save me, for I am Yours; I have sought out Your precepts.

verses.kjv: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.
verses.modern: The wicked are waiting to destroy me, but I will ponder your statutes.

verses.kjv: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.
verses.modern: To all perfection I see a limit, but your commands are boundless.

verses.kjv: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
verses.modern: Oh, how I love your law! I meditate on it all day long.

verses.kjv: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.
verses.modern: Your commands are always with me and make me wiser than my enemies.

verses.kjv: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.
verses.modern: I have more insight than all my teachers, for I meditate on your statutes.

verses.kjv: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.
verses.modern: I have more understanding than the elders, for I obey your precepts.

verses.kjv: I have refrained my feet from every evil way; that I might keep thy word.
verses.modern: I have kept my feet from every evil path so that I might obey your word.

verses.kjv: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.
verses.modern: I have not departed from your laws, for you yourself have taught me.

verses.kjv: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.modern: How sweet are your words to my taste, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

verses.kjv: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
verses.modern: I gain understanding from your precepts; therefore I hate every wrong path.

verses.kjv: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
verses.modern: Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path.

verses.kjv: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.
verses.modern: I have taken an oath and confirmed it, that I will follow your righteous laws.

verses.kjv: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O LORD, according unto thy word.
verses.modern: I have suffered much; preserve my life, LORD, according to Your word.

verses.kjv: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.
verses.modern: Accept, LORD, the willing praise of my mouth, and teach me Your laws.

verses.kjv: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.
verses.modern: Though I constantly take my life in my hands, I will not forget Your law.

verses.kjv: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.
verses.modern: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from your precepts.

verses.kjv: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
verses.modern: Your statutes are my heritage forever; they are the joy of my heart.

verses.kjv: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.
verses.modern: My heart is set on keeping your decrees to the very end.

verses.kjv: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
verses.modern: I hate double-minded people, but I love your law.

verses.kjv: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
verses.modern: You are my refuge and my shield; I have put my hope in your word.

verses.kjv: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.
verses.modern: Away from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commands of my God!

verses.kjv: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
verses.modern: Sustain me, my God, according to Your promise, and I will live; do not let my hopes be dashed.

verses.kjv: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.
verses.modern: Uphold me, and I will be delivered; I will always have regard for your decrees.

verses.kjv: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.
verses.modern: You reject all who stray from your decrees, for their delusions come to nothing.

verses.kjv: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.
verses.modern: All the wicked of the earth you discard like dross; therefore I love your statutes.

verses.kjv: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.
verses.modern: My flesh trembles in fear of you; I stand in awe of your laws.

verses.kjv: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.
verses.modern: I have done what is righteous and just; do not leave me to my oppressors.

verses.kjv: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.
verses.modern: Ensure your servant's well-being; do not let the arrogant oppress me.

verses.kjv: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.
verses.modern: My eyes fail, looking for your salvation, looking for your righteous promise.

verses.kjv: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.
verses.modern: Deal with your servant according to your mercy and teach me your decrees.

verses.kjv: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.
verses.modern: I am your servant; give me discernment that I may understand your statutes.

verses.kjv: It is time for thee, LORD, to work: for they have made void thy law.
verses.modern: It is time for You to act, LORD; Your law is being broken.

verses.kjv: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
verses.modern: Because I love Your commands more than gold, more than pure gold,

verses.kjv: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.
verses.modern: and because I consider all Your precepts right, I hate every wrong path.

verses.kjv: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.
verses.modern: Your statutes are wonderful; therefore I obey them.

verses.kjv: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
verses.modern: The unfolding of Your words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.

verses.kjv: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
verses.modern: I open my mouth and pant, longing for Your commands.

verses.kjv: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
verses.modern: Turn to me and have mercy on me, as You always do to those who love Your name.

verses.kjv: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.modern: Direct my footsteps according to Your word; let no iniquity rule over me.

verses.kjv: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
verses.modern: Deliver me from the oppression of man, so I will keep Your precepts.

verses.kjv: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.
verses.modern: Make Your face shine on Your servant and teach me Your decrees.

verses.kjv: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.
verses.modern: Streams of tears flow from my eyes, for Your law is not obeyed.

verses.kjv: Righteous art thou, O LORD, and upright are thy judgments.
verses.modern: You are righteous, LORD, and Your laws are right.

verses.kjv: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.
verses.modern: The statutes You have laid down are righteous; they are fully trustworthy.

verses.kjv: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.
verses.modern: My zeal wears me out, for my enemies ignore Your words.

verses.kjv: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.
verses.modern: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and Your servant loves them.

verses.kjv: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.
verses.modern: Though I am lowly and despised, I do not forget Your precepts.

verses.kjv: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.
verses.modern: Your righteousness is everlasting and Your law is true.

verses.kjv: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.
verses.modern: Trouble and distress have come upon me, but Your commands give me delight.

verses.kjv: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.
verses.modern: Your statutes are always righteous; give me understanding that I may live.

verses.kjv: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.
verses.modern: I call with all my heart; answer me, LORD, and I will obey Your decrees.

verses.kjv: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.
verses.modern: I call out to You; save me and I will keep Your statutes.

verses.kjv: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
verses.modern: I rise before dawn and cry for help; I have put my hope in Your word.

verses.kjv: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
verses.modern: My eyes stay open through the watches of the night, that I may meditate on Your promises.

verses.kjv: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O LORD, quicken me according to thy judgment.
verses.modern: Hear my voice according to Your lovingkindness; O LORD, quicken me according to Your judgment.

verses.kjv: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
verses.modern: Those who devise wicked schemes are near, but they are far from Your law.

verses.kjv: Thou art near, O LORD; and all thy commandments are truth.
verses.modern: Yet You are near, LORD, and all Your commands are true.

verses.kjv: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
verses.modern: Long ago I learned from Your statutes that You established them to last forever.

verses.kjv: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.
verses.modern: Look on my suffering and deliver me, for I have not forgotten Your law.

verses.kjv: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.
verses.modern: Defend my cause and redeem me; preserve my life according to Your promise.

verses.kjv: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.
verses.modern: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they do not seek out your decrees.

verses.kjv: Great are thy tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according to thy judgments.
verses.modern: Your compassion, LORD, is great; preserve my life according to Your laws.

verses.kjv: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.
verses.modern: Many are the foes who persecute me, but I have not turned from Your statutes.

verses.kjv: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.
verses.modern: I look on the faithless with loathing, for they do not obey Your word.

verses.kjv: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy lovingkindness.
verses.modern: Consider how I love Your precepts; quicken me, O LORD, according to Your lovingkindness.

verses.kjv: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.
verses.modern: All Your words are true; all Your righteous laws are eternal.

verses.kjv: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
verses.modern: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart trembles at Your word.

verses.kjv: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.
verses.modern: I rejoice in Your promise like one who finds great treasure.

verses.kjv: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
verses.modern: I hate and detest falsehood but I love Your law.

verses.kjv: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.
verses.modern: Seven times a day I praise You for Your righteous laws.

verses.kjv: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
verses.modern: Great peace have those who love Your law, and nothing can make them stumble.

verses.kjv: LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.
verses.modern: I wait for Your salvation, LORD, and I follow Your commands.

verses.kjv: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
verses.modern: I obey Your statutes, for I love them greatly.

verses.kjv: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.
verses.modern: I obey Your precepts and Your statutes, for all my ways are known to You.

verses.kjv: Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.
verses.modern: May my cry come before You, LORD; give me understanding according to Your word.

verses.kjv: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.
verses.modern: May my supplication come before You; deliver me according to Your promise.

verses.kjv: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
verses.modern: May my lips overflow with praise, for You teach me Your decrees.

verses.kjv: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.
verses.modern: May my tongue sing of Your word, for all Your commands are righteous.

verses.kjv: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.
verses.modern: May Your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen Your precepts.

verses.kjv: I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law is my delight.
verses.modern: I long for Your salvation, LORD, and Your law gives me delight.

verses.kjv: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.
verses.modern: Let me live that I may praise You, and may Your laws sustain me.

verses.kjv: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
verses.modern: I have strayed like a lost sheep. Seek Your servant, for I have not forgotten Your commands.

chapters.summary: The longest chapter in the Bible is an acrostic poem of 176 verses divided into twenty-two sections, one for each letter of the Hebrew alphabet, with every verse in each section beginning with that letter. The psalmist pours out sustained devotion to God's word — His law, statutes, precepts, commandments, and testimonies — pleading for understanding, delighting in obedience, and finding light, comfort, and life in Scripture through every trial.

verses.kjv: In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.
verses.modern: I call on the LORD in my distress, and He answers me.

verses.kjv: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.
verses.modern: Save me, LORD, from lying lips and from deceitful tongues.

verses.kjv: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?
verses.modern: What will He do to You, and what more besides, You deceitful tongue?

verses.kjv: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
verses.modern: He will punish You with a warrior's sharp arrows, with burning coals of the broom bush.

verses.kjv: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
verses.modern: Woe to me that I stay in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!

verses.kjv: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.
verses.modern: Too long have I lived among those who hate peace.

verses.kjv: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.
verses.modern: I am for peace; but when I speak, they are for war.

chapters.summary: The psalmist cries to the LORD in distress over lying tongues and deceitful lips, lamenting that he lives among those who hate peace. He has dwelt too long among hostile strangers, and when he speaks peace, they want war.

verses.kjv: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
verses.modern: I lift up my eyes to the mountains — where does my help come from?

verses.kjv: My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
verses.modern: My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

verses.kjv: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
verses.modern: He will not let Your foot slip — he who watches over you will not slumber;

verses.kjv: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.modern: indeed, He who watches over Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

verses.kjv: The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.
verses.modern: The LORD watches over You — the LORD is Your shade at Your right hand;

verses.kjv: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
verses.modern: the sun will not harm You by day, nor the moon by night.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.
verses.modern: The LORD will keep You from all harm — He will watch over Your life;

verses.kjv: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
verses.modern: the LORD will watch over Your coming and going both now and forevermore.

chapters.summary: The psalmist lifts his eyes to the hills and asks where his help comes from, answering that it comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth. The LORD neither slumbers nor sleeps but watches over His people, shading them by day and guarding them by night, preserving their going out and coming in forevermore.

verses.kjv: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
verses.modern: I rejoiced with those who said to me, "Let us go to the house of the LORD."

verses.kjv: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.
verses.modern: Our feet are standing in Your gates, Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:
verses.modern: Jerusalem is built like a city that is closely compacted together.

verses.kjv: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.
verses.modern: That is where the tribes go up — the tribes of the LORD — to praise the name of the LORD according to the statute given to Israel.

verses.kjv: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
verses.modern: There stand the thrones for judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

verses.kjv: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.
verses.modern: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: "May those who love you be secure.

verses.kjv: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.
verses.modern: May there be peace within your walls and security within your citadels."

verses.kjv: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
verses.modern: For the sake of my family and friends, I will say, "Peace be within you."

verses.kjv: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.
verses.modern: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek Your prosperity.

chapters.summary: David rejoices at the call to go to the house of the LORD, celebrating Jerusalem as the city where the tribes go up to give thanks and where the thrones of judgment stand. He prays for the peace of Jerusalem, asking prosperity for those who love her.

verses.kjv: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.
verses.modern: To You I lift up my eyes, O You who dwell in the heavens.

verses.kjv: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the LORD our God, until that he have mercy upon us.
verses.modern: As the eyes of slaves look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a female servant look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD our God, till He shows us His mercy.

verses.kjv: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
verses.modern: Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured no end of contempt.

verses.kjv: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.
verses.modern: We have endured no end of ridicule from the arrogant, of contempt from the proud.

chapters.summary: The psalmist lifts his eyes to God who is enthroned in heaven, comparing himself to a servant watching the hand of his master, waiting for mercy. He pleads for the LORD's compassion because his soul is full of the contempt and scorn of the proud.

verses.kjv: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;
verses.modern: If the LORD had not been on our side — let Israel say —

verses.kjv: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
verses.modern: if the LORD had not been on our side when people attacked us,

verses.kjv: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:
verses.modern: they would have swallowed us alive when their anger flared against us;

verses.kjv: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:
verses.modern: the flood would have engulfed us, the torrent would have swept over us,

verses.kjv: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
verses.modern: the raging waters would have swept us away.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
verses.modern: Praise be to the LORD, Who has not let us be torn by their teeth.

verses.kjv: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.
verses.modern: We have escaped like a bird from the fowler's snare; the snare has been broken, and we have escaped.

verses.kjv: Our help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
verses.modern: Our help is in the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

chapters.summary: David declares that if the LORD had not been on Israel's side, their enemies would have swallowed them alive and the flood would have swept them away. He blesses the LORD who did not give them over as prey, affirming that their help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

verses.kjv: They that trust in the LORD shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.
verses.modern: Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken but endures forever.

verses.kjv: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
verses.modern: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds His people both now and forevermore.

verses.kjv: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.
verses.modern: The scepter of the wicked will not remain over the land allotted to the righteous, for then the righteous might use their hands to do evil.

verses.kjv: Do good, O LORD, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
verses.modern: LORD, do good to those who are good, to those who are upright in heart.
