verses.kjv: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.
verses.modern: But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers. Peace be on Israel.

chapters.summary: The psalmist declares that those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken but endures forever, surrounded by the LORD as the mountains surround Jerusalem. He prays for peace on Israel and affirms that the scepter of the wicked will not rest on the land allotted to the righteous.

verses.kjv: When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
verses.modern: When the LORD restored the fortunes of Zion, we were like those who dreamed.

verses.kjv: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them.
verses.modern: Our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with songs of joy. Then it was said among the nations, "The LORD has done great things for them."

verses.kjv: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
verses.modern: The LORD has done great things for us, and we are filled with joy.

verses.kjv: Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.
verses.modern: Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.

verses.kjv: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
verses.modern: Those who sow with tears will reap with songs of joy.

verses.kjv: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
verses.modern: Those who go out weeping, carrying seed to sow, will return with songs of joy, carrying sheaves with them.

chapters.summary: The psalmist recalls the joy of the LORD's restoration of Zion, when the captives returned with laughter and singing so great that even the nations said the LORD had done great things. He prays for further restoration, declaring that those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.

verses.kjv: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.
verses.modern: Unless the LORD builds the house, the builders labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the guards stand watch in vain.

verses.kjv: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.
verses.modern: In vain You rise early and stay up late, toiling for food to eat — for He grants sleep to those He loves.

verses.kjv: Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
verses.modern: Children are a heritage from the LORD, the fruit of the womb a reward from Him.

verses.kjv: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.
verses.modern: Like arrows in the hands of a warrior are children born in one's youth.

verses.kjv: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.
verses.modern: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. They will not be put to shame when they contend with their opponents in court.

chapters.summary: Solomon declares that unless the LORD builds the house and watches over the city, the builders and watchmen labor in vain. Children are a heritage from the LORD, and the man whose quiver is full of them is blessed.

verses.kjv: Blessed is every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.
verses.modern: Blessed are all who fear the LORD, Who walk in obedience to Him.

verses.kjv: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
verses.modern: You will eat the fruit of Your labor; blessings and prosperity will be Yours.

verses.kjv: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.
verses.modern: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine within Your house; Your children will be like olive shoots around Your table.

verses.kjv: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.
verses.modern: Yes, this will be the blessing for the man who fears the LORD.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
verses.modern: May the LORD bless You from Zion; may You see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of Your life.

verses.kjv: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, and peace upon Israel.
verses.modern: May You live to see Your children's children — peace be on Israel.

chapters.summary: The psalmist pronounces blessings on the man who fears the LORD and walks in His ways: he will eat the fruit of his labor, his wife will be like a fruitful vine, and his children like olive shoots around his table. He prays that this man would see the prosperity of Jerusalem and peace upon Israel all the days of his life.

verses.kjv: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:
verses.modern: "They have greatly oppressed me from my youth" — let Israel say —

verses.kjv: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.modern: "they have greatly oppressed me from my youth, but they have not gained the victory over me."

verses.kjv: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
verses.modern: Plowmen have plowed my back and made their furrows long.

verses.kjv: The LORD is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
verses.modern: But the LORD is righteous; He has cut me free from the cords of the wicked.

verses.kjv: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.
verses.modern: May all who hate Zion be turned back in shame.

verses.kjv: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:
verses.modern: May they be like grass on the roof, which withers before it can grow;

verses.kjv: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.
verses.modern: a reaper cannot fill His hands with it, nor one who gathers fill His arms.

verses.kjv: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD be upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.
verses.modern: May those who pass by not say to them, "The blessing of the LORD be on You; we bless You in the name of the LORD."

chapters.summary: The psalmist recalls how Israel has been greatly oppressed from its youth, yet its enemies have not prevailed against it. He prays that all who hate Zion will be put to shame and wither like grass on a rooftop that dries before it grows.

verses.kjv: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.
verses.modern: Out of the depths I cry to You, LORD;

verses.kjv: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
verses.modern: Lord, hear my voice. Let Your ears be attentive to my cry for mercy.

verses.kjv: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?
verses.modern: If You, LORD, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?

verses.kjv: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
verses.modern: But with You there is forgiveness, so that we can, with reverence, serve You.

verses.kjv: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
verses.modern: I wait for the LORD, my whole being waits, and in His word I put my hope.

verses.kjv: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.
verses.modern: I wait for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning, more than watchmen wait for the morning.

verses.kjv: Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.
verses.modern: Israel, put Your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is mercy and with Him is full redemption.

verses.kjv: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
verses.modern: He Himself will redeem Israel from all their sins.

chapters.summary: The psalmist cries to the LORD from the depths, pleading for a hearing and confessing that if God kept a record of sins, no one could stand. He places his hope in the LORD's word, waiting for Him more than watchmen wait for the morning, and calls Israel to hope in the LORD's plenteous redemption.

verses.kjv: LORD, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
verses.modern: My heart is not proud, LORD, my eyes are not haughty; I do not concern myself with great matters or things too wonderful for me.

verses.kjv: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.
verses.modern: But I have calmed and quieted myself, I am like a weaned child with its mother; like a weaned child I am content.

verses.kjv: Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.
verses.modern: Israel, put Your hope in the LORD both now and forevermore.

chapters.summary: David declares that his heart is not proud nor his eyes haughty, and he does not concern himself with great matters beyond him. He has calmed and quieted his soul like a weaned child with its mother, and he calls Israel to hope in the LORD forevermore.

verses.kjv: LORD, remember David, and all his afflictions:
verses.modern: LORD, remember David and all his self-denial.

verses.kjv: How he sware unto the LORD, and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;
verses.modern: He swore an oath to the LORD, He made a vow to the Mighty One of Jacob:

verses.kjv: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;
verses.modern: "I will not enter my house or go to my bed,

verses.kjv: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,
verses.modern: I will allow no sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids,

verses.kjv: Until I find out a place for the LORD, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.
verses.modern: till I find a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob."

verses.kjv: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.
verses.modern: We heard it in Ephrathah, we came upon it in the fields of Jaar:

verses.kjv: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
verses.modern: "Let us go to His dwelling place, let us worship at His footstool, saying,

verses.kjv: Arise, O LORD, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.
verses.modern: 'Arise, LORD, and come to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your might.

verses.kjv: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.
verses.modern: Let Your priests be clothed with righteousness, and let Your saints shout for joy.

verses.kjv: For thy servant David's sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.
verses.modern: For your servant David's sake, do not turn away the face of your anointed.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
verses.modern: The LORD swore an oath to David, a sure oath he will not abandon: "One of your own descendants I will place on Your throne.

verses.kjv: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.
verses.modern: If Your sons keep my covenant and the statutes I teach them, then their sons will sit on Your throne for ever and ever."

verses.kjv: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.
verses.modern: For the LORD has chosen Zion, He has desired it for His dwelling, saying,

verses.kjv: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
verses.modern: "This is my resting place for ever and ever; here I will sit enthroned, for I have desired it.

verses.kjv: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
verses.modern: I will bless her with abundant provisions; her poor I will satisfy with food.

verses.kjv: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
verses.modern: I will also clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

verses.kjv: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.
verses.modern: There I will make the horn of David to bud; I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.

verses.kjv: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
verses.modern: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but his crown will be radiant on his head."

chapters.summary: The psalmist recalls David's oath to find a dwelling place for the LORD and pleads with God to remember David's hardships and faithfulness. God in turn swears an oath to David that his descendants will sit on his throne forever, and that He has chosen Zion as His resting place, where He will bless the faithful and clothe the priests with salvation.

verses.kjv: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
verses.modern: How good and pleasant it is when God's people live together in unity!

verses.kjv: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
verses.modern: It is like precious oil poured on the head, running down on the beard, running down on Aaron's beard, down on the collar of his robe.

verses.kjv: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.
verses.modern: It is as if the dew of Hermon were falling on Mount Zion. For there the LORD bestows His blessing, even life forevermore.

chapters.summary: David declares how good and pleasant it is when brothers dwell together in unity, comparing it to precious oil running down Aaron's beard and to the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. There the LORD commands the blessing — life forevermore.

verses.kjv: Behold, bless ye the LORD, all ye servants of the LORD, which by night stand in the house of the LORD.
verses.modern: Praise the LORD, all You servants of the LORD Who minister by night in the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.
verses.modern: Lift up Your hands in the sanctuary and praise the LORD.

verses.kjv: The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.
verses.modern: May the LORD bless You from Zion, He who is the Maker of heaven and earth.

chapters.summary: The psalmist calls the servants of the LORD who stand by night in the house of the LORD to lift up their hands in the sanctuary and bless the LORD. He pronounces a blessing: may the LORD who made heaven and earth bless you from Zion.

verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the name of the LORD; praise him, O ye servants of the LORD.
verses.modern: Praise the LORD. Praise the name of the LORD; praise Him, You servants of the LORD,

verses.kjv: Ye that stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God,
verses.modern: You who minister in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.

verses.kjv: Praise the LORD; for the LORD is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
verses.modern: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good; sing praise to His name, for that is pleasant.

verses.kjv: For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.
verses.modern: For the LORD has chosen Jacob to be his own, Israel to be his treasured possession.

verses.kjv: For I know that the LORD is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.
verses.modern: I know that the LORD is great, that our Lord is greater than all gods.

verses.kjv: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.
verses.modern: The LORD does whatever pleases Him, in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all their depths.

verses.kjv: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.
verses.modern: He makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth; He sends lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from His storehouses.

verses.kjv: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.
verses.modern: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, the firstborn of people and animals.

verses.kjv: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
verses.modern: He sent his signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.

verses.kjv: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;
verses.modern: He struck down many nations and killed mighty kings —

verses.kjv: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:
verses.modern: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kings of Canaan —

verses.kjv: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.
verses.modern: and he gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to his people Israel.

verses.kjv: Thy name, O LORD, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.
verses.modern: Your name, LORD, endures forever; Your renown, LORD, through all generations.

verses.kjv: For the LORD will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.
verses.modern: For the LORD will vindicate His people and have compassion on His servants.

verses.kjv: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
verses.modern: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

verses.kjv: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;
verses.modern: They have mouths, but cannot speak; eyes, but cannot see.

verses.kjv: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.
verses.modern: They have ears, but cannot hear; nor is there breath in their mouths.

verses.kjv: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.
verses.modern: Those who make them will be like them, and so will all who trust in them.

verses.kjv: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel: bless the LORD, O house of Aaron:
verses.modern: All You Israelites, praise the LORD; house of Aaron, praise the LORD;

verses.kjv: Bless the LORD, O house of Levi: ye that fear the LORD, bless the LORD.
verses.modern: house of Levi, praise the LORD; You who fear Him, praise the LORD.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.modern: Praise be to the LORD from Zion, to Him who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD.

chapters.summary: The psalmist calls the servants of the LORD to praise His name, declaring that He does whatever pleases Him in heaven and on earth, in the seas and in the depths. He recounts God's mighty acts in Egypt and against the kings of Canaan, and contrasts the living God with the lifeless idols of the nations.

verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good. His mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: Give thanks to the God of gods. His mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: Give thanks to the Lord of lords. His mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: To Him who alone does great wonders, His mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: Who by His understanding made the heavens, His mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: Who spread out the earth upon the waters, His mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.modern: Who made the great lights — his mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.modern: The sun to govern the day, His mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: The moon and stars to govern the night; His mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.modern: To Him who struck down the firstborn of Egypt, His mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.modern: And brought Israel out from among them, His mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: With a mighty hand and outstretched arm; His mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.modern: To Him who divided the Red Sea asunder, His mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.modern: And brought Israel through the midst of it, His mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: But swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea; his mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: To him who led his people through the wilderness; his mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.modern: To him who struck down great kings, his mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.modern: And killed mighty kings — his mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.modern: Sihon king of the Amorites, his mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.modern: And Og king of Bashan — his mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.modern: And gave their land as an inheritance, his mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: An inheritance to his servant Israel; his mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.modern: He remembered us in our low condition, his mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: And freed us from our enemies. His mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: He gives food to every creature. His mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: Give thanks to the God of heaven. His mercy endures forever.

chapters.summary: The psalmist gives thanks to the LORD in twenty-six verses, each ending with the refrain that His mercy endures forever. He praises God for creation, the exodus, the conquest of Canaan, and His care for His people in their low estate.

verses.kjv: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
verses.modern: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.

verses.kjv: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
verses.modern: There on the poplars we hung our harps,

verses.kjv: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
verses.modern: for there our captors asked us for songs, our tormentors demanded songs of joy; they said, "Sing us one of the songs of Zion!"

verses.kjv: How shall we sing the LORD'S song in a strange land?
verses.modern: How can we sing the songs of the LORD while in a foreign land?

verses.kjv: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.
verses.modern: If I forget You, Jerusalem, may my right hand forget its skill.

verses.kjv: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.
verses.modern: May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember You, if I do not consider Jerusalem my highest joy.

verses.kjv: Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.
verses.modern: Remember, LORD, what the Edomites did on the day Jerusalem fell. "Tear it down," they cried, "tear it down to its foundations!"

verses.kjv: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.
verses.modern: O daughter of Babylon, who are to be destroyed, happy shall He be who rewards you as you have served us.

verses.kjv: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.
verses.modern: Blessed is the one who seizes your infants and dashes them against the rocks.

chapters.summary: The exiles weep by the rivers of Babylon, unable to sing the songs of Zion in a foreign land while their captors taunt them for a song. The psalmist vows never to forget Jerusalem and pronounces a fierce blessing on the one who repays Babylon for what she did to Israel.

verses.kjv: I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.
verses.modern: I will praise You, LORD, with all my heart; before the gods I will sing Your praise.

verses.kjv: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.
verses.modern: I will worship toward Your holy temple, and praise Your name for Your lovingkindness and for Your truth, for You have magnified Your word above all Your name.

verses.kjv: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
verses.modern: When I called, You answered me; You greatly emboldened me.

verses.kjv: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD, when they hear the words of thy mouth.
verses.modern: May all the kings of the earth praise You, LORD, when they hear what You have decreed.

verses.kjv: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD: for great is the glory of the LORD.
verses.modern: May they sing of the ways of the LORD, for the glory of the LORD is great.

verses.kjv: Though the LORD be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.
verses.modern: Though the LORD is exalted, He looks kindly on the lowly; though lofty, He sees them from afar.

verses.kjv: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.
verses.modern: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve my life. You stretch out Your hand against the anger of my foes; with Your right hand You save me.

verses.kjv: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
verses.modern: The LORD will perfect that which concerns me; Your mercy, O LORD, endures forever; do not forsake the works of Your own hands.

chapters.summary: David praises the LORD with his whole heart before the gods, giving thanks for His lovingkindness and truth, declaring that God has magnified His word above all His name. He trusts that though he walks in the midst of trouble, the LORD will stretch out His hand against his enemies and complete what He has begun.

verses.kjv: O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known me.
verses.modern: You have searched me, LORD, and You know me.

verses.kjv: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.
verses.modern: You know when I sit and when I rise; You perceive my thoughts from far away.

verses.kjv: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.
verses.modern: You discern my going out and my lying down; You are familiar with all my ways.

verses.kjv: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O LORD, thou knowest it altogether.
verses.modern: Before a word is on my tongue You, LORD, know it completely.

verses.kjv: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.
verses.modern: You hem me in behind and before, and You lay Your hand upon me.

verses.kjv: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.
verses.modern: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.

verses.kjv: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
verses.modern: Where can I go from Your Spirit? Where can I flee from Your presence?

verses.kjv: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.
verses.modern: If I go up to the heavens, You are there; if I make my bed in hell, You are there.

verses.kjv: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
verses.modern: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle on the far side of the sea,

verses.kjv: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.
verses.modern: even there Your hand will guide me, Your right hand will hold me fast.

verses.kjv: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.
verses.modern: If I say, "Surely the darkness will hide me and the light become night around me,"

verses.kjv: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.
verses.modern: even the darkness will not be dark to You; the night will shine like the day, for darkness is as light to You.

verses.kjv: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother's womb.
verses.modern: For You created my inmost being; You knit me together in my mother's womb.

verses.kjv: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
verses.modern: I praise You because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; Your works are wonderful, I know that full well.

verses.kjv: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
verses.modern: My frame was not hidden from You when I was made in the secret place, when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.

verses.kjv: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.
verses.modern: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all the days ordained for me were written in Your book before one of them came to be.

verses.kjv: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!
verses.modern: How precious to me are Your thoughts, God! How vast is the sum of them!

verses.kjv: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.
verses.modern: Were I to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand — when I awake, I am still with You.

verses.kjv: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.
verses.modern: If only You, God, would slay the wicked! Away from me, you who are bloodthirsty!

verses.kjv: For they speak against thee wickedly, and thine enemies take thy name in vain.
verses.modern: They speak of you with evil intent; your adversaries misuse your name.

verses.kjv: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?
verses.modern: Do I not hate those who hate You, LORD, and abhor those who are in rebellion against You?

verses.kjv: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.
verses.modern: I have nothing but hatred for them; I count them my enemies.

verses.kjv: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
verses.modern: Search me, God, and know my heart; test me and know my anxious thoughts.

verses.kjv: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
verses.modern: See if there is any offensive way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

chapters.summary: David marvels at God's complete knowledge of him — every thought, every word, every movement known before it happens — and at God's inescapable presence in the heights of heaven, the depths of hell, and the farthest sea. He praises the LORD for forming him in his mother's womb, and asks God to search his heart and lead him in the everlasting way.

verses.kjv: Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;
verses.modern: Rescue me, LORD, from evildoers; protect me from the violent,

verses.kjv: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.
verses.modern: who devise evil plans in their hearts and stir up war every day.

verses.kjv: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison is under their lips. Selah.
verses.modern: They make their tongues as sharp as a serpent's; the poison of vipers is on their lips.

verses.kjv: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
verses.modern: Keep me safe, LORD, from the hands of the wicked; protect me from the violent, who devise ways to trip my feet.

verses.kjv: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.
verses.modern: The arrogant have hidden a snare for me; they have spread out the cords of their net and set traps for me along my path.

verses.kjv: I said unto the LORD, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.
verses.modern: I say to the LORD, "You are my God." Hear, LORD, my cry for mercy.

verses.kjv: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
verses.modern: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You have covered my head in the day of battle.

verses.kjv: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.
verses.modern: Do not grant the wicked their desires, LORD; do not let their plans succeed, or they will become proud.

verses.kjv: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
verses.modern: May the heads of those who surround me be covered with the trouble their lips have caused.

verses.kjv: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
verses.modern: May burning coals fall on them; may they be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, never to rise.

verses.kjv: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
verses.modern: May slanderers not be established in the land; may disaster hunt down the violent.

verses.kjv: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.
verses.modern: I know that the LORD secures justice for the poor and upholds the cause of the needy.

verses.kjv: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.
verses.modern: Surely the righteous will praise your name, and the upright will live in Your presence.

chapters.summary: David pleads with the LORD to rescue him from violent and evil men who sharpen their tongues like serpents and plot his downfall. He trusts that the LORD upholds the cause of the afflicted and the rights of the poor, and prays that the mischief of the wicked falls back on their own heads.

verses.kjv: LORD, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.
verses.modern: I call to You, LORD, come quickly to me; hear me when I call to You.

verses.kjv: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
verses.modern: May my prayer be set before You like incense; may the lifting up of my hands be like the evening sacrifice.

verses.kjv: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
verses.modern: Set a guard over my mouth, LORD; keep watch over the door of my lips.

verses.kjv: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.
verses.modern: Do not let my heart be drawn to what is evil so that I take part in wicked deeds along with those who are evildoers; do not let me eat their delicacies.

verses.kjv: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.
verses.modern: Let a righteous man strike me — that is a kindness; let Him rebuke me — that is oil on my head. My head will not refuse it, for my prayer will still be against the deeds of evildoers.

verses.kjv: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
verses.modern: Their rulers will be thrown down from the cliffs, and the wicked will learn that my words were well spoken.

verses.kjv: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.
verses.modern: They will say, "As one plows and breaks up the earth, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of the grave."

verses.kjv: But mine eyes are unto thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
verses.modern: But my eyes are to You, O GOD the Lord; in You is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.

verses.kjv: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.
verses.modern: Keep me safe from the traps set by evildoers, from the snares they have laid for me.

verses.kjv: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.
verses.modern: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by in safety.

chapters.summary: David prays that his words and worship would rise before God like incense, asking the LORD to set a guard over his mouth and keep his heart from evil. He would rather be rebuked by the righteous than anointed by the wicked, and he looks to the LORD alone as his refuge.

verses.kjv: I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication.
verses.modern: I cry aloud to the LORD; I lift up my voice to the LORD for mercy.

verses.kjv: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.
verses.modern: I pour out before Him my complaint; before Him I tell my trouble.

verses.kjv: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
verses.modern: When my spirit grows faint within me, it is You who watch over my way. In the path where I walk people have hidden a snare for me.

verses.kjv: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.
verses.modern: Look and see, there is no one at my right hand; no one is concerned for me. I have no refuge; no one cares for my life.

verses.kjv: I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.
verses.modern: I cry to You, LORD; I say, "You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living."

verses.kjv: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
verses.modern: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need; rescue me from those who pursue me, for they are too strong for me.

verses.kjv: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.
verses.modern: Set me free from my prison, that I may praise Your name. Then the righteous will gather about me because of your goodness to me.

chapters.summary: David, praying from a cave, pours out his complaint before the LORD, declaring that no one cares for his soul and there is no refuge left. He cries out to God as his only portion in the land of the living, trusting that the LORD will deal bountifully with him.

verses.kjv: Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.
verses.modern: LORD, hear my prayer, listen to my cry for mercy; in Your faithfulness and righteousness come to my relief.

verses.kjv: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.
verses.modern: Do not bring Your servant into judgment, for no one living is righteous before you.

verses.kjv: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
verses.modern: The enemy pursues me, he crushes me to the ground; He makes me dwell in the darkness like those long dead.

verses.kjv: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.
verses.modern: So my spirit grows faint within me; my heart within me is dismayed.

verses.kjv: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.
verses.modern: I remember the days of long ago; I meditate on all Your works and consider what Your hands have done.

verses.kjv: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.
verses.modern: I spread out my hands to You; I thirst for You like a parched land.

verses.kjv: Hear me speedily, O LORD: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
verses.modern: Answer me quickly, LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide Your face from me or I will be like those who go down to the pit.

verses.kjv: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
verses.modern: Cause me to hear Your lovingkindness in the morning, for in You do I trust; cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to You.

verses.kjv: Deliver me, O LORD, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
verses.modern: Rescue me from my enemies, LORD, for I hide myself in You.

verses.kjv: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
verses.modern: Teach me to do Your will, for You are my God; may Your good Spirit lead me on level ground.

verses.kjv: Quicken me, O LORD, for thy name's sake: for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.
verses.modern: For Your name's sake, LORD, preserve my life; in Your righteousness, bring me out of trouble.

verses.kjv: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.
verses.modern: And of Your mercy cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, for I am Your servant.

chapters.summary: David pleads with the LORD to hear his prayer and not enter into judgment with him, for no living person is righteous before God. Crushed by enemies and overwhelmed in spirit, he remembers God's past works, stretches out his hands, and asks to be taught God's will and led on level ground.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:
verses.modern: Praise be to the LORD my Rock, who trains my hands for war, my fingers for battle.

verses.kjv: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.
verses.modern: He is my loving God and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer, my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.

verses.kjv: LORD, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!
verses.modern: LORD, what is man, that You take knowledge of Him? Or the son of man, that You make account of Him?

verses.kjv: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.
verses.modern: They are like a breath; their days are like a fleeting shadow.

verses.kjv: Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
verses.modern: Part Your heavens, LORD, and come down; touch the mountains, so that they smoke.

verses.kjv: Send thine lightnings, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.
verses.modern: Send forth lightning and scatter the enemy; shoot your arrows and rout them.

verses.kjv: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;
verses.modern: Reach down Your hand from on high; deliver me and rescue me from the mighty waters, from the hands of foreigners

verses.kjv: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.modern: whose mouths are full of lies, whose right hands are deceitful.

verses.kjv: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.
verses.modern: I will sing a new song to You, my God; on the ten-stringed lyre I will make music to You,

verses.kjv: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.
verses.modern: to the One who gives victory to kings, who delivers his servant David.

verses.kjv: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:
verses.modern: From the deadly sword deliver me; rescue me from the hands of foreigners whose mouths are full of lies, whose right hands are deceitful.

verses.kjv: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:
verses.modern: Then our sons in their youth will be like well-nurtured plants, and our daughters will be like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

verses.kjv: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:
verses.modern: Our barns will be filled with every kind of provision. Our sheep will increase by thousands, by tens of thousands in our fields;

verses.kjv: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.
verses.modern: our oxen will draw heavy loads. There will be no breaching of walls, no going into captivity, no cry of distress in our streets.

verses.kjv: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the LORD.
verses.modern: Blessed is the people of whom this is true; blessed is the people whose God is the LORD.

chapters.summary: David blesses the LORD as his Rock who trains his hands for war, his fortress and deliverer, and he marvels that God pays attention to mortal man who is like a breath. He asks God to part the heavens and come down, to rescue him from enemies, and prays for a blessed nation whose God is the LORD.

verses.kjv: I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
verses.modern: I will exalt You, my God the King; I will praise your name for ever and ever.

verses.kjv: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
verses.modern: Every day I will praise you and extol your name for ever and ever.

verses.kjv: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
verses.modern: Great is the LORD and most worthy of praise; His greatness no one can fathom.

verses.kjv: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.
verses.modern: One generation commends Your works to another; they tell of Your mighty acts.

verses.kjv: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.
verses.modern: They speak of the glorious splendor of Your majesty — and I will meditate on Your wonderful works.

verses.kjv: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.
verses.modern: They tell of the power of Your awesome works — and I will proclaim Your great deeds.

verses.kjv: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.
verses.modern: They celebrate Your abundant goodness and joyfully sing of Your righteousness.

verses.kjv: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
verses.modern: The LORD is gracious and full of compassion, longsuffering, and of great mercy.

verses.kjv: The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
verses.modern: The LORD is good to all; He has compassion on all He has made.

verses.kjv: All thy works shall praise thee, O LORD; and thy saints shall bless thee.
verses.modern: All Your works shall praise You, O LORD; and Your saints shall bless You.

verses.kjv: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;
verses.modern: They shall speak of the glory of Your kingdom, and talk of Your power,

verses.kjv: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.
verses.modern: to make known to the sons of men His mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of His kingdom.

verses.kjv: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
verses.modern: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Your dominion endures throughout all generations.

verses.kjv: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
verses.modern: The LORD upholds all who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.

verses.kjv: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.
verses.modern: The eyes of all look to You, and You give them their food at the proper time.

verses.kjv: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
verses.modern: You open Your hand and satisfy the desires of every living thing.

verses.kjv: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.
verses.modern: The LORD is righteous in all His ways, and holy in all His works.

verses.kjv: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
verses.modern: The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call on Him in truth.

verses.kjv: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.
verses.modern: He fulfills the desires of those who fear Him; He hears their cry and saves them.

verses.kjv: The LORD preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.
verses.modern: The LORD watches over all who love Him, but all the wicked he will destroy.

verses.kjv: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
verses.modern: My mouth will speak in praise of the LORD. Let every creature praise His holy name for ever and ever.

chapters.summary: David exalts the LORD as King, declaring His greatness unsearchable and His mighty acts worthy of praise from one generation to the next. The LORD is gracious, merciful, longsuffering, good to all, faithful in all His words, and near to all who call on Him in truth.

verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.
verses.modern: Praise the LORD. Praise the LORD, my soul.

verses.kjv: While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.
verses.modern: I will praise the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.

verses.kjv: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.
verses.modern: Put not Your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.

verses.kjv: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.
verses.modern: When their spirit departs, they return to the ground; on that very day their plans come to nothing.

verses.kjv: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD his God:
verses.modern: Blessed are those whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD their God.

verses.kjv: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keepeth truth for ever:
verses.modern: He is the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them — he remains faithful forever.

verses.kjv: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The LORD looseth the prisoners:
verses.modern: He upholds the cause of the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets prisoners free,

verses.kjv: The LORD openeth the eyes of the blind: the LORD raiseth them that are bowed down: the LORD loveth the righteous:
verses.modern: the LORD gives sight to the blind, the LORD lifts up those who are bowed down, the LORD loves the righteous.

verses.kjv: The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
verses.modern: The LORD watches over the foreigner and sustains the fatherless and the widow, but He frustrates the ways of the wicked.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.modern: The LORD reigns forever, Your God, O Zion, for all generations. Praise the LORD.

chapters.summary: The psalmist resolves to praise the LORD all his life, warning against trusting in princes whose plans perish when they die. The LORD keeps faith forever, executes justice for the oppressed, gives food to the hungry, sets prisoners free, opens the eyes of the blind, and reigns forever.

verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.
verses.modern: Praise the LORD. How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and fitting to praise Him!

verses.kjv: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.
verses.modern: The LORD builds up Jerusalem; He gathers the exiles of Israel.

verses.kjv: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
verses.modern: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.

verses.kjv: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.
verses.modern: He determines the number of the stars and calls them each by name.

verses.kjv: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.
verses.modern: Great is our Lord and mighty in power; His understanding has no limit.

verses.kjv: The LORD lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.
verses.modern: The LORD sustains the humble but casts the wicked to the ground.

verses.kjv: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:
verses.modern: Sing to the LORD with grateful praise; make music to our God on the harp.

verses.kjv: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.
verses.modern: He covers the sky with clouds; He supplies the earth with rain and makes grass grow on the hills.

verses.kjv: He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.
verses.modern: He provides food for the cattle and for the young ravens when they call.

verses.kjv: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.
verses.modern: His pleasure is not in the strength of the horse, nor His delight in the legs of the warrior;

verses.kjv: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.
verses.modern: the LORD delights in those who fear Him, who put their hope in His mercy.

verses.kjv: Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.
verses.modern: Extol the LORD, Jerusalem; praise Your God, Zion.

verses.kjv: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.
verses.modern: He strengthens the bars of Your gates and blesses Your people within You.

verses.kjv: He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.
verses.modern: He grants peace to Your borders and satisfies You with the finest of wheat.

verses.kjv: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.
verses.modern: He sends His command to the earth; His word runs swiftly.

verses.kjv: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.
verses.modern: He spreads the snow like wool and scatters the frost like ashes.

verses.kjv: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
verses.modern: He hurls down His hail like pebbles. Who can withstand His icy blast?

verses.kjv: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
verses.modern: He sends His word and melts them; He stirs up His breezes, and the waters flow.

verses.kjv: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.
verses.modern: He has revealed his word to Jacob, his laws and decrees to Israel.

verses.kjv: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.modern: He has done this for no other nation; they do not know His laws. Praise the LORD.

chapters.summary: The psalmist praises the LORD who rebuilds Jerusalem, gathers the outcasts of Israel, and heals the brokenhearted, while also numbering the stars and calling them each by name. He sends snow, frost, and ice, then melts them with His wind, and He has revealed His word and statutes to Israel as to no other nation.

verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights.
verses.modern: Praise the LORD. Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise Him in the heights above.

verses.kjv: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.
verses.modern: Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His heavenly hosts.

verses.kjv: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.
verses.modern: Praise Him, sun and moon; praise Him, all You shining stars.

verses.kjv: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.
verses.modern: Praise Him, You highest heavens and You waters above the skies.

verses.kjv: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for he commanded, and they were created.
verses.modern: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for at His command they were created,

verses.kjv: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.
verses.modern: and He established them for ever and ever — he issued a decree that will never pass away.

verses.kjv: Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:
verses.modern: Praise the LORD from the earth, You great sea creatures and all ocean depths,

verses.kjv: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
verses.modern: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy winds that do His bidding,

verses.kjv: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:
verses.modern: you mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,

verses.kjv: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:
verses.modern: wild animals and all cattle, small creatures and flying birds,

verses.kjv: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:
verses.modern: kings of the earth and all nations, You princes and all rulers on earth,

verses.kjv: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:
verses.modern: young men and women, old men and children.

verses.kjv: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.
verses.modern: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for His name alone is exalted; His splendor is above the earth and the heavens.

verses.kjv: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.modern: And He has raised up for His people a horn, the praise of all His faithful servants, of Israel, the people close to his heart. Praise the LORD.

chapters.summary: The psalmist calls all creation to praise the LORD — angels, sun, moon, stars, and the heavens above, then fire, hail, snow, wind, mountains, trees, beasts, birds, kings, and all peoples below. He has exalted the horn of His people, and His name alone is excellent.

verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.
verses.modern: Praise the LORD. Sing to the LORD a new song, His praise in the congregation of saints.

verses.kjv: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.modern: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; let the people of Zion be glad in their King.

verses.kjv: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.
verses.modern: Let them praise His name with dancing and make music to Him with timbrel and harp.

verses.kjv: For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
verses.modern: For the LORD takes delight in His people; He crowns the humble with victory.

verses.kjv: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
verses.modern: Let the saints be joyful in glory; let them sing aloud on their beds.

verses.kjv: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;
verses.modern: May the praise of God be in their mouths and a double-edged sword in their hands,

verses.kjv: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;
verses.modern: to inflict vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples,

verses.kjv: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
verses.modern: to bind their kings with fetters, their nobles with shackles of iron,

verses.kjv: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.modern: to execute on them the judgment written; this honor have all His saints. Praise the LORD.

chapters.summary: The psalmist calls the saints to sing a new song to the LORD and rejoice in their Maker and King with dancing, timbrel, and harp. He gives them a two-edged sword to execute vengeance on the nations and bind their kings — this honor belongs to all His saints.

verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
verses.modern: Praise the LORD. Praise God in His sanctuary; praise Him in His mighty firmament.

verses.kjv: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.
verses.modern: Praise Him for His acts of power; praise Him for His surpassing greatness.

verses.kjv: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.
verses.modern: Praise Him with the sounding of the trumpet, praise Him with the harp and lyre,

verses.kjv: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.
verses.modern: praise Him with timbrel and dancing, praise Him with the strings and pipe,

verses.kjv: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
verses.modern: praise Him with the clash of cymbals, praise Him with resounding cymbals.

verses.kjv: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.modern: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD. Praise the LORD.

chapters.summary: The final psalm calls everything and everyone to praise the LORD in His sanctuary with every instrument — trumpet, harp, lyre, timbrel, strings, pipe, and cymbals. It closes the entire Psalter with the command: let everything that has breath praise the LORD.
